4.7.m: Inborn nature is difficult to surmount, producing palpable experience; / any alteration of inborn nature is perceived in every way by men.'

4.7.s:
viprasyaivaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā jagāmādarśanaṃ śanaiḥ ..
punaḥ kaiścidahorātrairājagāma sa tāṃ purīm .. 16 ..
4.7.d:
विप्रस्यैवं वचः श्रुत्वा जगामादर्शनं शनैः ॥
पुनः कैश्चिदहोरात्रैराजगाम स तां पुरीम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.7.m: Hearing the brāhmaṇa's words, he vanished slowly. / Then, after some days and nights, he came again to that city.

4.7.s:
mūlajālakavipreṇa pṛṣṭaḥ prāhāmarāvatīm ..
gato'haṃ pṛṣṭavāṃstatra raṃbhāṃ vibhramakāriṇīm .. 17 ..
4.7.d:
मूलजालकविप्रेण पृष्टः प्राहामरावतीम् ॥
गतोऽहं पृष्टवांस्तत्र रंभां विभ्रमकारिणीम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.7.m: Questioned by the brāhmaṇa who lived on root-fibres, he said: 'I went to Amarāvatī; / there I questioned the wanton Rambhā.

4.7.s:
śakrasyāvasare vṛtte vrajantyāḥ svagṛhaṃ mayā ..
tvatsaṃdeśaḥ samākhyātaḥ sāvadatko na vedmi tam ..18..
4.7.d:
शक्रस्यावसरे वृत्ते व्रजन्त्याः स्वगृहं मया ॥
त्वत्संदेशः समाख्यातः सावदत्को न वेद्मि तम् ॥18॥
4.7.m: When Śakra's court was concluded, as she was going to her own abode, / your message was related by me. She said: "Who is he? I do not know him.

4.7.s:
vidyayā kalayā cāpi pauruṣeṇa vratena ca ..
tapasā vā pumānmartyo divi vijñāyate ciram .. 19 ..
4.7.d:
विद्यया कलया चापि पौरुषेण व्रतेन च ॥
तपसा वा पुमान्मर्त्यो दिवि विज्ञायते चिरम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.7.m: By learning, by fine art, by manly prowess, by a votive observance, / or by austerity is a mortal man known in heaven for a long time."'

4.7.s:
brāhmaṇastamathovāca mugdhā dagdhāgnisaṃbhavā ..
na bhakṣayāmi śakaṭaṃ vratenaitena vetti mām .. 20 ..
4.7.d:
ब्राह्मणस्तमथोवाच मुग्धा दग्धाग्निसंभवा ॥
न भक्षयामि शकटं व्रतेनैतेन वेत्ति माम् ॥ 20 ॥
4.7.m: The brāhmaṇa then said to him: 'The simple girl born from fire is ignorant! / I do not eat Rohiṇī; through this votive observance she knows me.'

4.7.s:
tasyaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa siddhaḥ suviśuddhadhīḥ ..
prahasyāmaṃtrya taṃ vipraṃ jagāmādarśanaṃ punaḥ .. 21 ..
4.7.d:
तस्यैतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स सिद्धः सुविशुद्धधीः ॥
प्रहस्यामंत्र्य तं विप्रं जगामादर्शनं पुनः ॥ 21 ॥
4.7.m: Hearing this speech of his, that siddha of very pure intellect / laughed, took leave of that brāhmaṇa, and vanished once more.

4.7.s:
kadācicca ratā tena svargamārgaṃ yadṛcchayā ..
dṛṣṭvā raṃbhāṃ dvijaproktaṃ sarvameva niveditam .. 22 ..
4.7.d:
कदाचिच्च रता तेन स्वर्गमार्गं यदृच्छया ॥
दृष्ट्वा रंभां द्विजप्रोक्तं सर्वमेव निवेदितम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.7.m: At another time, roaming along the path to heaven as he pleased, / he saw Rambhā and reported everything said by the brāhmaṇa.

4.7.s:
.. raṃbhovāca .. ..
ko na jānāmi taṃ vipraṃ śakaṭavratacāriṇam ..
mūlajālairvartayaṃtaṃ mahākālavanāśrayam .. 23 ..
4.7.d:
॥ रंभोवाच ॥ ॥
को न जानामि तं विप्रं शकटव्रतचारिणम् ॥
मूलजालैर्वर्तयंतं महाकालवनाश्रयम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.7.m: Rambhā said: / 'How could I not know that brāhmaṇa who observes the Cart Votive Observance, / living on root-fibres and resorting to the forest of Mahākāla?

4.7.s:
darśanādatha saṃbhāṣādupakārātsahāsanāt ..
caturdhā snehanirbaṃdho nṛṇāṃ saṃjāyate'dhikaḥ .. 24 ..
4.7.d:
दर्शनादथ संभाषादुपकारात्सहासनात् ॥
चतुर्धा स्नेहनिर्बंधो नृणां संजायतेऽधिकः ॥ 24 ॥
4.7.m: From seeing, from conversation, from a service rendered, and from sitting together: / in four ways does an intense attachment arise among men.

4.7.s:
na darśanaṃ na saṃbhāṣā kadācitsaha tena me ..
nāmaśravaṇamātreṇa snehaḥ saṃdarśito mahān .. 25 ..
4.7.d:
न दर्शनं न संभाषा कदाचित्सह तेन मे ॥
नामश्रवणमात्रेण स्नेहः संदर्शितो महान् ॥ 25 ॥
4.7.m: I had neither sight nor conversation at any time with him; / merely upon hearing the name, great affection has been shown.'

4.7.s:
ityevamuktvā raṃbhorū raṃbhā jaṃbhāriṇoṃtikam ..
vismayotphullanayanā jagāma gajagāminī ..26..
4.7.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा रंभोरू रंभा जंभारिणोंतिकम् ॥
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना जगाम गजगामिनी ॥26॥
4.7.m: Having spoken thus, Rambhā of the lovely thighs, with eyes wide with wonder / and walking like an elephant, went to the presence of the enemy of Jambha.

4.7.s:
gatvā nivedayāmāsa snehavrataviceṣṭitam ..
purato ruddhahṛdayā brāhmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ .. 27 ..
4.7.d:
गत्वा निवेदयामास स्नेहव्रतविचेष्टितम् ॥
पुरतो रुद्धहृदया ब्राह्मणस्य च धीमतः ॥ 27 ॥
4.7.m: Having gone, with a thrilled heart she reported before him / the manifestation of affection and the votive practice of the wise brāhmaṇa.

4.7.s:
śakraḥ provāca cārvaṃgīṃ gīrvāṇahṛdayaṃgamām ..
kimānayāmi taṃ vipraṃ samīpaṃ tava suvratam .. 28 ..
4.7.d:
शक्रः प्रोवाच चार्वंगीं गीर्वाणहृदयंगमाम् ॥
किमानयामि तं विप्रं समीपं तव सुव्रतम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.7.m: Śakra said to the fair-limbed woman who captivated the hearts of the gods: / 'Shall I bring that brāhmaṇa of excellent vows into your presence?'

4.7.s:
divyamālyāṃbaradharaṃ divyasragunulepanam ..
vimānavaramāropya darśayāmāsa taṃ punaḥ .. 29 ..
4.7.d:
दिव्यमाल्यांबरधरं दिव्यस्रगुनुलेपनम् ॥
विमानवरमारोप्य दर्शयामास तं पुनः ॥ 29 ॥
4.7.m: Having caused him to mount an excellent celestial chariot, wearing divine garlands and garments, / adorned with divine wreaths and ointments, he showed him to her again.

4.7.s:
tatrasthaḥ sa dvijo bhogīvibhunakti saha raṃbhayā ..
śakaṭavratamāhātmyamityetatte mayoditam .. 30 ..
4.7.d:
तत्रस्थः स द्विजो भोगीविभुनक्ति सह रंभया ॥
शकटव्रतमाहात्म्यमित्येतत्ते मयोदितम् ॥ 30 ॥
4.7.m: Remaining there, that brāhmaṇa as an enjoyer enjoys pleasures together with Rambhā. / Thus has the greatness of the Cart Votive Observance been spoken by me to you.

4.7.s:
rājyaśriyaṃ jagati sarvajanopabhogyāmāpnoti śakraśivakeśavayornivāsam..
nāprāpyamasti bhuvane sudṛḍhavratānāṃ tasmātsadā vratapareṇa nareṇa bhāvyam .. 31 ..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde śakaṭavratamāhātmyakathanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 7 .. cha ..
tilakavratavarṇanam
4.7.d:
राज्यश्रियं जगति सर्वजनोपभोग्यामाप्नोति शक्रशिवकेशवयोर्निवासम्॥
नाप्राप्यमस्ति भुवने सुदृढव्रतानां तस्मात्सदा व्रतपरेण नरेण भाव्यम् ॥ 31 ॥
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे शकटव्रतमाहात्म्यकथनंनाम सप्तमोऽध्यायः ॥ 7 ॥ छ ॥
तिलकव्रतवर्णनम्
4.7.m:
One attains the splendour of kingship in the world to be enjoyed by all people, and the abode of Śakra, Śiva, and Keśava; / nothing is unobtainable in the world for those of very firm votive observances; therefore a man should always be devoted to votive observances.
Thus ends the seventh chapter, titled "The Description of the Greatness of the Cart-Observance", in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Tilaka Votive Observance

4.8.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
brahmeśa keśavādīnāṃ gauryā gaṇapatestathā ..
durgāsūryāgnisomānāṃ vratāni madhusūdana .. 1 ..
4.8.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रह्मेश केशवादीनां गौर्या गणपतेस्तथा ॥
दुर्गासूर्याग्निसोमानां व्रतानि मधुसूदन ॥ 1 ॥
4.8.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / The votive observances of Brahmā, Īśa, Keśava, and others, as well as of Gaurī and Gaṇapati, / of Durgā, Sūrya, Agni, and Soma, O slayer of Madhu,

4.8.s:
śāstrāṃtareṣu dṛṣṭāni tava buddhigatāni ca ..
tāni sarvāṇi me deva vada devakiranandana .. 2 ..
4.8.d:
शास्त्रांतरेषु दृष्टानि तव बुद्धिगतानि च ॥
तानि सर्वाणि मे देव वद देवकिरनन्दन ॥ 2 ॥
4.8.m: which are seen in other scriptures and are held in your intellect— / tell me all of them, O God, O son of Devakī!

4.8.s:
pratipatkramayogena vihitā yasya yā tithiḥ ..
devasya tasyāṃ yatkāryaṃ tadaśeṣeṇa kīrtaya .. 3 ..
4.8.d:
प्रतिपत्क्रमयोगेन विहिता यस्य या तिथिः ॥
देवस्य तस्यां यत्कार्यं तदशेषेण कीर्तय ॥ 3 ॥
4.8.m: Which lunar day is prescribed for which god in the order starting from the first lunar day— / declare completely what is to be done on that [lunar day].'

4.8.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vasaṃte kiṃśukāśokaśobhane pratipattithiḥ ..
śuklā tasyāṃ prakurvīta snānaṃ niyamatatparaḥ.. 4 ..
4.8.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
वसंते किंशुकाशोकशोभने प्रतिपत्तिथिः ॥
शुक्ला तस्यां प्रकुर्वीत स्नानं नियमतत्परः॥ 4 ॥
4.8.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'In spring, charming with kiṃśuka and aśoka flowers, on the first lunar day / of the bright fortnight, one should take a bath, devoted to religious restraint.

4.8.s:
nārī naro vā rājendra saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
nadyāstīre taḍāge vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān.. 5 ..
4.8.d:
नारी नरो वा राजेन्द्र संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ॥
नद्यास्तीरे तडागे वा गृहे वा नियतात्मवान्॥ 5 ॥
4.8.m: A woman or a man, O king of kings, having gratified the ancestors and the deities, / on the bank of a river, at a pond, or at home, with controlled mind,

4.8.s:
piṣṭātakena vilikhedvatsaraṃ puruṣākṛtim ..
tataścandanacūrṇena puṣpadhūpādinārcayet ..6.
4.8.d:
पिष्टातकेन विलिखेद्वत्सरं पुरुषाकृतिम् ॥
ततश्चन्दनचूर्णेन पुष्पधूपादिनार्चयेत् ॥6.
4.8.m: should draw the Year in the form of a man with scented flour; / then one should worship it with sandal powder, flowers, incense, and the like.

4.8.s:
dīpaiścāpi sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayedvatsaraṃ tadā ..
māsartunāmabhiḥ paścānnamaskārāṃtayojitaiḥ ..
pūjayedbrāhmaṇānvidvānmaṃtrairvedoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 7 ..
4.8.d:
दीपैश्चापि सनैवेद्यैः पूजयेद्वत्सरं तदा ॥
मासर्तुनामभिः पश्चान्नमस्कारांतयोजितैः ॥
पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्विद्वान्मंत्रैर्वेदोदितैः शुभैः ॥ 7 ॥
4.8.m: With lamps and food-offerings one should then worship the Year. / Afterwards, the learned person should worship brāhmaṇas with the names of the months and seasons ending with "namaḥ", / and with auspicious mantras declared in the Veda:

4.8.s: saṃvatsaro'si parivatsarosīḍā vatsaro'bhitsaro'si uṣasaste kalpaṃtāmahorātrāste kalpaṃtāmardhamāsaste kalpatāṃ māsāste kalpatāmṛtavaste kalpantāṃ saṃvatsaraste kalpatām .. .. 8 ..
4.8.d: संवत्सरोऽसि परिवत्सरोसीडा वत्सरोऽभित्सरोऽसि उषसस्ते कल्पंतामहोरात्रास्ते कल्पंतामर्धमासस्ते कल्पतां मासास्ते कल्पतामृतवस्ते कल्पन्तां संवत्सरस्ते कल्पताम् ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
4.8.m: "You are Saṃvatsara; you are Parivatsara; you are Iḍāvatsara; you are Idvatsara; may the dawns be disposed for you, may the days and nights be disposed for you, may the half-months be disposed for you, may the months be disposed for you, may the seasons be disposed for you, may the Year be disposed for you!"

4.8.s:
evamabhyarcya vāsobhiḥ paścāttamabhiveṣṭayet ..
kālodbhavairmūlaphalainairvedyairmodakādibhiḥ .. 9 ..
4.8.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य वासोभिः पश्चात्तमभिवेष्टयेत् ॥
कालोद्भवैर्मूलफलैनैर्वेद्यैर्मोदकादिभिः ॥ 9 ॥
4.8.m: Having thus worshipped [the Year], one should then wrap it with garments, / with seasonal roots and fruits, and with food offerings such as modakas.

4.8.s:
tatastaṃ prārthayetpaścātpuraḥ sthitvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ..
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena varṣa śubhadamastu me .. 4.8.10 ..
4.8.d:
ततस्तं प्रार्थयेत्पश्चात्पुरः स्थित्वा कृतांजलिः॥
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन वर्ष शुभदमस्तु मे ॥ 4.8.10 ॥
4.8.m: Then, standing before it with joined palms, one should make this request: / 'O Lord, by your grace, may the year bring good fortune to me.'

4.8.s:
evamuktvā yathāśakti dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ..
lalāṭapaṭṭe tilakaṃ kuyaccāṃdanapaṅkajam ..11..
4.8.d:
एवमुक्त्वा यथाशक्ति दद्याद्विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥
ललाटपट्टे तिलकं कुयच्चांदनपङ्कजम् ॥11॥
4.8.m: Having spoken thus, one should give a priestly gift to a brahmin according to one's means, / and make a lotus-mark with sandalpaste on the slab of one's forehead.

4.8.s:
tataḥ prabhṛtyanudinaṃ tilakālaṃkṛtaṃ mukham ..
dhāryaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvacchaśineva nabhastalam .. 12 ..
4.8.d:
ततः प्रभृत्यनुदिनं तिलकालंकृतं मुखम् ॥
धार्यं संवत्सरं यावच्छशिनेव नभस्तलम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.8.m: From then on, day after day, one's face adorned with the sectarian mark / should be borne for an entire year, as the sky [bears] the moon.

4.8.s:
evaṃ naro vā nārī vā vratametatsamācaret ..
sadaiva puruṣa vyāghra bhogānbhuvi bhunaktyasau .. 13 ..
4.8.d:
एवं नरो वा नारी वा व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् ॥
सदैव पुरुष व्याघ्र भोगान्भुवि भुनक्त्यसौ ॥ 13 ॥
4.8.m: If a man or a woman performs this votive observance in this way, / that person always enjoys pleasures on earth, O tiger among men.

4.8.s:
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca durvārā vairiṇo grahāḥ ..
nirarthakā bhavaṃtyete tilakaṃ vīkṣya tatkṣaṇāt .. 14 ..
4.8.d:
भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचाश्च दुर्वारा वैरिणो ग्रहाः ॥
निरर्थका भवंत्येते तिलकं वीक्ष्य तत्क्षणात् ॥ 14 ॥
4.8.m: Ghosts, pretas, and piśācas, unassailable enemies and malignant planets— / these become powerless at once upon beholding the sectarian mark.

4.8.s:
pūrvamāsīnmahīpālo nāmnā śatruṃjayo jayī ..
citralekheti tasyābhūdbhāryā cāritrabhūṣaṇā .. 15 ..
4.8.d:
पूर्वमासीन्महीपालो नाम्ना शत्रुंजयो जयी ॥
चित्रलेखेति तस्याभूद्भार्या चारित्रभूषणा ॥ 15 ॥
4.8.m: Formerly there was a victorious king named Śatruñjaya; / he had a wife named Citralekhā whose ornament was good conduct.

4.8.s:
tayā vratamidaṃ caitre gṛhītaṃ dvijasannidhau ..
saṃvatsaraṃ pūjayitvā dhṛtvā hṛdi janārdanam 16..
4.8.d:
तया व्रतमिदं चैत्रे गृहीतं द्विजसन्निधौ ॥
संवत्सरं पूजयित्वा धृत्वा हृदि जनार्दनम् 16॥
4.8.m: She undertook this votive observance in Caitra in the presence of a brahmin, / worshipping the Year and holding Janārdana in her heart.

4.8.s:
asūyuḥ kṣeptukāmo vā samāgacchati yaḥ puraḥ ..
prayāti priyakṛttasyā dṛṣṭvā mukhamadhomukhaḥ..17..
4.8.d:
असूयुः क्षेप्तुकामो वा समागच्छति यः पुरः ॥
प्रयाति प्रियकृत्तस्या दृष्ट्वा मुखमधोमुखः॥17॥
4.8.m: Whoever, envious or wishing to insult her, approached her presence, / having seen her face, departed with face cast down, acting to her liking.

4.8.s:
sapatnīdarpāpaharā vaśīkṛtamahītalā ..
bharturiṣṭā prahṛṣṭā ca sukhamāste nirākulā ..18..
4.8.d:
सपत्नीदर्पापहरा वशीकृतमहीतला ॥
भर्तुरिष्टा प्रहृष्टा च सुखमास्ते निराकुला ॥18॥
4.8.m: Depriving co-wives of their pride, having brought the earth under her sway, / beloved by her husband and full of joy, she dwelt in peace, untroubled.

4.8.s:
tāvatkareṇābhibhūto bhartā putraḥ savedanaḥ ..
śiro'rtyā nāśaṃ prayātaḥ suhṛdāṃ duḥkhadāyakaḥ ..19..
4.8.d:
तावत्करेणाभिभूतो भर्ता पुत्रः सवेदनः ॥
शिरोऽर्त्या नाशं प्रयातः सुहृदां दुःखदायकः ॥19॥
4.8.m: Meanwhile, the husband and son were seized by an affliction, suffering pain; / through a severe headache, bringing grief to his friends, he went towards death,

4.8.s:
dharmarājapuraṃ prāptuṃ sarvabhūtāpahārakaḥ..
tasminkṣaṇe mahārājaḥ dharmarājasya kiṃkarāḥ..4.8.20..
4.8.d:
धर्मराजपुरं प्राप्तुं सर्वभूतापहारकः॥
तस्मिन्क्षणे महाराजः धर्मराजस्य किंकराः॥4.8.20॥
4.8.m: to reach the city of the King of Dharma, he who carries off all creatures. / At that moment, O great king, the attendants of the King of Dharma,

4.8.s:
tasya dvāramanuprāptāḥ praveṣṭuṃ gṛhamañjasā ..
śatruṃjayaṃ samānetuṃ kālamṛtyupuraḥsarāḥ ..21..
4.8.d:
तस्य द्वारमनुप्राप्ताः प्रवेष्टुं गृहमञ्जसा ॥
शत्रुंजयं समानेतुं कालमृत्युपुरःसराः ॥21॥
4.8.m: reached his door to enter the house quickly, / preceded by Kāla and Mṛtyu, to take Śatruñjaya away.

4.8.s:
pārśvasthitāṃ citralekhāṃ tilakālaṃkṛtānanām ..
dṛṣṭvā pranaṣṭasaṃkalpāḥ parāvṛtya gatāḥ punaḥ..22..
4.8.d:
पार्श्वस्थितां चित्रलेखां तिलकालंकृताननाम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा प्रनष्टसंकल्पाः परावृत्य गताः पुनः॥22॥
4.8.m: Seeing Citralekhā standing beside him, her face adorned with the sectarian mark, / their intentions vanished, and they turned back and departed.

4.8.s:
gateṣu teṣu sa nṛpaḥ putreṇa saha bhārata ..
nīrujo bubhuje bhogānpūrvakarmārjitāñchubhān .. 23 ..
4.8.d:
गतेषु तेषु स नृपः पुत्रेण सह भारत ॥
नीरुजो बुभुजे भोगान्पूर्वकर्मार्जिताञ्छुभान् ॥ 23 ॥
4.8.m: When they had gone, that king, together with his son, O Bhārata, / became free from disease and enjoyed auspicious pleasures earned by past deeds.

4.8.s:
etadvrataṃ mahābhāga kīrtitaṃ te mahodayam ..
śaṃkareṇa samākhyātaṃ mama pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..24..
4.8.d:
एतद्व्रतं महाभाग कीर्तितं ते महोदयम् ॥
शंकरेण समाख्यातं मम पूर्वं युधिष्ठिर ॥24॥
4.8.m: This votive observance, O illustrious one, conferring great prosperity, has been related to you; / it was previously declared to me by Śaṅkara, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.8.s:
etattrilokatilakālakabhūṣaṇaṃ te khyātaṃ vrataṃ sakaladuḥkhaharaṃ paraṃ ca ..
itthaṃ samācarati yaḥ sa sukhaṃ vihṛtya martyaḥ prayāti padamāpadi padmayoneḥ .. 25 ..
aśokavratavarṇanam
4.8.d:
एतत्त्रिलोकतिलकालकभूषणं ते ख्यातं व्रतं सकलदुःखहरं परं च ॥
इत्थं समाचरति यः स सुखं विहृत्य मर्त्यः प्रयाति पदमापदि पद्मयोनेः ॥ 25 ॥
अशोकव्रतवर्णनम्
4.8.m:
This supreme votive observance, an ornament for the forelocks of the three worlds and removing all sorrow, has been proclaimed to you; / the mortal who performs it in this way, having enjoyed pleasure, goes in times of peril to the abode of the Lotus-Born [Brahmā].
Description of the Aśokavrata

4.9.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āśvayucchuklapakṣasya prathame'hni dinodaye ..
aśokaṃ pūjayedvṛkṣaṃ prarūḍhaśubhapallavam .. 1 ..
4.9.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आश्वयुच्छुक्लपक्षस्य प्रथमेऽह्नि दिनोदये ॥
अशोकं पूजयेद्वृक्षं प्ररूढशुभपल्लवम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.9.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / On the first day of the bright fortnight of Āśvayuja, at daybreak, / one should worship the aśoka tree whose auspicious sprouts have burgeoned,

4.9.s:
virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca guṇa kairmodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
phalaiḥ kālodbhavairdivyairnnālikeraiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ .. 2 ..
4.9.d:
विरूढैः सप्तधान्यैश्च गुण कैर्मोदकैः शुभैः ॥
फलैः कालोद्भवैर्दिव्यैर्न्नालिकेरैः सदाडिमैः ॥ 2 ॥
4.9.m: with sprouted seven grains, with auspicious guṇaka sweets and modakas, / with divine seasonal fruits, with coconuts and pomegranates,

4.9.s:
puṣpadhūpādinā tadvatpūjayettaddine'nagha ..
aśokaṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha śokaṃ nāpnoti kutracit .. 3 ..
4.9.d:
पुष्पधूपादिना तद्वत्पूजयेत्तद्दिनेऽनघ ॥
अशोकं पांडवश्रेष्ठ शोकं नाप्नोति कुत्रचित् ॥ 3 ॥
4.9.m: and likewise with flowers, incense, and the like, one should worship it on that day, O sinless one. / [Then] one never incurs grief (śoka) anywhere, O best of the Pāṇḍavas.

4.9.s:
pitṛbhrātṛpatiśvaśrūśvaśurāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ..
aśoka śokaśamano bhava sarvatra naḥ kule .. 4 ..
4.9.d:
पितृभ्रातृपतिश्वश्रूश्वशुराणां तथैव च ॥
अशोक शोकशमनो भव सर्वत्र नः कुले ॥ 4 ॥
4.9.m: 'For fathers, brothers, husbands, mothers-in-law, and fathers-in-law as well, / O aśoka, be the dispeller of grief (śoka) everywhere in our family.'

4.9.s:
ityuccārya tato dadyādarghyaṃ śraddhāsamanvi tam ..
patākābhiralaṃkṛtya pracchādya śubhavāsasā .. 5 ..
4.9.d:
इत्युच्चार्य ततो दद्यादर्घ्यं श्रद्धासमन्वि तम् ॥
पताकाभिरलंकृत्य प्रच्छाद्य शुभवाससा ॥ 5 ॥
4.9.m: Having uttered this, endowed with faith, one should then offer the arghya, / having adorned [the tree] with banners and covered it with an auspicious garment.

4.9.s:
damayantī yathā svāhā yathā vedavatī satī ..
tathāśokavratādasmājjāyate pativallabhā .. .. 6 ..
4.9.d:
दमयन्ती यथा स्वाहा यथा वेदवती सती ॥
तथाशोकव्रतादस्माज्जायते पतिवल्लभा ॥ ॥ 6 ॥
4.9.m: Just as Damayantī, just as Svāhā, just as the chaste Vedavatī, / so by this votive observance of the aśoka one becomes beloved of one's husband.

4.9.s:
vane vrajaṃtyā saddharmaḥ sītayā saṃpradarśitaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā'śokaṃ vane pārtha pallavālaṃkṛtāṃbaram .. 7 ..
4.9.d:
वने व्रजंत्या सद्धर्मः सीतया संप्रदर्शितः ॥
दृष्ट्वाऽशोकं वने पार्थ पल्लवालंकृतांबरम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.9.m: The true dharma was demonstrated by Sītā as she was journeying in the forest, / having seen an aśoka in the forest, O Pārtha, whose foliage adorned the sky.

4.9.s:
kṛtvā samīpe bhartāraṃ devaraṃ ca tilākṣataiḥ ..
dīpālaṃkṛtanaivedyadhūpasūtraphalārccanaiḥ .. 8 ..
4.9.d:
कृत्वा समीपे भर्तारं देवरं च तिलाक्षतैः ॥
दीपालंकृतनैवेद्यधूपसूत्रफलार्च्चनैः ॥ 8 ॥
4.9.m: Having seated her husband and brother-in-law near her, with sesame and unbroken grains, / with worship comprising lamps, adorned food offerings, incense, sacred threads, and fruits,

4.9.s:
arcayitvā hyarthito'sau raktāśoko yudhiṣṭhira ..
maithilyā prāñjalirbhūtvā śṛṇvato rāghavasya ca .. 9 ..
4.9.d:
अर्चयित्वा ह्यर्थितोऽसौ रक्ताशोको युधिष्ठिर ॥
मैथिल्या प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा शृण्वतो राघवस्य च ॥ 9 ॥
4.9.m: having worshipped it, that red aśoka was indeed entreated, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / by the princess of Mithilā with joined palms, while Rāghava listened:

4.9.s:
ciraṃ jīvatu me vṛddhaḥ śvaśuraḥ kośaleśvaraḥ ..
bhartā me devarāścaiva jīvaṃtu bharatādayaḥ ..
kauśalyāmapi jīvantīṃ paśyeyamiti maithilī .. 4.9.10 ..
4.9.d:
चिरं जीवतु मे वृद्धः श्वशुरः कोशलेश्वरः ॥
भर्ता मे देवराश्चैव जीवंतु भरतादयः ॥
कौशल्यामपि जीवन्तीं पश्येयमिति मैथिली ॥ 4.9.10 ॥
4.9.m: 'May my elderly father-in-law, the lord of Kośala, live long; / may my husband and brothers-in-law, Bharata and the others, live long; / and may I also see Kauśalyā living'—thus the princess of Mithilā

4.9.s:
yayāce taṃ mahābhāgā drumaṃ satyopayācanam ..
pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya tataste prayayuḥ punaḥ .. 11 ..
4.9.d:
ययाचे तं महाभागा द्रुमं सत्योपयाचनम् ॥
प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य ततस्ते प्रययुः पुनः ॥ 11 ॥
4.9.m: implored that tree, an granter of true petitions, O illustrious one. / Having performed circumambulation, they then set forth again.

4.9.s:
evamanyāpi yā nārī pūjayedbhuvi taṃ nagam ..
tila taṃḍulasaṃmiśrairyavagodhūmasarṣapaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.9.d:
एवमन्यापि या नारी पूजयेद्भुवि तं नगम् ॥
तिल तंडुलसंमिश्रैर्यवगोधूमसर्षपैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.9.m: In the same manner, any other woman on earth who worships that tree / with barley, wheat, and mustard mixed with sesame and husked grains,

4.9.s:
kṣamāpya vandayenmūlaṃ pādapaṃ raktapallavam ..
mantreṇānena kauṃteya praṇamya strī pativratā .. 13 ..
4.9.d:
क्षमाप्य वन्दयेन्मूलं पादपं रक्तपल्लवम् ॥
मन्त्रेणानेन कौंतेय प्रणम्य स्त्री पतिव्रता ॥ 13 ॥
4.9.m: having asked for pardon, should bow to the root of the tree with red sprouts; / bowing down with this mantra, O son of Kuntī, the devoted wife [says]:

4.9.s:
mahāvṛkṣa mahāśākha makaradhvajamandira ..
prārthaye tvāṃ mahābhāga vanopavanabhūṣaṇa .. 14 ..
4.9.d:
महावृक्ष महाशाख मकरध्वजमन्दिर ॥
प्रार्थये त्वां महाभाग वनोपवनभूषण ॥ 14 ॥
4.9.m: 'O great tree, of great branches, abode of the god of love, / I make my prayer to you, O illustrious one, ornament of forests and groves.'

4.9.s:
evamābhāṣya taṃ vṛkṣaṃ dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ..
sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī tataḥ svabhavanaṃ vrajet .. 15 ..
4.9.d:
एवमाभाष्य तं वृक्षं दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥
सखीभिः सहिता साध्वी ततः स्वभवनं व्रजेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.9.m: Having addressed the tree in this way and given a priestly gift to a brahmin, / the virtuous woman, accompanied by her female companions, should then go to her own home.

4.9.s:
yāḥ śokanāśanamaśokataruṃ taruṇyaḥ saṃpūjayaṃti kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ ..
tāḥ prāpya saukhyamatulaṃ bhuvi bhartṛ jātaṃ gaurīpadaṃ pramuditāḥ punarāpnuvaṃti .. 16 ..
karavīravratavarṇanam
4.9.d:
याः शोकनाशनमशोकतरुं तरुण्यः संपूजयंति कुसुमाक्षतधूपदीपैः ॥
ताः प्राप्य सौख्यमतुलं भुवि भर्तृ जातं गौरीपदं प्रमुदिताः पुनराप्नुवंति ॥ 16 ॥
करवीरव्रतवर्णनम्
4.9.m:
Those young women who revere the aśoka tree, the destroyer of grief, with flowers, unbroken rice, incense, and lamps, / having obtained peerless happiness born of a husband on earth, attain, full of joy, the realm of Gaurī hereafter.
Description of the Karavīravrata

4.10.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe prathame'hni dinodaye ..
devodyānabhavaṃ hṛdyaṃ karavīraṃ samarcayeta ..1..
4.10.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्षे प्रथमेऽह्नि दिनोदये ॥
देवोद्यानभवं हृद्यं करवीरं समर्चयेत ॥1॥
4.10.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In the month of Jyeṣṭha, in the bright fortnight, on the first day at sunrise, / one should worship the delightful karavīra tree growing in the garden of the gods,
draping it with red threads, with perfumed incense and ointments, / with sprouted seven grains, and with oranges and citrons,
with divine guṇakas and ghaṭakas, and with beautiful coconuts; / having sprinkled it with water and unbroken grains, one should ask for pardon with this mantra:

4.10.s:
karavīra viṣāvāsa namaste bhānuvallabha ..
maulimaṃḍanasadratna namaste keśaveśayoḥ .. 4 ..
4.10.d:
करवीर विषावास नमस्ते भानुवल्लभ ॥
मौलिमंडनसद्रत्न नमस्ते केशवेशयोः ॥ 4 ॥
4.10.m: 'O karavīra, abode of poison, homage to you, beloved of the Sun; / O noble jewel adorning the crowns of Keśava and Īśa, homage to you.'

4.10.s:
ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca ..
hiraṇyayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan .. 5 ..
4.10.d:
आकृष्णेन रजसा वर्तमानो निवेशयन्नमृतं मर्त्यं च ॥
हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेनादेवो याति भुवनानि पश्यन् ॥ 5 ॥
4.10.m: 'Rolling through the dark realm of space, establishing the immortal and the mortal, / the divine Savitṛ travels in his golden chariot, surveying the worlds.'

4.10.s:
evaṃ bhaktyā samabhyarcya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ..
pradakṣiṇāmatho kṛtvā tataḥ svabhavanaṃ vrajet .. 6 ..
4.10.d:
एवं भक्त्या समभ्यर्च्य दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥
प्रदक्षिणामथो कृत्वा ततः स्वभवनं व्रजेत् ॥ 6 ॥
4.10.m: Having thus worshipped with devotion and given a priestly gift to a brahmin, / and having then performed circumambulation, one should go to one's own home.

4.10.s:
etadvrataṃ mahābhāga sūryārādhanakāmyayā ..
anasūyayā ca kṣamayā sāvitryā satyabhāmayā .. 7 ..
4.10.d:
एतद्व्रतं महाभाग सूर्याराधनकाम्यया ॥
अनसूयया च क्षमया सावित्र्या सत्यभामया ॥ 7 ॥
4.10.m: This votive observance, O illustrious one, wishing to propitiate the Sun, / [was performed] by Anasūyā, Kṣamā, Sāvitrī, and Satyabhāmā.

4.10.s:
damayantyā sarasvatyā gāyatryā gaṃgayā tathā ..
anyābhirapi nārībhirmartyaloke'pyanuṣṭhitam ..
karavīvrataṃ pārtha sarvasaukhyaphalapradam .. 8 ..
4.10.d:
दमयन्त्या सरस्वत्या गायत्र्या गंगया तथा ॥
अन्याभिरपि नारीभिर्मर्त्यलोकेऽप्यनुष्ठितम् ॥
करवीव्रतं पार्थ सर्वसौख्यफलप्रदम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.10.m: By Damayantī, Sarasvatī, Gāyatrī, and Gaṅgā, / as well as by other women even in the mortal world, / this karavīra votive observance, O son of Pṛthā, which grants the fruit of all happiness, has been observed.

4.10.s:
saṃpūjya ratnakusumāṃcitasarvaśākhaṃ nīlairdalaistatatanuṃ karavīravṛkṣam ..
bhuktvā mano'bhilaṣitānbhuvi bhavyabhogānaṃte prayāti bhavanaṃ bharatāgrya bhānoḥ.. .. 9 ..
kokilāvratavarṇanam
[[File:rakṣābandhana Rakshabandhan.jpg|thumb|rakṣābandhanam]]
4.10.d:
संपूज्य रत्नकुसुमांचितसर्वशाखं नीलैर्दलैस्तततनुं करवीरवृक्षम् ॥
भुक्त्वा मनोऽभिलषितान्भुवि भव्यभोगानंते प्रयाति भवनं भरताग्र्य भानोः॥ ॥ 9 ॥
कोकिलाव्रतवर्णनम्
[[Fइले:रक्षाबन्धन रक्स्हबन्धन्।ज्प्ग्।थुम्ब्।रक्षाबन्धनम्]]
4.10.m:
Having worshipped the karavīra tree whose branches are adorned with jewel-like blossoms and whose body is covered with dark leaves, / and having enjoyed pleasing and splendid pleasures on earth, one goes at the end, O best of the Bharatas, to the abode of the Sun.
Description of the Kokilā Votive Observance

4.11.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
svabhartrā saha saṃbaddhamahāsneho yathā bhavet ..
kulastrīṇāṃ tadācakṣva vrataṃ mama surottama .. 1 ..
4.11.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
स्वभर्त्रा सह संबद्धमहास्नेहो यथा भवेत् ॥
कुलस्त्रीणां तदाचक्ष्व व्रतं मम सुरोत्तम ॥ 1 ॥
4.11.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me, O best of gods, that votive observance for noble women / by which great love connected with one's husband may come to be.

4.11.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yamunāyāstaṭe pūrvaṃ mathurāste purī śubhā ..
tasyāṃ śatrughnanāmnābhūdrājā rāmapratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 2 ..
4.11.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
यमुनायास्तटे पूर्वं मथुरास्ते पुरी शुभा ॥
तस्यां शत्रुघ्ननाम्नाभूद्राजा रामप्रतिष्ठितः ॥ 2 ॥
4.11.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In former times, on the bank of the Yamunā, there was an auspicious city named Mathurā. / In it was a king named Śatrughna, established by Rāma.

4.11.s:
tasya bhāryā kīrtimālā nāmnāsītprathitā bhuvi ..
tayā praṇamya bhagavānvaśiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ .. 3 ..
4.11.d:
तस्य भार्या कीर्तिमाला नाम्नासीत्प्रथिता भुवि ॥
तया प्रणम्य भगवान्वशिष्ठो मुनिपुंगवः ॥ 3 ॥
4.11.m: His wife was named Kīrtimālā, renowned on earth. / Having bowed to the venerable Vaśiṣṭha, the foremost of sages, / she asked:

4.11.s:
pṛṣṭaḥ sukhaṃ muniśreṣṭha kathaṃ samupajāyate ..
brūhi me tilasambandhakāraṇaṃ vratamuttamam .. 4 ..
4.11.d:
पृष्टः सुखं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कथं समुपजायते ॥
ब्रूहि मे तिलसम्बन्धकारणं व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.11.m: "O best of sages, how does happiness arise? / Tell me the supreme votive observance that brings about connection through sesame."

4.11.s:
evamuktastayā jñānī vaśiṣṭhaḥ kīrtimālayā ..
dhyātvā muhūrtamācakhyau kokilāvratamuttamam .. 5 ..
4.11.d:
एवमुक्तस्तया ज्ञानी वशिष्ठः कीर्तिमालया ॥
ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तमाचख्यौ कोकिलाव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.11.m: Thus addressed by Kīrtimālā, the wise Vaśiṣṭha / meditated for a moment and expounded the supreme Kokilā votive observance.

4.11.s:
.. śrīvaśiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
āṣāḍhapūrṇimāyāṃ tu saṃdhyākāle hyupasthite ..
saṃkalpayenmāsamekaṃ śrāvaṇe śvaḥprabhṛtyaham .. 6 ..
4.11.d:
॥ श्रीवशिष्ठ उवाच ॥ ॥
आषाढपूर्णिमायां तु संध्याकाले ह्युपस्थिते ॥
संकल्पयेन्मासमेकं श्रावणे श्वःप्रभृत्यहम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.11.m: Śrī Vaśiṣṭha said: / On the full moon day of Āṣāḍha, when twilight has arrived, / one should make the formal resolution: 'From tomorrow, in Śrāvaṇa, for one month, I,

4.11.s:
snānaṃ kariṣye niyatā brahmacaryasthitā satī ..
bhokṣyāmi naktaṃ bhūśayyāṃ kariṣye prāṇināṃ dayām .. 7 ..
4.11.d:
स्नानं करिष्ये नियता ब्रह्मचर्यस्थिता सती ॥
भोक्ष्यामि नक्तं भूशय्यां करिष्ये प्राणिनां दयाम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.11.m: restrained and abiding in celibacy as a chaste wife, will bathe, / eat a nocturnal meal, sleep on the ground, and practice compassion toward living beings.'

4.11.s:
iti saṃkalpya puruṣo nārī vā brāhmaṇāṃtike ..
prāpyānujñāṃ tataḥ prātaḥ sarvasāmagrisaṃyutaḥ .. 8 ..
4.11.d:
इति संकल्प्य पुरुषो नारी वा ब्राह्मणांतिके ॥
प्राप्यानुज्ञां ततः प्रातः सर्वसामग्रिसंयुतः ॥ 8 ॥
4.11.m: Having thus made the formal resolution in the presence of a brāhmaṇa, whether a man or a woman, / and having received his permission, then in the morning, equipped with all necessary materials,

4.11.s:
puruṣaḥ pratipatkālāddantadhāvanapūrvakam ..
nadyāṃ gatvā tathā vāpyāṃ taḍāge girinirjhare .. 9 ..
4.11.d:
पुरुषः प्रतिपत्कालाद्दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् ॥
नद्यां गत्वा तथा वाप्यां तडागे गिरिनिर्झरे ॥ 9 ॥
4.11.m: the person, beginning from the first lunar day, after first cleaning the teeth, / having gone to a river, a stepwell, a pond, or a mountain torrent,

4.11.s:
snānaṃ kuryādvratī pārtha sugandhāmalakaistilaiḥ ..
dināṣṭakaṃ tathā paścātsarvauṣadhyā punaḥ pṛthak .. 4.11.10 ..
4.11.d:
स्नानं कुर्याद्व्रती पार्थ सुगन्धामलकैस्तिलैः ॥
दिनाष्टकं तथा पश्चात्सर्वौषध्या पुनः पृथक् ॥ 4.11.10 ॥
4.11.m: the practitioner of the votive observance, O son of Pṛthā, should bathe with fragrant āmalaka and sesame / for eight days; then, subsequently, with all-herbs separately;

4.11.s:
vacayāṣṭau punaḥ piṣṭvā śiroruhavimardanam ..
snātvā dhyātvā raviṃ caiva vaṃditvā ca pitṝnatha .. 11 ..
4.11.d:
वचयाष्टौ पुनः पिष्ट्वा शिरोरुहविमर्दनम् ॥
स्नात्वा ध्यात्वा रविं चैव वंदित्वा च पितॄनथ ॥ 11 ॥
4.11.m: again for eight days, having ground vacā, rubbing it into the hair; / having bathed, meditated on the Sun, and revered the ancestors;

4.11.s:
tarpayitvā tilāpiṣṭaiḥ kokilāṃ pakṣirūpiṇīm ..
kalakaṇṭhīṃ śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayeccaṃpakodbhavaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.11.d:
तर्पयित्वा तिलापिष्टैः कोकिलां पक्षिरूपिणीम् ॥
कलकण्ठीं शुभैः पुष्पैः पूजयेच्चंपकोद्भवैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.11.m: and having made libations with sesame flour, one should worship the cuckoo in the form of a bird, / sweet-throated, with auspicious campaka flowers,

4.11.s:
patrairvā dhūpanaivedyadīpālaktakacaṃdanaiḥ ..
tila tanduladūrvāgraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet ..
nityaṃ tilavratī bhakto maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava .. 13 ..
4.11.d:
पत्रैर्वा धूपनैवेद्यदीपालक्तकचंदनैः ॥
तिल तन्दुलदूर्वाग्रैः पूजयित्वा क्षमापयेत् ॥
नित्यं तिलव्रती भक्तो मंत्रेणानेन पांडव ॥ 13 ॥
4.11.m: or with leaves, incense, food offerings, lamps, red lac, and sandal, / and with sesame, rice grains, and dūrvā tips; and, asking for forgiveness, / the devoted practitioner of the sesame votive observance should worship daily with this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu:

4.11.s:
tilasahe tilasaukhye tilavarṇe tilapriye ..
saubhāgyaṃ dravyaputrāṃśca dehi me kokile namaḥ .. 14 ..
4.11.d:
तिलसहे तिलसौख्ये तिलवर्णे तिलप्रिये ॥
सौभाग्यं द्रव्यपुत्रांश्च देहि मे कोकिले नमः ॥ 14 ॥
4.11.m: "O you who endure sesame, who find joy in sesame, who have the colour of sesame, who love sesame! / Grant me good fortune, wealth, and sons. Homage to you, O cuckoo!"

4.11.s:
ityuccārya tataḥ paścādgṛhamabhyetya saṃyataḥ ..
kṛtvāhāraṃ svapetpārtha yāvanmāsaḥ samāpnute ..15..
4.11.d:
इत्युच्चार्य ततः पश्चाद्गृहमभ्येत्य संयतः ॥
कृत्वाहारं स्वपेत्पार्थ यावन्मासः समाप्नुते ॥15॥
4.11.m: Having uttered this, then afterwards returning home with self-restraint, / having taken food, one should sleep, O son of Pṛthā, until the month is complete.

4.11.s:
māsāṃte tāmrapātryāṃ tu kokilāṃ tilapiṣṭajām ..
ratnanetrāṃ svarṇapakṣāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet.. 16 ..
4.11.d:
मासांते ताम्रपात्र्यां तु कोकिलां तिलपिष्टजाम् ॥
रत्ननेत्रां स्वर्णपक्षां ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत्॥ 16 ॥
4.11.m: At the end of the month, one should present to a brāhmaṇa on a copper plate / a cuckoo made of sesame paste, with jewel eyes and golden wings,

4.11.s:
vastrairddhanairguḍairyuktāṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ kuṃḍale'tha vā ..
śvaśrūśvaśuravarge vā daivajñe vā purohite ..
vyāse vā saṃpradātavyā vratibhiḥ śubhakāmyayā ..17..
4.11.d:
वस्त्रैर्द्धनैर्गुडैर्युक्तां श्रावण्यां कुंडलेऽथ वा ॥
श्वश्रूश्वशुरवर्गे वा दैवज्ञे वा पुरोहिते ॥
व्यासे वा संप्रदातव्या व्रतिभिः शुभकाम्यया ॥17॥
4.11.m: provided with garments, wealth, and jaggery, or earrings, on the full moon of Śrāvaṇa; / or it should be given by practitioners of the votive observance desiring welfare / to mothers-in-law and fathers-in-law, or an astrologer, or the family priest, or a reciter of the Purāṇas.

4.11.s:
evaṃ yā kurute nārī kokilāvratamādarāt ..
sapta janmāni saubhāgyaṃ sā prāpnoti suvistaram .. 18 ..
4.11.d:
एवं या कुरुते नारी कोकिलाव्रतमादरात् ॥
सप्त जन्मानि सौभाग्यं सा प्राप्नोति सुविस्तरम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.11.m: Whatever woman performs the Kokilā votive observance in this manner with reverence / attains extensive good fortune for seven births.

4.11.s:
niḥsāpatnyaṃ patiṃ bhavyaṃ sasnehaṃ prāpya bhūtale ..
mṛtā gaurīpuraṃ yāti vimānenārkavarcasā .. 19 ..
4.11.d:
निःसापत्न्यं पतिं भव्यं सस्नेहं प्राप्य भूतले ॥
मृता गौरीपुरं याति विमानेनार्कवर्चसा ॥ 19 ॥
4.11.m: Having obtained on earth a splendid, affectionate husband free from rival wives, / upon dying she goes to the city of Gaurī in a celestial chariot shining like the sun.

4.11.s:
etadvrataṃ vaśiṣṭhena muninā kathitaṃ purā ..
tathā cānuṣṭhitaṃ pārtha samastaṃ kīrtimālayā .. 4.11.20 ..
4.11.d:
एतद्व्रतं वशिष्ठेन मुनिना कथितं पुरा ॥
तथा चानुष्ठितं पार्थ समस्तं कीर्तिमालया ॥ 4.11.20 ॥
4.11.m: This votive observance was spoken of old by the sage Vaśiṣṭha, / and was performed entirely, O son of Pṛthā, by Kīrtimālā.

4.11.s:
tasyāśca sarvaṃ saṃpannaṃ vaśiṣṭhavacanādiha ..
putrasaubhāgyasaṃmānaṃ śatrughnasya prasādajam.. 21 ..
4.11.d:
तस्याश्च सर्वं संपन्नं वशिष्ठवचनादिह ॥
पुत्रसौभाग्यसंमानं शत्रुघ्नस्य प्रसादजम्॥ 21 ॥
4.11.m: And everything was accomplished for her in this world from the words of Vaśiṣṭha: / sons, good fortune, and honour, born of the grace of Śatrughna.

4.11.s:
evaṃ yānyāpi kauṃteya kokilāvratamādarāt ..
kariṣyati dhruvaṃ tasyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ..22..
4.11.d:
एवं यान्यापि कौंतेय कोकिलाव्रतमादरात् ॥
करिष्यति ध्रुवं तस्याः सौभाग्यं च भविष्यति ॥22॥
4.11.m: Likewise, whatever other woman, O son of Kuntī, performs / the Kokilā votive observance with reverence, good fortune shall certainly be hers.

4.11.s:
ye kokilāṃ kalaravāṃ kalakaṃṭhapīṭhāṃ yacchaṃti sājyatilapiṣṭamayīṃ dvijebhyaḥ ..
te naṃdanādiṣu vaneṣu vihṛtya kāmaṃ martye sametya madhuradhvanayo bhavaṃti .. 23 .. ..
bṛhattapovratavarṇanam
4.11.d:
ये कोकिलां कलरवां कलकंठपीठां यच्छंति साज्यतिलपिष्टमयीं द्विजेभ्यः ॥
ते नंदनादिषु वनेषु विहृत्य कामं मर्त्ये समेत्य मधुरध्वनयो भवंति ॥ 23 ॥ ॥
बृहत्तपोव्रतवर्णनम्
4.11.m:
Those who give to the twice-born a cuckoo with sweet notes and an alluring throat, / made of sesame paste mixed with ghee, / sport at will in the Nandana and other celestial groves, and coming to the mortal world, they become possessed of sweet voices.
Description of the Great Austerity Votive Observance

4.12.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
atha pāpāpahaṃ vakṣye bṛhadvratamanuttamam ..
surāsuramunīnāṃ ca durllabhaṃ vidhinā śṛṇu ..1..
4.12.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच॥ ॥
अथ पापापहं वक्ष्ये बृहद्व्रतमनुत्तमम् ॥
सुरासुरमुनीनां च दुर्ल्लभं विधिना शृणु ॥1॥
4.12.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now I shall declare the great, unsurpassed votive observance that removes sin, / difficult to obtain even for gods, asuras, and sages; listen to it with its rules.

4.12.s:
parvaṇyāśvayujasyāṃte pāyasaṃ ghṛta saṃyutam ..
naktaṃ bhuñjīta śuddhātmā odanaṃ vaikṣavānvitam .. 2 ..
4.12.d:
पर्वण्याश्वयुजस्यांते पायसं घृत संयुतम् ॥
नक्तं भुञ्जीत शुद्धात्मा ओदनं वैक्षवान्वितम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.12.m: At the full moon at the end of Āśvayuja, with a pure mind, / one should eat as a nocturnal meal milk rice accompanied by ghee, or boiled rice mixed with sugarcane juice.

4.12.s:
ācamyātha śucirbhūtvā bilvajaṃ daṃtadhāvanam ..
bhakṣayitvā mahādevaṃ praṇamyedamudīrayet .. 3 ..
4.12.d:
आचम्याथ शुचिर्भूत्वा बिल्वजं दंतधावनम् ॥
भक्षयित्वा महादेवं प्रणम्येदमुदीरयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
4.12.m: Then, having sipped water and become pure, having chewed / a tooth-cleaning twig born of the bilva tree, and having bowed to Mahādeva, one should declare this:

4.12.s:
ahaṃ devavratamidaṃ kartumicchāmi śāśvatam ..
tavājñayā mahādeva yathā nirvahate kuru ..4..
4.12.d:
अहं देवव्रतमिदं कर्तुमिच्छामि शाश्वतम् ॥
तवाज्ञया महादेव यथा निर्वहते कुरु ॥4॥
4.12.m: "I desire to perform this eternal votive observance of the god. / By your command, O Mahādeva, act so that it is carried out successfully."

4.12.s:
ityevaṃ niyamaṃ kṛtvā yāvadvarṣāṇi ṣoḍaśa ..
tithayaḥ pratipatpūrvāṃ bhajiṣyāmītyanukramāt .. 5 ..
4.12.d:
इत्येवं नियमं कृत्वा यावद्वर्षाणि षोडश ॥
तिथयः प्रतिपत्पूर्वां भजिष्यामीत्यनुक्रमात् ॥ 5 ॥
4.12.m: Having thus made a restriction: 'For sixteen years / I will attend upon the lunar days in succession, beginning with the first lunar day;'

4.12.s:
tato mārgaśire māsi pratipadyapare'hani ..
pṛṣṭvā guruṃ copavāsaṃ mahādevaṃ smaranmuhuḥ .. 6 ..
4.12.d:
ततो मार्गशिरे मासि प्रतिपद्यपरेऽहनि ॥
पृष्ट्वा गुरुं चोपवासं महादेवं स्मरन्मुहुः ॥ 6 ॥
4.12.m: then, in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the first lunar day of the other fortnight, / having asked the guru about the fast, remembering Mahādeva repeatedly,

4.12.s:
snātvā devaṃ samabhyarcya rātrau prajvālya dīpakān ..
yamunāṃ ca mahādevaṃ natvā paścānnimaṃtrayet .. 7 ..
4.12.d:
स्नात्वा देवं समभ्यर्च्य रात्रौ प्रज्वाल्य दीपकान् ॥
यमुनां च महादेवं नत्वा पश्चान्निमंत्रयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
4.12.m: having bathed, worshipped the god, and kindled lamps at night, / and having bowed to the Yamunā and Mahādeva, one should then invite

4.12.s:
mahādevaratānviprānsapatnīkānyatavratān ..
ṣoḍaśāṣṭau tadardhaṃ vā ekaṃ vā śaktyapekṣayā .. 8 ..
4.12.d:
महादेवरतान्विप्रान्सपत्नीकान्यतव्रतान् ॥
षोडशाष्टौ तदर्धं वा एकं वा शक्त्यपेक्षया ॥ 8 ॥
4.12.m: brāhmaṇas devoted to Mahādeva, accompanied by their wives and firm in their vows, / sixteen, eight, or half of that, or one, according to one's capacity.

4.12.s:
āmaṃtrya svagṛhaṃ gatvā mahādevaṃ smarankṣitau ..
śucivastrāstṛtāyāṃ tu nirāhāro niśi svapeta .. 9 ..
4.12.d:
आमंत्र्य स्वगृहं गत्वा महादेवं स्मरन्क्षितौ ॥
शुचिवस्त्रास्तृतायां तु निराहारो निशि स्वपेत ॥ 9 ॥
4.12.m: Having invited them and gone to one's house, remembering Mahādeva, / one should sleep at night without food on the ground spread with a clean cloth.

4.12.s:
bhāskarodayamāsādya snātvā cādāya dīpakān ..
naivedyaṃ snapanaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ gaccheṣchivālaye ..4.12.10..
4.12.d:
भास्करोदयमासाद्य स्नात्वा चादाय दीपकान् ॥
नैवेद्यं स्नपनं पुष्पं धूपं गच्छेष्छिवालये ॥4.12.10॥
4.12.m: When the sun rises, having bathed and taken lamps, / a food offering, ablution water, flowers, and incense, one should go to a temple of Śiva.

4.12.s:
abhyaṃgayitvā deveśaṃ kaṣāyaiśca virūkṣayet ..
snapayetpañcagavyena payasā tadanaṃtaram .. 11 ..
4.12.d:
अभ्यंगयित्वा देवेशं कषायैश्च विरूक्षयेत् ॥
स्नपयेत्पञ्चगव्येन पयसा तदनंतरम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.12.m: Having anointed the lord of gods with oil, one should dry him with astringents; / one should bathe him with pañcagavya, and immediately afterwards with milk;

4.12.s:
ghṛtena madhunā dadhnā rasena payasā punaḥ ..
tilāṃbunā tataḥ snāpya snāpayeduṣṇavā riṇā .. 12 ..
4.12.d:
घृतेन मधुना दध्ना रसेन पयसा पुनः ॥
तिलांबुना ततः स्नाप्य स्नापयेदुष्णवा रिणा ॥ 12 ॥
4.12.m: with ghee, honey, curd, sugarcane juice, and again with milk; / then, having bathed him with sesame water, one should bathe him with warm water.

4.12.s:
lepayetsughanaṃ paścātkarpūrāgarucaṃdanaiḥ ..
puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya dātavyaṃ haimaṃ śirasi paṃkajam .. 13 ..
4.12.d:
लेपयेत्सुघनं पश्चात्कर्पूरागरुचंदनैः ॥
पुष्पैः संपूज्य दातव्यं हैमं शिरसि पंकजम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.12.m: Afterwards, one should thickly smear [the deity] with camphor, agallochum, and sandalwood paste. / Having worshipped with flowers, a golden lotus should be placed upon the head.

4.12.s:
vastrayugmaṃ patākāṃ ca pañcavarṇaṃ vitānakam..
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca ghaṃṭāñca dadyāddevasya śaktitaḥ ..14..
4.12.d:
वस्त्रयुग्मं पताकां च पञ्चवर्णं वितानकम्॥
धूपं दीपं च घंटाञ्च दद्याद्देवस्य शक्तितः ॥14॥
4.12.m: A pair of garments, a banner, and a five-coloured canopy, / incense, a lamp, and a bell, one should present to the god according to one's capacity.

4.12.s:
paścānnivedya naivedyaṃ stutvā svabhavanaṃ vrajet..
susamiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjayejjātavedasam ..15..
4.12.d:
पश्चान्निवेद्य नैवेद्यं स्तुत्वा स्वभवनं व्रजेत्॥
सुसमिद्धं ततः कृत्वा पूजयेज्जातवेदसम् ॥15॥
4.12.m: Then, having offered food-offerings and chanted praises, he should go to his own abode. / Having then made [the sacred fire] well-kindled, he should worship Jātavedas.

4.12.s:
vratinaśca tathācāryaṃ bhojayenmithunāni ca ..
hemavastrādidānena yathāśakti kṣamāpayet .. 16 ..
4.12.d:
व्रतिनश्च तथाचार्यं भोजयेन्मिथुनानि च ॥
हेमवस्त्रादिदानेन यथाशक्ति क्षमापयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.12.m: He should feed the vow-observers, likewise the teacher, and married couples. / By giving gold, garments, and other gifts, he should ask their forgiveness according to his capacity.

4.12.s:
evaṃ visṛjya tānsarvānsārddhaṃ baṃdhujanaiḥ svayam ..
āśayitvā pañcagavyaṃ hṛṣṭo bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 17 ..
4.12.d:
एवं विसृज्य तान्सर्वान्सार्द्धं बंधुजनैः स्वयम् ॥
आशयित्वा पञ्चगव्यं हृष्टो भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥ 17 ॥
4.12.m: Having thus dismissed all of them, he himself, along with his kinsmen, / having first consumed the five products of the cow, should eat in joy, restrained in speech.

4.12.s:
evameva vidhiṃ kṛtvā prārabhetādhano dhanī ..
vittasāmarthyataścaiva pratimāsaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 18 ..
4.12.d:
एवमेव विधिं कृत्वा प्रारभेताधनो धनी ॥
वित्तसामर्थ्यतश्चैव प्रतिमासं च कृत्स्नशः ॥ 18 ॥
4.12.m: Having performed this very rite, whether poor or wealthy, / according to the extent of his wealth, he should undertake it in full each month.

4.12.s:
vittahīno yathā kaścicchraddhayā ca punaḥpunaḥ ..
puṣpārcanavidhānena sarvametatsamācaret .. 19 ..
4.12.d:
वित्तहीनो यथा कश्चिच्छ्रद्धया च पुनःपुनः ॥
पुष्पार्चनविधानेन सर्वमेतत्समाचरेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.12.m: Even if someone is destitute of wealth, with faith again and again / by means of the ritual of flower-worship he should perform all of this.

4.12.s:
pratimāsamupoṣyaivaṃ prati patkārttikāvadhau ..
pārayettaṃ hutaṃ pārtha prāraṃbhavidhinā sphuṭam .. 4.12.20 ..
4.12.d:
प्रतिमासमुपोष्यैवं प्रति पत्कार्त्तिकावधौ ॥
पारयेत्तं हुतं पार्थ प्रारंभविधिना स्फुटम् ॥ 4.12.20 ॥
4.12.m: Fasting thus each month on the pratipad until Kārttika, / one should break that fast [after] offering oblations, O son of Pṛthā, clearly according to the rules of commencement.

4.12.s:
dvitīye dve pañcadaśyāṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ narādhipaḥ ..
pratipatsa dvitīyā cettasyāmupavasetsudhīḥ .. 21 ..
4.12.d:
द्वितीये द्वे पञ्चदश्यां कृत्वा नक्तं नराधिपः ॥
प्रतिपत्स द्वितीया चेत्तस्यामुपवसेत्सुधीः ॥ 21 ॥
4.12.m: In the second [year], having eaten a nocturnal meal on two fifteenth [tithis], the king— / if the pratipad is joined with the dvitīyā, the wise man should fast upon it.

4.12.s:
dvitīyopavasecchuklā tataḥ prabhṛti vatsaram ..
prāraṃbhavidhinā caivaṃ dvitīyāmapi pārayet .. 22 ..
4.12.d:
द्वितीयोपवसेच्छुक्ला ततः प्रभृति वत्सरम् ॥
प्रारंभविधिना चैवं द्वितीयामपि पारयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.12.m: From then on he should fast on the bright dvitīyā for a year; / and following the rules of commencement he should thus break the fast on the dvitīyā as well.

4.12.s:
upavāsadvayaṃ kṛtvā tṛtīyāṃ prārabhettataḥ ..
anena kramayogena yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate .. 23 ..
4.12.d:
उपवासद्वयं कृत्वा तृतीयां प्रारभेत्ततः ॥
अनेन क्रमयोगेन यावद्वर्षं समाप्यते ॥ 23 ॥
4.12.m: Having kept two fasts, he should then commence the tṛtīyā; / through this order of progression, until the year is completed.

4.12.s:
kṛtvaivaṃ ṣoḍaśe varṣe pūrṇamāsyāṃ samudyataḥ ..
pūrvavaddevamabhyarcya kṛśānuṃ vābhitarpya ca .. 24 ..
4.12.d:
कृत्वैवं षोडशे वर्षे पूर्णमास्यां समुद्यतः ॥
पूर्ववद्देवमभ्यर्च्य कृशानुं वाभितर्प्य च ॥ 24 ॥
4.12.m: Having done this, in the sixteenth year, zealous on the full-moon day, / having worshipped the god as before or having gratified the fire,

4.12.s:
hemaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ saghaṃṭāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ..
mahādevāya gāṃ dadyāddīkṣitāya dvijāya vai .. 25 ..
4.12.d:
हेमशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां सघंटां कांस्यदोहनाम् ॥
महादेवाय गां दद्याद्दीक्षिताय द्विजाय वै ॥ 25 ॥
4.12.m: one should bestow upon an initiated brāhmaṇa, for Mahādeva, a cow / with golden horns, silver hooves, a bell, and a bronze milking vessel.

4.12.s:
śivabhaktiratānviprānviśuddhāṃścaiva ṣoḍaśa ..
vastrābharaṇadānaiśca śaktyā saṃpūjayedvratī .. 26 ..
4.12.d:
शिवभक्तिरतान्विप्रान्विशुद्धांश्चैव षोडश ॥
वस्त्राभरणदानैश्च शक्त्या संपूजयेद्व्रती ॥ 26 ॥
4.12.m: The vow-observer should worship sixteen pure brāhmaṇas devoted to the worship of Śiva, / according to his capacity, with gifts of garments and ornaments.

4.12.s:
brāhmaṇāṃśca yathāśaktyā bhojayedaparānapi ..
anyeṣāṃ ca kṣudhārtānāṃ dadyāddānaṃ yathecchayā .. 27 ..
4.12.d:
ब्राह्मणांश्च यथाशक्त्या भोजयेदपरानपि ॥
अन्येषां च क्षुधार्तानां दद्याद्दानं यथेच्छया ॥ 27 ॥
4.12.m: And he should feed other brāhmaṇas as well according to his capacity; / and to others afflicted with hunger he should give gifts as he pleases.

4.12.s:
bṛhattapovrataṃ caiva brahmaghnādyaghaśoṣaṇam ..
bhūrbhuvādiṣu lokeṣu bhūribhogapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 28 ..
4.12.d:
बृहत्तपोव्रतं चैव ब्रह्मघ्नाद्यघशोषणम् ॥
भूर्भुवादिषु लोकेषु भूरिभोगप्रदं नृणाम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.12.m: This Bṛhattapovrata dries up sins such as the slaying of a brāhmaṇa, / and bestows abundant enjoyments upon men in the worlds of Bhūr, Bhuvas, and the rest.

4.12.s:
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ svargasopānavatsthitam ..
na kuryādyo dhanaṃ prāpya sa muṣṭo naṣṭacetanaḥ .. 29 ..
4.12.d:
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां स्वर्गसोपानवत्स्थितम् ॥
न कुर्याद्यो धनं प्राप्य स मुष्टो नष्टचेतनः ॥ 29 ॥
4.12.m: It stands like a stairway to heaven for all four classes. / Whoever has acquired wealth and does not perform it is cheated and bereft of sense.

4.12.s:
dhanyamāyuḥpradaṃ puṇyaṃ rūpasaubhāgyavarddhanam ..
strīpuṃsayośca nirdiṣṭaṃ vratametatpurātanam .. 4.12.30 ..
4.12.d:
धन्यमायुःप्रदं पुण्यं रूपसौभाग्यवर्द्धनम् ॥
स्त्रीपुंसयोश्च निर्दिष्टं व्रतमेतत्पुरातनम् ॥ 4.12.30 ॥
4.12.m: This ancient votive observance is declared for both women and men; / it brings prosperity, bestows long life, is meritorious, and increases beauty and fortune.

4.12.s:
vidhavayāpi kartavyaṃ bhūyo'vaidhavyahetave ..
sadhavayāpi kartavyamaviyogāya sadvratam .. 31 ..
4.12.d:
विधवयापि कर्तव्यं भूयोऽवैधव्यहेतवे ॥
सधवयापि कर्तव्यमवियोगाय सद्व्रतम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.12.m: It should be performed even by a widow so that she may not become a widow again; / it should also be performed by a woman whose husband is alive, for the sake of non-separation.

4.12.s:
upoṣya pratimāsaṃ tu bhuṃjīta brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ..
ekadvitricaturbhirvā svaśaktyā pāṃḍunaṃdana .. 32 ..
4.12.d:
उपोष्य प्रतिमासं तु भुंजीत ब्राह्मणैः सह ॥
एकद्वित्रिचतुर्भिर्वा स्वशक्त्या पांडुनंदन ॥ 32 ॥
4.12.m: Having fasted each month, one should eat together with brāhmaṇas— / with one, two, three, or four, according to one's capacity, O son of Pāṇḍu.

4.12.s:
aṃte cāṃte suvarṇānāṃ prāraṃbhavidhinācaret ..
puṇyasaṃbhāramanvicchangamayitvā śivālayam .. 33 ..
4.12.d:
अंते चांते सुवर्णानां प्रारंभविधिनाचरेत् ॥
पुण्यसंभारमन्विच्छन्गमयित्वा शिवालयम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.12.m: At the very end, seeking an accumulation of merit, / having gone to a temple of Śiva, one should perform [the rite] with pieces of gold according to the rules of commencement.

4.12.s:
vratavighne mahārāja jāte daivātkathaṃcana ..
tāvatyastithayaścānyāḥ samupoṣyāḥ samāptaye.. .. 34 ..
4.12.d:
व्रतविघ्ने महाराज जाते दैवात्कथंचन ॥
तावत्यस्तिथयश्चान्याः समुपोष्याः समाप्तये॥ ॥ 34 ॥
4.12.m: If by chance some obstacle arises in the votive observance, O great king, / that many other lunar days should be fasted upon for its completion.

4.12.s:
atha śīghrataraṃ kaścidvrataṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ ..
vidhinānena rājendra tena grāhyaṃ tithidvayam .. 35 ..
4.12.d:
अथ शीघ्रतरं कश्चिद्व्रतं कर्तुं समुद्यतः ॥
विधिनानेन राजेन्द्र तेन ग्राह्यं तिथिद्वयम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.12.m: If someone is prepared to perform the votive observance more quickly, / O king of kings, he should undertake two lunar days according to this rule.

4.12.s:
aṃte cāṃte ca varṣāṇāṃ prāraṃbhavidhinā ca ret ..
athārabdhe vrate kaścidasamāpte mriyeta cet .. 36 ..
4.12.d:
अंते चांते च वर्षाणां प्रारंभविधिना च रेत् ॥
अथारब्धे व्रते कश्चिदसमाप्ते म्रियेत चेत् ॥ 36 ॥
4.12.m: At the end of the years he should perform it according to the rules of commencement. / If someone dies after beginning the votive observance while it is still unfinished,

4.12.s:
so'pi tatphalamāpnoti satyāraṃbhaprabhāvataḥ ..
vācakāḥ śrāvakāścaiva vratasyāsya yudhiṣṭhira..
bhavaṃti putrasaṃśliṣṭāḥ śivadhyānānubhāvataḥ ..37..
4.12.d:
सोऽपि तत्फलमाप्नोति सत्यारंभप्रभावतः ॥
वाचकाः श्रावकाश्चैव व्रतस्यास्य युधिष्ठिर॥
भवंति पुत्रसंश्लिष्टाः शिवध्यानानुभावतः ॥37॥
4.12.m: even he attains its fruit through the power of a true commencement. / The reciters and the listeners of this votive observance, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / become embraced by sons through the power of meditating on Śiva.

4.12.s:
puṇyaṃ bṛhattapa idaṃ vratamādarādye kurvaṃti ṣoḍaśasamā niratāḥ svadharme ..
te bhānumaṃḍalamabhedyamaciṃtyamādyaṃ bhittvā prayānti śaśiśekharapādamūlam .. 38 ..
bhadropavāsavratavarṇanam
4.12.d:
पुण्यं बृहत्तप इदं व्रतमादराद्ये कुर्वंति षोडशसमा निरताः स्वधर्मे ॥
ते भानुमंडलमभेद्यमचिंत्यमाद्यं भित्त्वा प्रयान्ति शशिशेखरपादमूलम् ॥ 38 ॥
भद्रोपवासव्रतवर्णनम्
4.12.m:
Those who, devoted to their own duties, perform with reverence this meritorious Bṛhattapo-vrata for sixteen years, / pierce the impenetrable, inconceivable, primordial orb of the sun and go to the presence of the moon-crested god.
Description of the Bhadropavāsavrata

4.13.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
jātismaratvaṃ deveśa duṣprāpyamiti me matiḥ ..
tadahaṃ jñātumicchāmi prāpyate kena karmaṇā .. 1 ..
4.13.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
जातिस्मरत्वं देवेश दुष्प्राप्यमिति मे मतिः ॥
तदहं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि प्राप्यते केन कर्मणा ॥ 1 ॥
4.13.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / It is my thought, O Lord of gods, that remembrance of previous births is difficult to attain. / Therefore I wish to know: by what deed is it attained?

4.13.s:
varapradānāddevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ sevanena vā ..
tīrthasnānena vā deva tapohomavratena vā .. 2 ..
4.13.d:
वरप्रदानाद्देवानामृषीणां सेवनेन वा ॥
तीर्थस्नानेन वा देव तपोहोमव्रतेन वा ॥ 2 ॥
4.13.m: Is it by the bestowal of a boon by the gods, or through attending upon the sages, / or by bathing at holy places, O god, or by penance, homa, and votive observance?

4.13.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
catvāri rājanbhadrāṇi samupoṣyāṇi yatnataḥ ..
tatprabhāvādbhavennūnaṃ rājañjātismaro naraḥ .. 3 ..
4.13.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
चत्वारि राजन्भद्राणि समुपोष्याणि यत्नतः ॥
तत्प्रभावाद्भवेन्नूनं राजञ्जातिस्मरो नरः ॥ 3 ॥
4.13.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Four Bhadras are to be fasted upon with effort, O king; / by the power thereof, O king, a man surely remembers his previous births.

4.13.s:
śubhodayaḥ purā vaiśyo babhūva yamunātaṭe ..
tena vratamidaṃ cīrṇaṃ mṛtaḥ kālakramādasau .. 4 ..
4.13.d:
शुभोदयः पुरा वैश्यो बभूव यमुनातटे ॥
तेन व्रतमिदं चीर्णं मृतः कालक्रमादसौ ॥ 4 ॥
4.13.m: Formerly, a vaiśya named Śubhodaya lived on the bank of the Yamunā. / This votive observance was performed by him; he died in the course of time.

4.13.s:
saṃjayasya suto jātaḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvīti viśrutaḥ ..
vrataprabhāvājjātijñaḥ sa ca caurernipātitaḥ .. 5 ..
4.13.d:
संजयस्य सुतो जातः स्वर्णष्ठीवीति विश्रुतः ॥
व्रतप्रभावाज्जातिज्ञः स च चौरेर्निपातितः ॥ 5 ॥
4.13.m: He was born as the son of Saṃjaya, renowned as Svarṇaṣṭhīvin; / by the power of the votive observance he knew his previous birth, and he was killed by thieves.

4.13.s:
nāradasya prabhāveṇa punaru jīvyate'pyasau ..
sasmāra pūrvavṛttāṃtaṃ sakalaṃ vratadharmataḥ ..6..
4.13.d:
नारदस्य प्रभावेण पुनरु जीव्यतेऽप्यसौ ॥
सस्मार पूर्ववृत्तांतं सकलं व्रतधर्मतः ॥6॥
4.13.m: Through the power of Nārada he was restored to life again; / he remembered the whole narrative of his past life through the merit of the votive observance.

4.13.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
saṃjayasya kathaṃ putraḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvīti vā katham ..
dasyubhiśca kathaṃ nīto mṛtyuṃ vai jīvitaḥ katham .. 7 ..
4.13.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
संजयस्य कथं पुत्रः स्वर्णष्ठीवीति वा कथम् ॥
दस्युभिश्च कथं नीतो मृत्युं वै जीवितः कथम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.13.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How was he Saṃjaya's son, and why was he named Svarṇaṣṭhīvin? / And how was he put to death by robbers, and how was he brought to life?

4.13.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ... ..
saṃjayo nāma rājāsītkuśāvatyāṃ narādhipa ..
devarṣī tasya mitre ca sadā nāradaparvatau .. 8..
4.13.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥॥।
संजयो नाम राजासीत्कुशावत्यां नराधिप ॥
देवर्षी तस्य मित्रे च सदा नारदपर्वतौ ॥ 8॥
4.13.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / There was a king named Saṃjaya in Kuśāvatī, O lord of men; / the divine sages Nārada and Parvata were his constant friends.

4.13.s:
ekadā saṃjayagṛhaṃ saṃprāptau tau yadṛcchayā ..
svagatāsanadānādyairupacārairapūjayat .. 9 ..
4.13.d:
एकदा संजयगृहं संप्राप्तौ तौ यदृच्छया ॥
स्वगतासनदानाद्यैरुपचारैरपूजयत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.13.m: Once, those two arrived at Saṃjaya's palace at will. / He honoured them with hospitable services, beginning with welcomes and the offer of seats.

4.13.s:
teṣāmathopaviṣṭānāṃ pūrvavṛttāṃtabhāṣiṇau ..
saṃjayasya sutā prāptā taruṇī pituraṃtikam .. 4.13.10 ..
4.13.d:
तेषामथोपविष्टानां पूर्ववृत्तांतभाषिणौ ॥
संजयस्य सुता प्राप्ता तरुणी पितुरंतिकम् ॥ 4.13.10 ॥
4.13.m: As they sat there recounting past events, / Saṃjaya's young daughter came into the presence of her father.

4.13.s:
parvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ kanyeyaṃ varavarṇinī ..
guptagulphā saṃhatorūḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharā .. 11 ..
4.13.d:
पर्वतः प्राह राजानं कन्येयं वरवर्णिनी ॥
गुप्तगुल्फा संहतोरूः पीनश्रोणिपयोधरा ॥ 11 ॥
4.13.m: Parvata said to the king: 'This maiden is of splendid complexion, / with hidden ankles, closely knit thighs, and swelling hips and breasts,

4.13.s:
padmapatrekṣaṇanakhā padmakiṃjalkasaprabhā ..
ākuñcitamṛdusnigdhaiḥ keśairavitatairghanaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.13.d:
पद्मपत्रेक्षणनखा पद्मकिंजल्कसप्रभा ॥
आकुञ्चितमृदुस्निग्धैः केशैरविततैर्घनैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.13.m: with eyes and fingernails like lotus petals, possessing the lustre of lotus filaments, / with curved, soft, glossy, neat, and thick hair,

4.13.s:
savilāsā gajagatiḥ sunāsā kokilasvarā ..
aho rūpamaho dhairyamaho lāvaṇyamuttamam ..13..
4.13.d:
सविलासा गजगतिः सुनासा कोकिलस्वरा ॥
अहो रूपमहो धैर्यमहो लावण्यमुत्तमम् ॥13॥
4.13.m: graceful, with an elephant's gait, a lovely nose, and the voice of a cuckoo. / Ah, what beauty! Ah, what composure! Ah, what exquisite charm!

4.13.s:
tilapuṣpasphuṭā nāsā rūpaṃ saṃparilakṣyate ..
kasyeyaṃ bhadrikā bhadrā mamātihṛdayaṃgamā .. 14 ..
4.13.d:
तिलपुष्पस्फुटा नासा रूपं संपरिलक्ष्यते ॥
कस्येयं भद्रिका भद्रा ममातिहृदयंगमा ॥ 14 ॥
4.13.m: Her nose is prominent like a sesamum blossom; [her divine] form is clearly manifest. / Whose is this gracious, auspicious maiden who captivates my heart?'

4.13.s:
evaṃ bruvā ṇaṃ taṃ vipraṃ vismayotphullalocanam ..
sa rājā prāha kanyeyaṃ duhitā mama parvata .. 15 ..
4.13.d:
एवं ब्रुवा णं तं विप्रं विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनम् ॥
स राजा प्राह कन्येयं दुहिता मम पर्वत ॥ 15 ॥
4.13.m: To that brāhmaṇa who spoke thus with eyes wide with wonder, / that king said: 'This maiden is my daughter, O Parvata.'

4.13.s:
athovāca nṛpaṃ dhīmānnāradaḥ kṣubhitendriyaḥ ..
rājanniveṣṭukāmo'haṃ kanyeyaṃ mama dīyatām .. 16
4.13.d:
अथोवाच नृपं धीमान्नारदः क्षुभितेन्द्रियः ॥
राजन्निवेष्टुकामोऽहं कन्येयं मम दीयताम् ॥ 16
4.13.m: Then the wise Nārada, his senses agitated, said to the king: / 'O king, I wish to marry; let this maiden be given to me.

4.13.s:
īpsitaṃ tava dāsyāmi varaṃ martyeṣu durllabham ..
evamukto nāradena prītātmā saṃjayastathā .. 17 ..
4.13.d:
ईप्सितं तव दास्यामि वरं मर्त्येषु दुर्ल्लभम् ॥
एवमुक्तो नारदेन प्रीतात्मा संजयस्तथा ॥ 17 ॥
4.13.m: I shall grant you a desired boon, hard to obtain among mortals.' / Addressed thus by Nārada, Sañjaya, pleased in his heart,

4.13.s:
kṛtāñjaliruvācedaṃ praharṣotphullalocanaḥ ..
putro me dīyatāṃ kṣipramakṣīṇakanakākaraḥ .. 18 ..
4.13.d:
कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदं प्रहर्षोत्फुल्ललोचनः ॥
पुत्रो मे दीयतां क्षिप्रमक्षीणकनकाकरः ॥ 18 ॥
4.13.m: Folded his hands and said this, his eyes blooming with joy: / 'Quickly grant me a son who is an inexhaustible mine of gold,

4.13.s:
yasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā śleṣmāṇaṃ kṣipati kṣitau ..
jātarūpaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavatu sthiram .. 19 ..
4.13.d:
यस्य मूत्रं पुरीषं वा श्लेष्माणं क्षिपति क्षितौ ॥
जातरूपं हि तत्सर्वं सुवर्णं भवतु स्थिरम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.13.m: Whatever urine, feces, or phlegm he casts upon the ground, / let all of that indeed become durable, refined gold.'

4.13.s:
evamastviti taṃ rājannāradaḥ pratyabhāṣata ..
suvarṇaṣṭhīvinaṃ putraṃ dadāmi tava suvrata .. 4.13.20 ..
4.13.d:
एवमस्त्विति तं राजन्नारदः प्रत्यभाषत ॥
सुवर्णष्ठीविनं पुत्रं ददामि तव सुव्रत ॥ 4.13.20 ॥
4.13.m: 'So be it,' Nārada replied to him, O king; / 'O man of good vows, I grant you a son who spits gold.'

4.13.s:
evamuktvā sa tāṃ kanyāṃ sālaṅkārāṃ sumadhyamām ..
vivāhayāmāsa tayā nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..21 ..
4.13.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स तां कन्यां सालङ्कारां सुमध्यमाम् ॥
विवाहयामास तया नारदो हृष्टमानसः ॥21 ॥
4.13.m: Having said this, Nārada, glad at heart, / took in marriage that slender-waisted maiden, adorned with ornaments.

4.13.s:
tattasya ceṣṭitaṃ dṛṣṭvā parvataḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ..
uvāca nāradaṃ roṣāddīptākṣaḥ sphuritādharaḥ .. 22 ..
4.13.d:
तत्तस्य चेष्टितं दृष्ट्वा पर्वतः क्रोधमूर्छितः ॥
उवाच नारदं रोषाद्दीप्ताक्षः स्फुरिताधरः ॥ 22 ॥
4.13.m: Seeing that deed of his, Parvata was overcome with rage; / his eyes blazing and his lower lip trembling, he spoke furiously to Nārada:

4.13.s:
mayeyaṃ prārthitā pūrvaṃ tvayā yasmādvivāhitā ..
tasmānmayā samaṃ svargaṃ na gaṃtāsi kathaṃcana .. 23 ..
4.13.d:
मयेयं प्रार्थिता पूर्वं त्वया यस्माद्विवाहिता ॥
तस्मान्मया समं स्वर्गं न गंतासि कथंचन ॥ 23 ॥
4.13.m: 'Since this maiden was sought by me first, yet married by you, / therefore you shall never go to heaven together with me.

4.13.s:
dattastvayāsya yaḥ putro varadānena nārada ..
so'pi caurairabhihataḥ pañcatvamupayāsyati .. 24 ..
4.13.d:
दत्तस्त्वयास्य यः पुत्रो वरदानेन नारद ॥
सोऽपि चौरैरभिहतः पञ्चत्वमुपयास्यति ॥ 24 ॥
4.13.m: And the son whom you granted to him by bestowing a boon, O Nārada, / he too shall meet his death, slain by thieves.'

4.13.s:
evamuktaḥ parvatena nāradaḥ prāha durmanāḥ ..
na tvaṃ dharmaṃ vijānāsi kiñcinmūḍho'si durmate .. 25 ..
4.13.d:
एवमुक्तः पर्वतेन नारदः प्राह दुर्मनाः ॥
न त्वं धर्मं विजानासि किञ्चिन्मूढोऽसि दुर्मते ॥ 25 ॥
4.13.m: Spoken to thus by Parvata, Nārada, downcast, said: / 'You know nothing of dharma; you are foolish, O wicked-minded one!

4.13.s:
sāmānyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kanyā bhavati suvrata ..
na tasyā varaṇe duḥkhaṃ paśyaṃtīha bahuśrutāḥ .. 26 ..
4.13.d:
सामान्यं सर्वभूतानां कन्या भवति सुव्रत ॥
न तस्या वरणे दुःखं पश्यंतीह बहुश्रुताः ॥ 26 ॥
4.13.m: A maiden is common to all beings, O man of good vows; / the learned see no wrong in choosing her.

4.13.s:
na sevitāstvayā vṛddhāstena māṃ śapase ruṣā ..
paṇigrahaṇamaṃtrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syātsaptame pade .. 27 ..
4.13.d:
न सेवितास्त्वया वृद्धास्तेन मां शपसे रुषा ॥
पणिग्रहणमंत्राणां निष्ठा स्यात्सप्तमे पदे ॥ 27 ॥
4.13.m: You have not served the elders; therefore, out of anger, you curse me. / The completion of the marriage mantras occurs at the seventh step.

4.13.s:
yasmādetadavijñāya śapase māmanāgasam ..
tasmāttvamapyaho svargaṃ na gaṃtāsi mayā vinā .. 28 ..
4.13.d:
यस्मादेतदविज्ञाय शपसे मामनागसम् ॥
तस्मात्त्वमप्यहो स्वर्गं न गंतासि मया विना ॥ 28 ॥
4.13.m: Since you, without knowing this, curse me who am innocent, / therefore you too, alas, shall not go to heaven without me.

4.13.s:
saṃjayasya sutaḥ śāpādyadi pañcatvameṣyati ..
ānayiṣye tathāpyenaṃ yamalokānna saṃśayaḥ ..29..
4.13.d:
संजयस्य सुतः शापाद्यदि पञ्चत्वमेष्यति ॥
आनयिष्ये तथाप्येनं यमलोकान्न संशयः ॥29॥
4.13.m: If Sañjaya's son goes to his death on account of your curse, / nevertheless I will bring him back from the realm of Yama; there is no doubt.'

4.13.s:
evaṃ śaptvā tadā' nyonyaṃ devarṣī tāvubhau punaḥ ..
pūjitau saṃjayenātha jagmatuḥ svāśramaṃ prati .. 4.13.30 ..
4.13.d:
एवं शप्त्वा तदा' न्योन्यं देवर्षी तावुभौ पुनः ॥
पूजितौ संजयेनाथ जग्मतुः स्वाश्रमं प्रति ॥ 4.13.30 ॥
4.13.m: Having thus cursed each other, both divine sages, / worshipped then by Sañjaya, departed toward their own hermitage.

4.13.s:
athāsya saptame māsi jātaḥ putro nṛpasya saḥ ..
svarṇaṣṭhīvīti nāmāsya yathārthamakarotpitā .. 31 ..
4.13.d:
अथास्य सप्तमे मासि जातः पुत्रो नृपस्य सः ॥
स्वर्णष्ठीवीति नामास्य यथार्थमकरोत्पिता ॥ 31 ॥
4.13.m: Then, in the seventh month, that son was born to the king; / his father gave him the name Suvarṇaṣṭhīvin, which was true to fact.

4.13.s:
jātismaraḥ smaravapuḥ suvarṇotpattikāraṇam ..
sarvabhūtarutajño'bhūdbhadravrataphalādiha .. 32 ..
4.13.d:
जातिस्मरः स्मरवपुः सुवर्णोत्पत्तिकारणम् ॥
सर्वभूतरुतज्ञोऽभूद्भद्रव्रतफलादिह ॥ 32 ॥
4.13.m: He remembered his past lives, possessed the form of Kāma, was the source of gold, / and understood the cries of all creatures here, by the fruit of the Bhadra vow.

4.13.s:
mūtraśleṣmapurīṣādi yatkiñcitkṣipati kṣitau ..
jāyate kanakaṃ sarvaṃ prasādānnāradasya ca ..33..
4.13.d:
मूत्रश्लेष्मपुरीषादि यत्किञ्चित्क्षिपति क्षितौ ॥
जायते कनकं सर्वं प्रसादान्नारदस्य च ॥33॥
4.13.m: Whatever urine, phlegm, feces, and the like he cast on the ground / turned entirely into gold, through the favor of Nārada.

4.13.s:
tenāsau yajate rājā vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ..
rājasūyādibhiryajñairvi vidhairbrāhmaṇairvṛtaḥ ..34..
4.13.d:
तेनासौ यजते राजा विधिवद्भूरिदक्षिणैः ॥
राजसूयादिभिर्यज्ञैर्वि विधैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वृतः ॥34॥
4.13.m: Therewith the king sacrificed according to rule with abundant gifts, / through various sacrifices such as the Rājasūya, surrounded by brāhmaṇas.

4.13.s:
babhāra bhṛtyānaniśaṃ pupoṣa svajanātithīn ..
cakāra devatāgāraṃ saraścārāmavāṭikāḥ ..35..
4.13.d:
बभार भृत्याननिशं पुपोष स्वजनातिथीन् ॥
चकार देवतागारं सरश्चारामवाटिकाः ॥35॥
4.13.m: He constantly maintained his servants and nourished his kin and guests; / he constructed temples, lakes, and pleasure-gardens.

4.13.s:
jātasnehaṃ tathā putraṃ rarakṣa rakṣi bhirvṛtaḥ ..
rāśayaḥ kanakasyāsya babhūvurnṛpateḥ sutāt..36..
4.13.d:
जातस्नेहं तथा पुत्रं ररक्ष रक्षि भिर्वृतः ॥
राशयः कनकस्यास्य बभूवुर्नृपतेः सुतात्॥36॥
4.13.m: Surrounded by guards, he guarded his son, whom he loved dearly; / heaps of gold were produced for the king from his son.

4.13.s:
athāsya dasyavaḥ kecicchrutvā taṃ kanakākaram..
dhanalolupayā jaghnurdākṣiṇātyā madoddha tāḥ..37..
4.13.d:
अथास्य दस्यवः केचिच्छ्रुत्वा तं कनकाकरम्॥
धनलोलुपया जघ्नुर्दाक्षिणात्या मदोद्ध ताः॥37॥
4.13.m: Then certain bandits, southern men swollen with arrogance, / hearing that he was a mine of gold, killed him out of greed for wealth.

4.13.s:
tasminvinaṣṭe tannaṣṭaṃ varadānasamudbhavam ..
kanakaṃ tadapaśyaṃto jagmuranyonyataḥ kṣayam ..38..
4.13.d:
तस्मिन्विनष्टे तन्नष्टं वरदानसमुद्भवम् ॥
कनकं तदपश्यंतो जग्मुरन्योन्यतः क्षयम् ॥38॥
4.13.m: When he perished, that gold born of the boon disappeared; / not seeing it, they destroyed one another.

4.13.s:
pātitaṃ dasyubhiḥ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā suduḥkhitaḥ..
vilalāpākulamatiḥ sa mumoha papāta ca ..39..
4.13.d:
पातितं दस्युभिः पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा राजा सुदुःखितः॥
विललापाकुलमतिः स मुमोह पपात च ॥39॥
4.13.m: Seeing his son struck down by bandits, the king was exceedingly distressed; / his mind agitated, he wailed, fainted, and fell to the ground.

4.13.s:
vilapaṃtaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha saṃjayam ..
rājanviṣādaṃ mā kārṣīḥ śṛṇvimāṃ bhāratīṃ mama ..4.13.40..
4.13.d:
विलपंतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा नारदः प्राह संजयम् ॥
राजन्विषादं मा कार्षीः शृण्विमां भारतीं मम ॥4.13.40॥
4.13.m: Seeing him wailing, Nārada said to Sañjaya: / 'O king, do not despair; listen to these words of mine.'

4.13.s:
ityuktvā sa samācakhyau caritāni mahaujasām ..
viśiṣṭānāṃ narendrāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ dakṣiṇāvatām .. 41 ..
4.13.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स समाचख्यौ चरितानि महौजसाम् ॥
विशिष्टानां नरेन्द्राणां यतीनां दक्षिणावताम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.13.m: Having said this, he related the deeds of illustrious men, / distinguished kings and ascetics who gave generous sacrificial gifts.

4.13.s:
śrutvā rājā nareṃdrāṇāṃ caritāni mahā tmanām ..
vinaṣṭaśokaḥ sahasā prakṛtistho vabhūva saḥ ..42..
4.13.d:
श्रुत्वा राजा नरेंद्राणां चरितानि महा त्मनाम् ॥
विनष्टशोकः सहसा प्रकृतिस्थो वभूव सः ॥42॥
4.13.m: Having heard the deeds of the great-souled kings, / the king's grief vanished at once and he returned to his natural state.

4.13.s:
nārado'pi nareṃdrasya mṛtaṃ putraṃ yamālayāt ..
ānayāmāsa tarasā tathārūpaṃ yathā hatam .. 43 ..
4.13.d:
नारदोऽपि नरेंद्रस्य मृतं पुत्रं यमालयात् ॥
आनयामास तरसा तथारूपं यथा हतम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.13.m: And Nārada swiftly brought the king's dead son from Yama's abode, / in the very same form as when he was slain.

4.13.s:
dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā sa putraṃ taṃ parituṣṭena cetasā ..
vrīḍito vismitaścaiva kṛtāñjalirathāvravīt .. 44 ..
4.13.d:
दृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा स पुत्रं तं परितुष्टेन चेतसा ॥
व्रीडितो विस्मितश्चैव कृताञ्जलिरथाव्रवीत् ॥ 44 ॥
4.13.m: Having seen and touched that son with a delighted mind, / he, ashamed and astonished, folded his hands and then said:

4.13.s:
kimāścaryaṃ prasannena bhavatā mama nārada ..
dattaḥ putrastathābhūto dasyubhirghātito yathā .. 45 ..
4.13.d:
किमाश्चर्यं प्रसन्नेन भवता मम नारद ॥
दत्तः पुत्रस्तथाभूतो दस्युभिर्घातितो यथा ॥ 45 ॥
4.13.m: 'What a wonder that you, being pleased, O Nārada, / gave me a son of such a kind, even as he was slain by bandits!'

4.13.s:
ṣaṇmāsāṃte punarasau jīvitaṃ sarvameva tat ..
sasmāra pūrvaṃ vṛttāṃtaṃ bhadrāṇāṃ pāraṇātkila .. 46 ..
4.13.d:
षण्मासांते पुनरसौ जीवितं सर्वमेव तत् ॥
सस्मार पूर्वं वृत्तांतं भद्राणां पारणात्किल ॥ 46 ॥
4.13.m: At the end of six months, he regained his life and all of that; / he remembered his past events, indeed, through the concluding meal of the Bhadras.

4.13.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ jātismaraṇakārakam ..
vrataṃ vratādhikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi te ..47 ..
4.13.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं जातिस्मरणकारकम् ॥
व्रतं व्रताधिकं श्रेष्ठं किमन्यत्कथयामि ते ॥47 ॥
4.13.m: This has all been related to you—the vow that causes remembrance of past lives, / supreme above all vows; what else shall I tell you?

4.13.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
brāhmaṇāścaiva śūdrāśca kule mahati janma ca ..
dātā kṣamī dhanī vāgmī rūpī svairbhadrakairbhavet ..48..
4.13.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्राह्मणाश्चैव शूद्राश्च कुले महति जन्म च ॥
दाता क्षमी धनी वाग्मी रूपी स्वैर्भद्रकैर्भवेत् ॥48॥
4.13.m: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Brāhmaṇas and śūdras, birth in a great family, / being generous, forgiving, wealthy, eloquent, and handsome, occur through one's own Bhadrakas.

4.13.s:
catvāri rājanbhadrāṇi catuṣpādāni tāni vai ..
tānyeva bahuvighnāni duṣprāpyānyakṛtātmabhiḥ .. 49 ..
4.13.d:
चत्वारि राजन्भद्राणि चतुष्पादानि तानि वै ॥
तान्येव बहुविघ्नानि दुष्प्राप्यान्यकृतात्मभिः ॥ 49 ॥
4.13.m: There are four Bhadras, O king; they indeed have four quarters; / they have many obstacles and are difficult to attain by undisciplined persons.

4.13.s:
mārgaśīrṣe tu prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ phālgune tathā ..
jyeṣṭhe tṛtīyaṃ rājendra khyātaṃ bhādrapade param .. 4.13.50 ..
4.13.d:
मार्गशीर्षे तु प्रथमं द्वितीयं फाल्गुने तथा ॥
ज्येष्ठे तृतीयं राजेन्द्र ख्यातं भाद्रपदे परम् ॥ 4.13.50 ॥
4.13.m: The first is in Mārgaśīrṣa, and the second is in Phālguna; / the third is in Jyeṣṭha, O king of kings, and the next is known to be in Bhādrapada.

4.13.s:
phālgunāmalapakṣādau trīnmāsāṃstu narādhipa ..
tattripuṣpamiti khyātaṃ tapasyākaraṇaṃ param .. 51 ..
4.13.d:
फाल्गुनामलपक्षादौ त्रीन्मासांस्तु नराधिप ॥
तत्त्रिपुष्पमिति ख्यातं तपस्याकरणं परम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.13.m: Beginning from the bright fortnight of Phālguna, for three months, O ruler of men, / that is known as Tripuṣpa, an excellent practice of austerity.

4.13.s:
jyeṣṭhasya śuklapakṣādau trīnvai māsānyudhiṣṭhira ..
tattrirāmamiti khyātaṃ satyaśauryapradāyakam .. 52 ..
4.13.d:
ज्येष्ठस्य शुक्लपक्षादौ त्रीन्वै मासान्युधिष्ठिर ॥
तत्त्रिराममिति ख्यातं सत्यशौर्यप्रदायकम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.13.m: Beginning from the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, for three months, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / that is known as Trirāma, bestowing truth and valor.

4.13.s:
śukle bhādrapadasyādau trīnmāsānpāṃḍunaṃdana ..
tattriraṃgamiti khyātaṃ vahuvidyāpradāyakam .. 53 ..
4.13.d:
शुक्ले भाद्रपदस्यादौ त्रीन्मासान्पांडुनंदन ॥
तत्त्रिरंगमिति ख्यातं वहुविद्याप्रदायकम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.13.m: Beginning in the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, for three months, O son of Pāṇḍu, / that is known as Triraṅga, bestowing much knowledge.

4.13.s:
śuklamārgaśirasyādau trīnmāsāṃstu narādhipa ..
tadviṣṇupadamityuktaṃ sarvadharmapradāyakam .. 54 ..
4.13.d:
शुक्लमार्गशिरस्यादौ त्रीन्मासांस्तु नराधिप ॥
तद्विष्णुपदमित्युक्तं सर्वधर्मप्रदायकम् ॥ 54 ॥
4.13.m: Beginning in the bright fortnight of Mārgaśiras, for three months, O ruler of men, / that is said to be Viṣṇupada, bestowing all dharma.

4.13.s:
samāsenaiva coktāni bhadrāṇyetāni bhārata ..
kartavyāni naraiḥ strībhirvā brahmaṇānumatena vā .. 55 ..
4.13.d:
समासेनैव चोक्तानि भद्राण्येतानि भारत ॥
कर्तव्यानि नरैः स्त्रीभिर्वा ब्रह्मणानुमतेन वा ॥ 55 ॥
4.13.m: These Bhadras have been declared in brief, O Bhārata; / they are to be performed by men, or by women with the permission of a brāhmaṇa.'

4.13.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
vistareṇaiva me brūhi devadeva jagatpate ..
bhadrāṇāṃ niyamādhānaṃ pradhānaniyamāṃstathā .. 56 .. ..
4.13.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
विस्तरेणैव मे ब्रूहि देवदेव जगत्पते ॥
भद्राणां नियमाधानं प्रधाननियमांस्तथा ॥ 56 ॥ ॥
4.13.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'Tell me in detail, O god of gods, Lord of the universe, / the adoption of the rules of the Bhadras, and their principal observances.'

4.13.s:
..śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājannavahito bhadrāṇāṃ vistaraṃ param ..
kathayiṣye na kathitaṃ kasyacidyanmayāpurā ..57..
4.13.d:
॥श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु राजन्नवहितो भद्राणां विस्तरं परम् ॥
कथयिष्ये न कथितं कस्यचिद्यन्मयापुरा ॥57॥
4.13.m: The Blessed Lord said: / 'Listen attentively, O king, to the supreme detail of the Bhadras; / I shall relate what has not been told by me to anyone before.

4.13.s:
śukle mārgaśirasyādau catvārastithayo varāḥ ..
dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca caturthī pañcamī tathā .. 58 ..
4.13.d:
शुक्ले मार्गशिरस्यादौ चत्वारस्तिथयो वराः ॥
द्वितीया च तृतीया च चतुर्थी पञ्चमी तथा ॥ 58 ॥
4.13.m: At the beginning of the bright fortnight of Mārgaśiras, four lunar days are excellent: / the second, the third, the fourth, and the fifth.

4.13.s:
ekabhuktāsanastiṣṭhetpratipadyāṃ jitendriyaḥ ..
prabhāte tu dvitīyāyāṃ kṛtvā yatkaraṇīyakam .. 59 ..
4.13.d:
एकभुक्तासनस्तिष्ठेत्प्रतिपद्यां जितेन्द्रियः ॥
प्रभाते तु द्वितीयायां कृत्वा यत्करणीयकम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.13.m: One should observe a single meal on the first day, self-controlled; / then, in the morning of the second day, having done what is to be done,

4.13.s:
praharatraye samadhike gate snānaṃ samācaret ..
mṛdgomayaṃ ca saṃgṛhya maṃtrairebhirvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4.13.60 ..
4.13.d:
प्रहरत्रये समधिके गते स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥
मृद्गोमयं च संगृह्य मंत्रैरेभिर्विचक्षणः ॥ 4.13.60 ॥
4.13.m: When more than three watches have passed, he should perform his bath. / Gathering clay and cow dung, the wise man [bathes] with these mantras:

4.13.s:
ahaṃ te tu pradiśyāmi maṃtrāṇāṃ vidhimuttamam ..
yeṣāṃ deyo na deyo vā tāñchṛṣva vadāmi te .. 61 ..
4.13.d:
अहं ते तु प्रदिश्यामि मंत्राणां विधिमुत्तमम् ॥
येषां देयो न देयो वा ताञ्छृष्व वदामि ते ॥ 61 ॥
4.13.m: "I will instruct you in the supreme rule of the mantras; / hear from me to whom they should be given or not given, as I explain to you.

4.13.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye śucayo'malāḥ ..
teṣāṃ maṃtrāḥ pradeyā vai na tu saṃkīrṇadharmiṇām .. 62 ..
4.13.d:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा ये शुचयोऽमलाः ॥
तेषां मंत्राः प्रदेया वै न तु संकीर्णधर्मिणाम् ॥ 62 ॥
4.13.m: Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and those Śūdras who are pure and spotless— / to them mantras may indeed be imparted, but not to those of mixed conduct.

4.13.s:
yā strī bhartrā viyuktāpi svācāraiḥ saṃyutā śubhā ..
sā ca mantrānpragṛhṇātu sabhartrī tadanujñayā ..63..
4.13.d:
या स्त्री भर्त्रा वियुक्तापि स्वाचारैः संयुता शुभा ॥
सा च मन्त्रान्प्रगृह्णातु सभर्त्री तदनुज्ञया ॥63॥
4.13.m: A woman who is separated from her husband, yet possessed of proper conduct and auspicious, / may also receive the mantras; and a woman with a husband, by his permission.

4.13.s:
snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ kūpe gṛhepi vā ..
daśottaraṃ phalaṃ jñeyamadhikaṃ hi samantrakam .. 64 ..
4.13.d:
स्नानं नद्यां तडागे वा वाप्यां कूपे गृहेपि वा ॥
दशोत्तरं फलं ज्ञेयमधिकं हि समन्त्रकम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.13.m: Bathing in a river, a pond, a stepped reservoir, a well, or even at home / brings tenfold greater fruit, it should be known, when accompanied by mantras.

4.13.s:
mṛdaṃ maṃtreṇa saṃgṛhya sarvāṃgeṣu pralepayet ..
tvaṃ mṛtsne vaṃditā devaiḥ samalairddaityaghātibhiḥ .. 65 ..
4.13.d:
मृदं मंत्रेण संगृह्य सर्वांगेषु प्रलेपयेत् ॥
त्वं मृत्स्ने वंदिता देवैः समलैर्द्दैत्यघातिभिः ॥ 65 ॥
4.13.m: Taking clay with the mantra, he should smear it over all his limbs: / 'O Earth, you have been praised by the gods, [though] soiled, slaying the daityas;

4.13.s: mayāpi vaṃditā bhaktyā māmato vimalaṃ kuru .. 66 ..
4.13.d: मयापि वंदिता भक्त्या मामतो विमलं कुरु ॥ 66 ॥
4.13.m: I too have praised you with devotion; therefore, make me pure.'"

4.13.s:
iti mṛnmaṃtraḥ ..
evaṃ japanmṛdaṃ dattvā svahastāgresamaṃtrakam ..
jalāvagāhanaṃ kuryātkuṇḍamālikhya dharmavit ..
siddhārthakaiḥ kṛṣṇatilairvacāsarvauṣadhīḥ kramāt .. 67 ..
4.13.d:
इति मृन्मंत्रः ॥
एवं जपन्मृदं दत्त्वा स्वहस्ताग्रेसमंत्रकम् ॥
जलावगाहनं कुर्यात्कुण्डमालिख्य धर्मवित् ॥
सिद्धार्थकैः कृष्णतिलैर्वचासर्वौषधीः क्रमात् ॥ 67 ॥
4.13.m: This is the clay mantra. / Having applied the clay while thus reciting, he should immerse himself in the water / with mantras from the tips of his own hands. The knower of dharma, having drawn a pit / in sequence with white mustard seeds, black sesame seeds, sweet flag, and all medicinal herbs [recites]:

4.13.s:
tvamādiḥ sarvadevānāṃ jagatāṃ ca jaganmaye ..
bhūtānāṃ vīrudhāṃcaiva rasānāṃpataye namaḥ .. 68 ..
4.13.d:
त्वमादिः सर्वदेवानां जगतां च जगन्मये ॥
भूतानां वीरुधांचैव रसानांपतये नमः ॥ 68 ॥
4.13.m: "You are the origin of all gods and worlds, O universe-embodied one! / Homage to the lord of beings, plants, and juices!

4.13.s:
gaṃgāsāgarajaṃ toyaṃ pauṣkaraṃ nārmadaṃ tathā ..
yāmunaṃ sāṃnihatyaṃ ca saṃnidhānamihāstu me .. 69 ..
4.13.d:
गंगासागरजं तोयं पौष्करं नार्मदं तथा ॥
यामुनं सांनिहत्यं च संनिधानमिहास्तु मे ॥ 69 ॥
4.13.m: May the waters arising from Gaṅgā-Sāgara, from Puṣkara, from Narmadā, / from Yamunā, and from Sannihitī be present here for me!"

4.13.s:
iti snānamaṃtraḥ ..
śarīrālaṃbhanaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtvā mṛdgomayāṃbubhiḥ..
evaṃ snātvā samāplutya ācamya taṭamāsthitaḥ ..4.13.70..
4.13.d:
इति स्नानमंत्रः ॥
शरीरालंभनं पूर्वं कृत्वा मृद्गोमयांबुभिः॥
एवं स्नात्वा समाप्लुत्य आचम्य तटमास्थितः ॥4.13.70॥
4.13.m: This is the bath mantra. / Having first touched his body with clay, cow dung, and water, / having thus bathed, dipped completely, and sipped water, standing on the bank,

4.13.s:
nivasya vāsasī śubhre śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ ..
devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca tarpayetsusamādhinā .. 71 ..
4.13.d:
निवस्य वाससी शुभ्रे शुचिः प्रयतमानसः ॥
देवान्पितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च तर्पयेत्सुसमाधिना ॥ 71 ॥
4.13.m: putting on two clean garments, pure and with restrained mind, / he should gratify the gods, ancestors, and humans with good concentration.

4.13.s:
evaṃ gṛhītaniyamo gṛhaṃ gacchecchucivrataḥ ..
upaviśya na saṃjalpedyāvaccandrasya darśanam .. 72 ..
4.13.d:
एवं गृहीतनियमो गृहं गच्छेच्छुचिव्रतः ॥
उपविश्य न संजल्पेद्यावच्चन्द्रस्य दर्शनम् ॥ 72 ॥
4.13.m: Having thus undertaken the observance, pure in his vow, he should go home. / Sitting down, he should not converse until the sighting of the moon.

4.13.s:
snātvā caiva tato nāma tṛtīyādi caturdine ..
namaḥ kṛṣṇācyutānaṃta hṛṣīkeśeti ca kramāta .. .. 73 ..
4.13.d:
स्नात्वा चैव ततो नाम तृतीयादि चतुर्दिने ॥
नमः कृष्णाच्युतानंत हृषीकेशेति च क्रमात ॥ ॥ 73 ॥
4.13.m: And having bathed, then on the four days beginning with the third [tithi], the names / 'Homage to Kṛṣṇa, Acyuta, Ananta, Hṛṣīkeśa' [are uttered] in order.

4.13.s:
caturdine dvitīyādau devamabhyarcaye'cyutam ..
prathamehni smṛtā pūjā pādayoścakrapāṇinaḥ .. 74 ..
4.13.d:
चतुर्दिने द्वितीयादौ देवमभ्यर्चयेऽच्युतम् ॥
प्रथमेह्नि स्मृता पूजा पादयोश्चक्रपाणिनः ॥ 74 ॥
4.13.m: On the four days beginning with the second, he should worship the god Acyuta. / On the first day, worship of the feet of the discus-bearer is prescribed.

4.13.s:
nābhipūjā dvitīyehni kartavyā vidhivannaraiḥ ..
muradviṣastatīyehni pūjāṃ vakṣasivinyaset .. 75 ..
4.13.d:
नाभिपूजा द्वितीयेह्नि कर्तव्या विधिवन्नरैः ॥
मुरद्विषस्ततीयेह्नि पूजां वक्षसिविन्यसेत् ॥ 75 ॥
4.13.m: On the second day, worship of the navel should be performed properly by men. / On the third day, he should place worship upon the chest of the enemy of Mura.

4.13.s:
caturthehni jagaddhātuḥ pūjāṃ śirasi kalpayet ..
puṣpairvilepanairdhūpairarghyaṃ dadyurvi bhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 76 ..
4.13.d:
चतुर्थेह्नि जगद्धातुः पूजां शिरसि कल्पयेत् ॥
पुष्पैर्विलेपनैर्धूपैरर्घ्यं दद्युर्वि भूषणैः ॥ 76 ॥
4.13.m: On the fourth day, he should arrange worship upon the head of the sustainer of the world. / They should offer water of respect with flowers, unguents, incense, and ornaments,

4.13.s:
ghīvarairharinaivedyairdīpadānaiśca bhaktitaḥ ..
pūjayitvā vidhānena viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ vratī .. 77 ..
4.13.d:
घीवरैर्हरिनैवेद्यैर्दीपदानैश्च भक्तितः ॥
पूजयित्वा विधानेन विष्णुं विश्वेश्वरं व्रती ॥ 77 ॥
4.13.m: with clarified butter preparations, food offerings for Hari, and gifts of lamps with devotion. / Having worshipped Viṣṇu, the lord of the universe, according to the rule, the observer of the vow,

4.13.s:
tato dināvasāne tu muhūrte nirgate sati ..
arghyaṃ pradadyātsomāya bhaktyātadbhāvabhāvitaḥ .. 78 ..
4.13.d:
ततो दिनावसाने तु मुहूर्ते निर्गते सति ॥
अर्घ्यं प्रदद्यात्सोमाय भक्त्यातद्भावभावितः ॥ 78 ॥
4.13.m: then at the end of the day, when a muhūrta has elapsed, / should offer water of respect to Soma with devotion, imbued with contemplation of him.

4.13.s:
śaśicandraśaśāṃkendunāmāni kramaśo naraḥ ..
tṛtīyādiṣu candrasya saṃkīrtyārghyaṃ nivedayet .. 79 ..
4.13.d:
शशिचन्द्रशशांकेन्दुनामानि क्रमशो नरः ॥
तृतीयादिषु चन्द्रस्य संकीर्त्यार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ॥ 79 ॥
4.13.m: Reciting the names Śaśin, Candra, Śaśāṅka, and Indu in sequence / for the moon on the [days] beginning with the third, a man should present the water of respect.

4.13.s:
sa cārghyo yādṛśo deya ṛddhimadbhirathetaraiḥ ..
tatte samyakpravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha me .. 4.13.80 ..
4.13.d:
स चार्घ्यो यादृशो देय ऋद्धिमद्भिरथेतरैः ॥
तत्ते सम्यक्प्रवक्ष्यामि युधिष्ठिर निबोध मे ॥ 4.13.80 ॥
4.13.m: And of what kind that water of respect should be given by the wealthy and by others, / that I shall fully explain to you; listen to me, Yudhiṣṭhira:

4.13.s:
candanāgurukarpūradadhi dūrvākṣatādibhiḥ ..
ratnaiḥ samudrajaiścānyairvajravaidūryamauktikaiḥ .. 81 ..
4.13.d:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरदधि दूर्वाक्षतादिभिः ॥
रत्नैः समुद्रजैश्चान्यैर्वज्रवैदूर्यमौक्तिकैः ॥ 81 ॥
4.13.m: With sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, curd, dūrvā grass, unbroken rice grains, and the like, / with gems born of the ocean and others—diamonds, lapis lazuli, and pearls—

4.13.s:
puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ svakālotthaiḥ kharjūrairnnālikerakaiḥ ..
vastrācchādanagovā jibhūmihemagajānvitaiḥ .. 82 ..
4.13.d:
पुष्पैः फलैः स्वकालोत्थैः खर्जूरैर्न्नालिकेरकैः ॥
वस्त्राच्छादनगोवा जिभूमिहेमगजान्वितैः ॥ 82 ॥
4.13.m: with flowers and fruits in season, with dates and coconuts, / accompanied by garments, coverings, cows, horses, land, gold, and elephants.

4.13.s:
sattvayuktasya ṛddhasya rājanneṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
itarasya yathāśakti phalapuṣpākṣatodakaiḥ .. 83 ..
4.13.d:
सत्त्वयुक्तस्य ऋद्धस्य राजन्नेष विधिः स्मृतः ॥
इतरस्य यथाशक्ति फलपुष्पाक्षतोदकैः ॥ 83 ॥
