4.13.m: This is remembered as the rule for an energetic, wealthy man, O king; / for another, according to his capacity, with fruits, flowers, unbroken rice grains, and water.

4.13.s:
lavaṇaṃ guḍaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ payaḥkuṃbhāstilaiḥ saha ..
argheṣvetāni śastāni śaśivṛddhyā vivarddhayet .. 84 ..
4.13.d:
लवणं गुडं घृतं तैलं पयःकुंभास्तिलैः सह ॥
अर्घेष्वेतानि शस्तानि शशिवृद्ध्या विवर्द्धयेत् ॥ 84 ॥
4.13.m: Salt, jaggery, ghee, oil, and pots of milk along with sesame— / these are commended in the waters of respect; he should increase them with the waxing of the moon.

4.13.s:
pratyahaṃ varddhayedarghyaṃ śaśi vṛddhyā narottama ..
evamarghaḥ pradātavyaḥ śṛṇu maṃtravidhikramam .. 85 ..
4.13.d:
प्रत्यहं वर्द्धयेदर्घ्यं शशि वृद्ध्या नरोत्तम ॥
एवमर्घः प्रदातव्यः शृणु मंत्रविधिक्रमम् ॥ 85 ॥
4.13.m: Every day he should increase the water of respect with the waxing of the moon, O best of men. / Thus the water of respect should be given; hear the order of the mantra rule:

4.13.s:
navonavosi māsāṃte jāyamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
triragnisamaveto vai devānāpyāyase haviḥ .. 86 ..
4.13.d:
नवोनवोसि मासांते जायमानः पुनःपुनः ॥
त्रिरग्निसमवेतो वै देवानाप्यायसे हविः ॥ 86 ॥
4.13.m: "You become ever new, being born again and again at the end of the month; / united with the three fires, you fatten the gods with sacrificial offering.

4.13.s:
gaganāṅgaṇasaddīpa dugdhābdhimathanodbhava ..
bhābhāsitadigābhoga ramānuja namo'stu te .. 87 ..
4.13.d:
गगनाङ्गणसद्दीप दुग्धाब्धिमथनोद्भव ॥
भाभासितदिगाभोग रमानुज नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 87 ॥
4.13.m: O auspicious lamp of the courtyard of the sky, born of the churning of the milk ocean, / illuminator of the compass of the directions with radiance, younger brother of Ramā, homage to you!"

4.13.s:
dattvārghyaṃ dvijarājāya tadviprāya nivedayet ..
nirvartyārghyakramamimaṃ tato bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ .. 88 ..
4.13.d:
दत्त्वार्घ्यं द्विजराजाय तद्विप्राय निवेदयेत् ॥
निर्वर्त्यार्घ्यक्रममिमं ततो भुंजीत वाग्यतः ॥ 88 ॥
4.13.m: Having offered water of respect to the king of the twice-born, he should present it to a brāhmaṇa. / Having completed this procedure of water of respect, he should then eat with restrained speech,

4.13.s:
bhūmiṃ tu bhājanaṃ kṛtvā padmapatrasamāstṛtām ..
pālāśairmadhupatrairvā surūpairvā śilātale .. 89 ..
4.13.d:
भूमिं तु भाजनं कृत्वा पद्मपत्रसमास्तृताम् ॥
पालाशैर्मधुपत्रैर्वा सुरूपैर्वा शिलातले ॥ 89 ॥
4.13.m: making the ground his dish, strewn with lotus leaves, / or with flame-of-the-forest leaves, or pleasant leaves, or on a rock surface.

4.13.s:
samālabhya dharāṃ devīṃ maṃtreṇānena maṃtravit ..
tvattale bhoktukāmo'haṃ devi sarvarasodbhave .. 4.13.90 ..
4.13.d:
समालभ्य धरां देवीं मंत्रेणानेन मंत्रवित् ॥
त्वत्तले भोक्तुकामोऽहं देवि सर्वरसोद्भवे ॥ 4.13.90 ॥
4.13.m: Touching the earth goddess with this mantra, the knower of mantras [recites]: / 'I wish to eat upon your surface, O goddess, source of all tastes;

4.13.s:
madanugrahāya susvādaṃ kurvannamamṛtopamam ..
evaṃ japtvā ca bhuktvā ca śākaṃ pākaṃ guṇottaram .. 91 ..
4.13.d:
मदनुग्रहाय सुस्वादं कुर्वन्नममृतोपमम् ॥
एवं जप्त्वा च भुक्त्वा च शाकं पाकं गुणोत्तरम् ॥ 91 ॥
4.13.m: for my favor, make the food delicious, resembling nectar.' / Having thus recited and eaten excellent cooked greens,

4.13.s:
ācamya khānyupālabhya smṛtvā somaṃ svapedbhuvi ..
bhoktavyaṃ tu dritīyāyāmakṣāralavaṇaṃ haviḥ .. 92 ..
4.13.d:
आचम्य खान्युपालभ्य स्मृत्वा सोमं स्वपेद्भुवि ॥
भोक्तव्यं तु द्रितीयायामक्षारलवणं हविः ॥ 92 ॥
4.13.m: having sipped water, touched the bodily apertures, and remembered Soma, he should sleep on the ground. / On the second day, sacrificial offering without salt or pungent seasoning should be eaten;

4.13.s:
munyannaṃ tu tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ gorasottaram ..
ghṛtāktāḥ saguṇāḥ śastāḥ pañcamyāṃ kṛśarāssadā 93 ..
4.13.d:
मुन्यन्नं तु तृतीयायां चतुर्थ्यां गोरसोत्तरम् ॥
घृताक्ताः सगुणाः शस्ताः पञ्चम्यां कृशरास्सदा 93 ॥
4.13.m: sage's grain on the third day; cow's milk products on the fourth; / khicḍī smeared with ghee and seasoned is always commended on the fifth.

4.13.s:
śastā bhadreṣu sarveṣu sadā śyāmākataṇḍulāḥ ..
prasādhikā ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ vanyaṃ phalamayācitam .. 94 ..
4.13.d:
शस्ता भद्रेषु सर्वेषु सदा श्यामाकतण्डुलाः ॥
प्रसाधिका घृतं गव्यं वन्यं फलमयाचितम् ॥ 94 ॥
4.13.m: Śyāmāka rice grains are always commended on all the Bhadrā days, / [as well as] wild rice, cow's ghee, and unbegged forest fruits.

4.13.s:
prātaḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā saṃtarjya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā dattadānānvisarjayeta ..95..
4.13.d:
प्रातः स्नानं ततः कृत्वा संतर्ज्य पितृदेवताः ॥
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या दत्तदानान्विसर्जयेत ॥95॥
4.13.m: Having then bathed in the morning and gratified the ancestors and deities, / he should feed brāhmaṇas with devotion and dismiss them after giving gifts.

4.13.s:
bhṛtyabandhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ paścādbhuñjīta kāmataḥ ..
evaṃ bhadreṣu sarveṣu trimāseṣu gateṣu yaḥ ..96..
4.13.d:
भृत्यबन्धुजनैः सार्द्धं पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत कामतः ॥
एवं भद्रेषु सर्वेषु त्रिमासेषु गतेषु यः ॥96॥
4.13.m: Afterwards he may eat at will along with servants and kinfolk. / Whoever performs this with devotion on all the Bhadrā days

4.13.s:
karotyetannaro bhaktyā varṣamekamamatsarī ..
tasya śrīrvijayaścaiva nityaṃ somaḥ prasīdati ..97..
4.13.d:
करोत्येतन्नरो भक्त्या वर्षमेकममत्सरी ॥
तस्य श्रीर्विजयश्चैव नित्यं सोमः प्रसीदति ॥97॥
4.13.m: when three months have passed, for one year, free from jealousy— / to him belong fortune and victory, and Soma is always pleased with him.

4.13.s:
etatkaroti yā kanyā śubhaṃ prāpnoti sā patim ..
durbhagā subhagā sādhvī bhavatyavidhavā sadā .. 98 ..
4.13.d:
एतत्करोति या कन्या शुभं प्राप्नोति सा पतिम् ॥
दुर्भगा सुभगा साध्वी भवत्यविधवा सदा ॥ 98 ॥
4.13.m: A maiden who performs this obtains an auspicious husband; / an unfortunate woman becomes fortunate, virtuous, and never a widow.

4.13.s:
rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
putrārthī labhate putrāniti prāha prabhākaraḥ .. 99 ..
4.13.d:
राज्यार्थी लभते राज्यं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ॥
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रानिति प्राह प्रभाकरः ॥ 99 ॥
4.13.m: One desiring a kingdom obtains a kingdom; one desiring wealth obtains wealth; / one desiring sons obtains sons: so spoke Prabhākara.

4.13.s:
yoṣitkulākulavivāhamanoramāṇi śayyānnayānaśayanāsanaśobhitāni ..
bhadrāṇyavāpya dhanaputrakalatrajāni jātismaro bhavati bhārata bhadrakartā .. 4.13.100 ..
dvitīyāvratamāhātmyavarṇanam
4.13.d:
योषित्कुलाकुलविवाहमनोरमाणि शय्यान्नयानशयनासनशोभितानि ॥
भद्राण्यवाप्य धनपुत्रकलत्रजानि जातिस्मरो भवति भारत भद्रकर्ता ॥ 4.13.100 ॥
द्वितीयाव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
4.13.m:
Having obtained auspicious things delightful with weddings of suitable lineages, / adorned with beds, food, vehicles, couches, and seats, and consisting of wealth, sons, and wives, the performer of the Bhadrā vow remembers his past lives, O Bhārata.
Description of the Greatness of the Dvitīyā Vow

4.14.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
saṃtyanyāstithayaḥ pārtha dvitīyādyāḥ pariśrutāḥ ..
māsaiścaturbhiścatvāraḥ prāvṛṭchuklāḥ klamāpahāḥ .. 1 ..
4.14.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
संत्यन्यास्तिथयः पार्थ द्वितीयाद्याः परिश्रुताः ॥
मासैश्चतुर्भिश्चत्वारः प्रावृट्छुक्लाः क्लमापहाः ॥ 1 ॥
4.14.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
There are other celebrated lunar days, O son of Pṛthā, beginning with the second,
four during the four months of the rainy season, in the bright fortnight, which dispel exhaustion.

4.14.s:
gopitāśca sadā loke na proktāśca mayā kvacit ..
prakāśayāmi tāḥ pārtha śṛṇu sarvā mayā hi tāḥ .. 2 ..
4.14.d:
गोपिताश्च सदा लोके न प्रोक्ताश्च मया क्वचित् ॥
प्रकाशयामि ताः पार्थ शृणु सर्वा मया हि ताः ॥ 2 ॥
4.14.m:
They have always been kept secret in the world and have never been spoken by me anywhere.
I shall reveal them, O son of Pṛthā; listen to them all from me.

4.14.s:
ekā tu śrāvaṇe māsi anyā bhādrapade tathā ..
aparāśvayuje māsi caturthī kārtike bhavet .. 3 ..
4.14.d:
एका तु श्रावणे मासि अन्या भाद्रपदे तथा ॥
अपराश्वयुजे मासि चतुर्थी कार्तिके भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
4.14.m:
One is in the month of Śrāvaṇa, another in Bhādrapada,
another in the month of Āśvayuja, and the fourth is in Kārtika.

4.14.s:
śrāvaṇe kaluṣā nāma proṣṭhapāde ca gīrmalā ..
āśvine pretasaṃcārā kārtike ca yamā smṛtā ..4..
4.14.d:
श्रावणे कलुषा नाम प्रोष्ठपादे च गीर्मला ॥
आश्विने प्रेतसंचारा कार्तिके च यमा स्मृता ॥4॥
4.14.m:
In Śrāvaṇa it is called Kaluṣā, and in Proṣṭhapada, Gīrmalā;
in Āśvina it is Pretasaṃcārā, and in Kārtika it is known as Yamā.

4.14.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kasmātsā kaluṣā proktā kasmātsā gīrmalā matā .
kasmātsā pretasaṃcārā kasmādyāmyā prakīrtitā .. 5 ..
4.14.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कस्मात्सा कलुषा प्रोक्ता कस्मात्सा गीर्मला मता ।
कस्मात्सा प्रेतसंचारा कस्माद्याम्या प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 5 ॥
4.14.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Why is it called Kaluṣā? Why is it considered Gīrmalā?
Why is it Pretasaṃcārā, and why is it proclaimed Yamā?

4.14.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā vṛtravadhe vṛtte prāptarājye puraṃdare ..
brahmahatyāpanodārthamaśvamedhe pravartite .. 6 ..
4.14.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा वृत्रवधे वृत्ते प्राप्तराज्ये पुरंदरे ॥
ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थमश्वमेधे प्रवर्तिते ॥ 6 ॥
4.14.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Formerly, when the slaying of Vṛtra took place and Puraṃdara attained his kingdom,
an Aśvamedha sacrifice was undertaken in order to remove the sin of killing a brahmin.

4.14.s:
krodhādindreṇa vajeṇa brahmahatyā niṣūditā ..
ṣaṭkhaṇḍā ca kṛtā kṣiptā vṛkṣe toye mahītale .. 7 ..
4.14.d:
क्रोधादिन्द्रेण वजेण ब्रह्महत्या निषूदिता ॥
षट्खण्डा च कृता क्षिप्ता वृक्षे तोये महीतले ॥ 7 ॥
4.14.m:
Out of anger, the sin of killing a brahmin was struck down by Indra with his thunderbolt,
split into six pieces, and cast into trees, water, and the surface of the earth,

4.14.s:
nāryāṃ brahmahane vahnau saṃvibhajya yathākramam ..
tatpāpaṃ śrāvaṇe vyūḍhaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ dinodaye ..8..
4.14.d:
नार्यां ब्रह्महने वह्नौ संविभज्य यथाक्रमम् ॥
तत्पापं श्रावणे व्यूढं द्वितीयायां दिनोदये ॥8॥
4.14.m:
into women, into the murderer of a brahmin, and into fire, having divided it in proper order.
That sin was washed away in Śrāvaṇa at the dawn of the second lunar day.

4.14.s:
nārīvṛkṣanadībhūmivahnibrahmahaneṣvatha ..
nirmalīkaraṇaṃ jātamatorthaṃ kaluṣā smṛtā ..9..
4.14.d:
नारीवृक्षनदीभूमिवह्निब्रह्महनेष्वथ ॥
निर्मलीकरणं जातमतोर्थं कलुषा स्मृता ॥9॥
4.14.m:
Then purification occurred in women, trees, rivers, the earth, fire, and the murderer of a brahmin;
for this reason, it is remembered as Kaluṣā.

4.14.s:
madhukaiṭabhayo rakte purā magneti medinī ..
aṣṭāṃgulā pavitrā sā nārīṇāṃ tu rajo malam .. 4.14.10 ..
4.14.d:
मधुकैटभयो रक्ते पुरा मग्नेति मेदिनी ॥
अष्टांगुला पवित्रा सा नारीणां तु रजो मलम् ॥ 4.14.10 ॥
4.14.m:
Formerly, the earth was submerged in the blood of Madhu and Kaiṭabha;
it became pure by eight finger-widths, and for women the menstrual flow is impurity.

4.14.s:
nadyaḥ pūramalāḥ sarvā vahnerdhūmaśikhā malaḥ ..
kaluṣāṇi caraṃtyasyāṃ tenaiṣā kaluṣā matā .. 11 ..
4.14.d:
नद्यः पूरमलाः सर्वा वह्नेर्धूमशिखा मलः ॥
कलुषाणि चरंत्यस्यां तेनैषा कलुषा मता ॥ 11 ॥
4.14.m:
Rivers carry floods as impurity; the column of smoke is the impurity of fire.
Impurities wander on this [day], therefore it is regarded as Kaluṣā.

4.14.s:
gīrgirā bhāratī vāṇī vācā medhā sarasvatī ..
gīrmalaṃ vahate yasmādvitīyā gīrmalā matā .. 12 ..
4.14.d:
गीर्गिरा भारती वाणी वाचा मेधा सरस्वती ॥
गीर्मलं वहते यस्माद्वितीया गीर्मला मता ॥ 12 ॥
4.14.m:
Gīr, girā, bhāratī, vāṇī, vācā, medhā, and sarasvatī [are speech].
Because this second [lunar day] bears the impurity of speech, it is considered Gīrmalā.

4.14.s:
devarṣipitṛdharmāṇāṃ niṃdakā nāstikāḥ śaṭhāḥ ..
teṣāṃ sā vāgmalavyūḍhā dvitīyā tena gīrmalā .. 13 ..
4.14.d:
देवर्षिपितृधर्माणां निंदका नास्तिकाः शठाः ॥
तेषां सा वाग्मलव्यूढा द्वितीया तेन गीर्मला ॥ 13 ॥
4.14.m:
Scoffers, atheists, and rogues who revile the gods, sages, ancestors, and dharma—
their impurities of speech are removed by it; therefore the second lunar day is Gīrmalā.

4.14.s:
anadhyāyeṣu śāstrāṇi pāṭhayaṃti paṭhaṃti ca ..
śābdikāstārkikāḥ śrautāsteṣāṃ śabdāpaśabdajāḥ .. 14 ..
malā vyūḍhā dvitīyāyāmato'rthaṃ gīrmalā ca sā ..14..
4.14.d:
अनध्यायेषु शास्त्राणि पाठयंति पठंति च ॥
शाब्दिकास्तार्किकाः श्रौतास्तेषां शब्दापशब्दजाः ॥ 14 ॥
मला व्यूढा द्वितीयायामतोऽर्थं गीर्मला च सा ॥14॥
4.14.m:
Grammarians, logicians, and Vedic scholars who study and teach the sacred texts
on days when study is forbidden—their impurities born from correct and incorrect words
are washed away on the second lunar day; therefore it is Gīrmalā.

4.14.s:
pretāstu pitaraḥ proktāsteṣāṃ tasyāṃ tu saṃcaraḥ ..
dvitīyāyāṃ ca lokeṣu tena sā pretasaṃcarā .. 15 ..
4.14.d:
प्रेतास्तु पितरः प्रोक्तास्तेषां तस्यां तु संचरः ॥
द्वितीयायां च लोकेषु तेन सा प्रेतसंचरा ॥ 15 ॥
4.14.m:
The ancestors are declared to be pretas, and their wandering takes place on that day,
on the second lunar day in the worlds; therefore it is Pretasaṃcarā.

4.14.s:
agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapāstathā .. 16 ..
pitṛpitāmahapretasaṃcarātpretasaṃcarā .. 16 ..
4.14.d:
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषद आज्यपाः सोमपास्तथा ॥ 16 ॥
पितृपितामहप्रेतसंचरात्प्रेतसंचरा ॥ 16 ॥
4.14.m:
The Agniṣvāttas, the Barhiṣads, the Ājyapas, and the Somapas—
it is called Pretasaṃcarā from the wandering of the deceased fathers and grandfathers.

4.14.s:
putraiḥ pautraiśca dauhitraiḥ svadhāmaṃtraiḥ supūjitāḥ ..
śrāddhadānamakhaistṛptā yātyataḥ pretasaṃcarāḥ .. 17 ..
4.14.d:
पुत्रैः पौत्रैश्च दौहित्रैः स्वधामंत्रैः सुपूजिताः ॥
श्राद्धदानमखैस्तृप्ता यात्यतः प्रेतसंचराः ॥ 17 ॥
4.14.m:
Well-worshipped with svadhā mantras by sons, grandsons, and daughter’s sons,
satisfied with śrāddhas, gifts, and sacrifices, the wandering ancestors depart thence.

4.14.s:
kārtike śuklapakṣasya dvitīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
yamo yamunayā pūrvaṃ bhojitaḥ svagṛhe tadā .. 18 ..
4.14.d:
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षस्य द्वितीयायां युधिष्ठिर ॥
यमो यमुनया पूर्वं भोजितः स्वगृहे तदा ॥ 18 ॥
4.14.m:
On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight in Kārtika, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
Yama was formerly fed at home by Yamunā.

4.14.s:
dvitīyāyāṃ mahotsarge nārakīyāśca tarpitāḥ ..
pāpebhyo vipramuktāste muktāḥ sarve vibaṃdhanāḥ ..
bhrāmitā nartitāstuṣṭāḥ sthitāḥ sarve yadṛcchayā ..19..
4.14.d:
द्वितीयायां महोत्सर्गे नारकीयाश्च तर्पिताः ॥
पापेभ्यो विप्रमुक्तास्ते मुक्ताः सर्वे विबंधनाः ॥
भ्रामिता नर्तितास्तुष्टाः स्थिताः सर्वे यदृच्छया ॥19॥

4.14.s:
teṣāṃ mahotsavo vṛtto yamarāṣṭre sukhāvahaḥ ..
tato yamadvitīyā sā proktā loke yudhiṣṭhira .. 4.14.20 ..
4.14.d:
तेषां महोत्सवो वृत्तो यमराष्ट्रे सुखावहः ॥
ततो यमद्वितीया सा प्रोक्ता लोके युधिष्ठिर ॥ 4.14.20 ॥
4.14.m:
A great festival took place for them, bringing happiness in Yama’s realm;
hence it is known in the world as Yama-dvitīyā, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.14.s:
asyāṃ nijagṛhe pārtha na bhoktavyamato budhaiḥ ..
snehena bhaginīhastādbhoktavyaṃ puṣṭivarddhanam .. 21 ..
4.14.d:
अस्यां निजगृहे पार्थ न भोक्तव्यमतो बुधैः ॥
स्नेहेन भगिनीहस्ताद्भोक्तव्यं पुष्टिवर्द्धनम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.14.m:
Therefore, O son of Pṛthā, the wise should not eat in their own house on this day;
out of love, one should eat from the hand of a sister, which increases strength.

4.14.s:
dānāni ca pradeyāni bhaginībhyo vidhānataḥ ..
svarṇālaṃkāravastrādyaiḥ pūjāsatkārabhojanaiḥ .. 22 ..
4.14.d:
दानानि च प्रदेयानि भगिनीभ्यो विधानतः ॥
स्वर्णालंकारवस्त्राद्यैः पूजासत्कारभोजनैः ॥ 22 ॥
4.14.m:
And gifts must be properly presented to sisters,
with gold, ornaments, garments, and so on, with worship, honour, and feasts.

4.14.s:
sarvā bhaginyaḥ saṃpūjyā abhāve pratipattigāḥ ..
pitṛvyabhaginī hastātprathamāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 23 ..
4.14.d:
सर्वा भगिन्यः संपूज्या अभावे प्रतिपत्तिगाः ॥
पितृव्यभगिनी हस्तात्प्रथमायां युधिष्ठिर ॥ 23 ॥
4.14.m:
All sisters should be worshipped, or in their absence, those treated as such:
on the first, from the hand of a paternal uncle’s sister, O Yudhiṣṭhira;

4.14.s:
mātulasya sutāhastādvitīyāyāṃ punarnṛpa ..
pitṛmātṛsvasārau ye tṛtīyāyāṃ tayoḥ karāt .. 24 ..
4.14.d:
मातुलस्य सुताहस्ताद्वितीयायां पुनर्नृप ॥
पितृमातृस्वसारौ ये तृतीयायां तयोः करात् ॥ 24 ॥
4.14.m:
on the second, O king, from the hand of a maternal uncle’s daughter;
on the third, from the hand of the two who are paternal and maternal aunts;

4.14.s:
bhoktavyaṃ sahajāyāśca bhaginyā hastataḥ param ..
sarvāsu bhaginīhastādbhoktavyaṃ balavarddhanam .. ..25..
4.14.d:
भोक्तव्यं सहजायाश्च भगिन्या हस्ततः परम् ॥
सर्वासु भगिनीहस्ताद्भोक्तव्यं बलवर्द्धनम् ॥ ॥25॥
4.14.m:
and next, one should eat from the hand of one’s own sister.
Eating from the hand of any sister promotes strength.

4.14.s:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ dharmakāmārthavarddhanam ..
vyākhyātaṃ sakalaṃ snehātsarahasyaṃ mayā tava ..26..
4.14.d:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं धर्मकामार्थवर्द्धनम् ॥
व्याख्यातं सकलं स्नेहात्सरहस्यं मया तव ॥26॥
4.14.m:
It is fortunate, brings fame, grants long life, and increases dharma, kāma, and artha.
Everything, along with the secret, has been explained by me out of love for you.

4.14.s:
yasyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarājadevaḥ sambhojito jagati sattvarasauhṛdena ..
tasyāṃ svasuḥ karatalādiha yo bhunakti prāpnoti vittamatha bhojyamanuttamaṃ saḥ .. 27 ..
aśūnyaśayanamāhātmyavarṇanam
4.14.d:
यस्यां तिथौ यमुनया यमराजदेवः सम्भोजितो जगति सत्त्वरसौहृदेन ॥
तस्यां स्वसुः करतलादिह यो भुनक्ति प्राप्नोति वित्तमथ भोज्यमनुत्तमं सः ॥ 27 ॥
अशून्यशयनमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
4.14.m:
On that lunar day when Lord Yamarāja was served food in the world by Yamunā with quick affection,
whoever eats here from the palm of his sister's hand obtains wealth and peerless food.
Description of the Greatness of the Aśūnyaśayana [Vrata]

4.15.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavanbhavatā proktaṃ dharmārthādeḥ susādhanam ..
gārhasthyaṃ tacca bhavati daṃpatyoḥ prīyamāṇayoḥ .. 1 ..
4.15.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्भवता प्रोक्तं धर्मार्थादेः सुसाधनम् ॥
गार्हस्थ्यं तच्च भवति दंपत्योः प्रीयमाणयोः ॥ 1 ॥
4.15.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Lord, you have spoken of the householder's life as the excellent means to attain dharma, artha, and the rest,
and that is achieved when husband and wife are mutually affectionate.

4.15.s:
patnīhīnaḥ pumānpatnī bhartrā virahitā tathā ..
dharmakāmārthasaṃsiddhī na syātāṃ madhusūdana .. 2.
4.15.d:
पत्नीहीनः पुमान्पत्नी भर्त्रा विरहिता तथा ॥
धर्मकामार्थसंसिद्धी न स्यातां मधुसूदन ॥ 2.
4.15.m:
A man without a wife, and likewise a wife deprived of her husband,
would not attain success in dharma, kāma, and artha, O Madhusūdana.

4.15.s:
tadbrūhi devadeveśa vidhavā strī na jāyate ..
vratena yena goviṃda patnyā'virahito naraḥ .. 3 ..
4.15.d:
तद्ब्रूहि देवदेवेश विधवा स्त्री न जायते ॥
व्रतेन येन गोविंद पत्न्याऽविरहितो नरः ॥ 3 ॥
4.15.m:
Therefore, O Lord of the gods of gods, tell [me] that vrata by which a woman does not become a widow,
and a man, O Govinda, is not separated from his wife.

4.15.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
aśūnyaśayanīṃ nāma dvitīyāṃ śṛṇu tāṃ mama ..
yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prāpnoti strī yudhiṣṭhira .. 4 ..
4.15.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अशून्यशयनीं नाम द्वितीयां शृणु तां मम ॥
यामुपोष्य न वैधव्यं प्राप्नोति स्त्री युधिष्ठिर ॥ 4 ॥
4.15.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Hear from me of that second lunar day called Aśūnyaśayanī,
observing a fast upon which, a woman does not incur widowhood, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

4.15.s:
patnīvimuktaśca naro na kadācitprajāyate ..
śete jagatpatirviṣṇuḥ striyā sārddhaṃ yadā kila .. 5 ..
4.15.d:
पत्नीविमुक्तश्च नरो न कदाचित्प्रजायते ॥
शेते जगत्पतिर्विष्णुः स्त्रिया सार्द्धं यदा किल ॥ 5 ॥
4.15.m:
nor is a man ever abandoned by his wife.
When indeed Viṣṇu, Lord of the Universe, sleeps with his wife,

4.15.s:
aśūnyaśayanaṃ nāma tadā grāhyā ca sā tithiḥ ..
upavāsena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca .. 6 ..
4.15.d:
अशून्यशयनं नाम तदा ग्राह्या च सा तिथिः ॥
उपवासेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च ॥ 6 ॥
4.15.m:
that lunar day is then to be observed as Aśūnyaśayana,
by fasting, by eating only at night, or by consuming only unasked-for food.

4.15.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇe nṛpasattama ..
snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān .. 7 ..
4.15.d:
कृष्णपक्षे द्वितीयायां श्रावणे नृपसत्तम ॥
स्नानं नद्यां तडागे वा गृहे वा नियतात्मवान् ॥ 7 ॥
4.15.m:
On the second lunar day of the dark fortnight in Śrāvaṇa, O best of kings,
having bathed in a river, a pond, or at home, self-controlled,

4.15.s:
kṛtvā pitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca devānsaṃ tarpya bhaktimān ..
sthaṃḍilaṃ caturasraṃ tu mṛnmayaṃ kārayettataḥ .. 8 ..
4.15.d:
कृत्वा पितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च देवान्सं तर्प्य भक्तिमान् ॥
स्थंडिलं चतुरस्रं तु मृन्मयं कारयेत्ततः ॥ 8 ॥
4.15.m:
and having gratified the ancestors, humans, and gods with devotion,
one should then construct a four-sided earthen altar.

4.15.s:
tatrasthaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīśaṃ bhaktyābhyarcya śriyā saha ..
naivedyapuṣpadhūpādyaiḥ phalaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 9 ..
4.15.d:
तत्रस्थं श्रीधरं श्रीशं भक्त्याभ्यर्च्य श्रिया सह ॥
नैवेद्यपुष्पधूपाद्यैः फलैः कालोद्भवैः शुभैः ॥ 9 ॥
4.15.m:
There, having worshipped with devotion Śrīdhara, Lord of Śrī, together with Śrī,
with offerings of food, flowers, incense, and auspicious seasonal fruits,

4.15.s:
imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ praṇamya jagataḥ patim ..
śrīvatsadhāriñchrīkāṃta śrīdhāmañchrīpate'vyaya .. 4.15.10 ..
4.15.d:
इममुच्चारयेन्मंत्रं प्रणम्य जगतः पतिम् ॥
श्रीवत्सधारिञ्छ्रीकांत श्रीधामञ्छ्रीपतेऽव्यय ॥ 4.15.10 ॥
4.15.m:
bowing to the Lord of the Universe, one should recite this mantra:
'O wearer of the Śrīvatsa, O beloved of Śrī, O abode of Śrī, O Lord of Śrī, O imperishable one!

4.15.s:
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadam ..
agnayo mā praṇaśyaṃtu mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ ..
pitaro mā praṇaśyaṃtu matto dāṃpatyabhedataḥ ..11..
4.15.d:
गार्हस्थ्यं मा प्रणाशं मे यातु धर्मार्थकामदम् ॥
अग्नयो मा प्रणश्यंतु मा प्रणश्यन्तु देवताः ॥
पितरो मा प्रणश्यंतु मत्तो दांपत्यभेदतः ॥11॥

4.15.s:
lakṣmyā viyujyate kṛṣṇa na kadācidyathā bhavān ..
tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me praṇaśyatu .. 12 ..
4.15.d:
लक्ष्म्या वियुज्यते कृष्ण न कदाचिद्यथा भवान् ॥
तथा कलत्रसम्बन्धो देव मा मे प्रणश्यतु ॥ 12 ॥
4.15.m:
Just as you, O Kṛṣṇa, are never separated from Lakṣmī,
so, O God, may my union with my wife never perish!'

4.15.s:
lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ sadā ..
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmanijanmani .. 13 ..
4.15.d:
लक्ष्म्या न शून्यं वरद यथा ते शयनं सदा ॥
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ 13 ॥
4.15.m: O giver of boons, just as your bed is never devoid of Lakṣmī, / so may my bed also never be devoid [of a spouse] in birth after birth.

4.15.s:
evaṃ prasādya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā lakṣmyā harestathā ..
candrodaye snānapūrvaṃ pañcagavyena saṃyutam ..
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsva śaktyā phalasaṃyutām .. 14 ..
4.15.d:
एवं प्रसाद्य पूजां च कृत्वा लक्ष्म्या हरेस्तथा ॥
चन्द्रोदये स्नानपूर्वं पञ्चगव्येन संयुतम् ॥
विप्राय दक्षिणां दद्यात्स्व शक्त्या फलसंयुताम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.15.m: Having thus propitiated [them] and worshipped Lakṣmī and Hari, / at moonrise, preceded by bathing and together with the five products of the cow, / one should give a sacrificial fee to a brahmin according to one's capacity, along with fruit.

4.15.s:
anenavidhinā rājanyāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ prāguktavidhimācaret .. 15 ..
4.15.d:
अनेनविधिना राजन्यावन्मासचतुष्टयम् ॥
कृष्णपक्षे द्वितीयायां प्रागुक्तविधिमाचरेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.15.m: By this procedure, O king, for four months, / on the second day of the dark fortnight, one should perform the rite mentioned earlier.

4.15.s:
kārttike cātha saṃprāpte śayyāṃ śrīkāṃtasaṃyutām ..
sopaskarāṃ sodakuṃbhāṃ sānnāṃ dadyāddvijātaye .. 16 ..
4.15.d:
कार्त्तिके चाथ संप्राप्ते शय्यां श्रीकांतसंयुताम् ॥
सोपस्करां सोदकुंभां सान्नां दद्याद्द्विजातये ॥ 16 ॥
4.15.m: And when Kārttika arrives, one should give a bed accompanied by [an image of] the husband of Śrī, / provided with furnishings, a water-pot, and cooked food, to a twice-born man.

4.15.s:
pratimāsaṃ ca somāya arghyaṃ dadyātsamaṃtrakam ..
dadhyakṣatairmūla phalai ratnaiḥ sauvarṇabhājanaiḥ .. 17 ..
4.15.d:
प्रतिमासं च सोमाय अर्घ्यं दद्यात्समंत्रकम् ॥
दध्यक्षतैर्मूल फलै रत्नैः सौवर्णभाजनैः ॥ 17 ॥
4.15.m: And each month one should offer an arghya to Soma with mantras, / with curd, unbroken rice grains, roots, fruits, and jewels, using golden vessels:

4.15.s:
gaganāṃgaṇasaddīpa durābdhimathanodbhava ..
ābhāsitadigābhoga ramānuja namostu te .. 18 ..
4.15.d:
गगनांगणसद्दीप दुराब्धिमथनोद्भव ॥
आभासितदिगाभोग रमानुज नमोस्तु ते ॥ 18 ॥
4.15.m: “O noble lamp in the courtyard of the sky, born of the churning of the milk ocean, / O illuminator of the expanse of the directions, O younger brother of Ramā, reverence to you!”

4.15.s:
evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyaṅnaro māsacatuṣṭayam ..
tasya janmatrayaṃ yāvadgṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate .. 19 ..
4.15.d:
एवं करोति यः सम्यङ्नरो मासचतुष्टयम् ॥
तस्य जन्मत्रयं यावद्गृहभङ्गो न जायते ॥ 19 ॥
4.15.m: A man who performs this properly for four months / suffers no destruction of his household for three lifetimes.

4.15.s:
aśūnyaśayanaścaiva dharmakāmārthasādhakaḥ ..
bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 4.15.20 ..
4.15.d:
अशून्यशयनश्चैव धर्मकामार्थसाधकः ॥
भवत्यव्याहतैश्वर्यः पुरुषो नात्र संशयः ॥ 4.15.20 ॥
4.15.m: His bed is never empty, he accomplishes virtue, desire, and wealth, / and his prosperity remains unimpeded—a man becomes such; of this there is no doubt.

4.15.s:
nārī ca pārtha dharmajñā vratametadyathāvidhi ..
yā karoti na sā śocyā bandhuvargasya jāyate .. 21 ..
4.15.d:
नारी च पार्थ धर्मज्ञा व्रतमेतद्यथाविधि ॥
या करोति न सा शोच्या बन्धुवर्गस्य जायते ॥ 21 ॥
4.15.m: And a woman, O Pārtha, who knows dharma and performs this votive observance according to rule, / does not become a source of sorrow for her circle of kin.

4.15.s:
vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca bhartṛtyāgaṃ ca sattama ..
prāpnoti janmatritayaṃ na sā pāṃḍukulodvaha .. 22 ..
4.15.d:
वैधव्यं दुर्भगत्वं च भर्तृत्यागं च सत्तम ॥
प्राप्नोति जन्मत्रितयं न सा पांडुकुलोद्वह ॥ 22 ॥
4.15.m: Widowhood, misfortune, and abandonment by a husband— / these she does not encounter for three lifetimes, O best of men, O uplifter of the Pāṇḍu lineage.

4.15.s:
eṣā hyaśūnyaśayanā nṛpate dvitīyā khyātā samastakaluṣāpaharā'dvitīyā ..
etāṃ samācarati yaḥ puruṣo'tha yoṣitprāpnotyasau śayanamagryamahārhabhogyam .. 23 ..
madhūkatṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
4.15.d:
एषा ह्यशून्यशयना नृपते द्वितीया ख्याता समस्तकलुषापहराऽद्वितीया ॥
एतां समाचरति यः पुरुषोऽथ योषित्प्राप्नोत्यसौ शयनमग्र्यमहार्हभोग्यम् ॥ 23 ॥
मधूकतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.15.m:
Indeed, O king, this is celebrated as the Aśūnyaśayanā Dvitīyā, unequalled, dispelling all sins; / whatever man or woman observes it attains an excellent bed worthy of high enjoyment.
Description of the Madhūkatṛtīyā Votive Observance

4.16.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
phālgune'pyasite pakṣe tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitā ..
prātaḥ sthitvā brahmacarye jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitā .. 1 ..
4.16.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
फाल्गुनेऽप्यसिते पक्षे तृतीयायामुपोषिता ॥
प्रातः स्थित्वा ब्रह्मचर्ये जटामुकुटशोभिता ॥ 1 ॥
4.16.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Fasting also on the third lunar day in the dark fortnight of Phālguna, / abiding in chastity in the morning, adorned with a crest of matted hair,

4.16.s:
godhārathagatāṃ devīṃ rudradhyānaparāyaṇām ..
pūjayedgandhakusumairdīpālaktakacaṃdanaiḥ ..
kesarairmadhurairdravyaiḥ svarṇamāṇikyapūjayā .. 2 ..
4.16.d:
गोधारथगतां देवीं रुद्रध्यानपरायणाम् ॥
पूजयेद्गन्धकुसुमैर्दीपालक्तकचंदनैः ॥
केसरैर्मधुरैर्द्रव्यैः स्वर्णमाणिक्यपूजया ॥ 2 ॥
4.16.m: one should worship the goddess mounted on an iguana-chariot, devoted to meditation on Rudra, / with perfumes, flowers, lamps, red lac, sandal-paste, / saffron, sweet substances, and an offering of gold and rubies:

4.16.s:
oṃ bhūṣikā devabhūṣā ca bhūṣikā lalitā umā ..
tapovanaratā gaurī saubhāgyaṃ me prayacchatu .. 3 ..
4.16.d:
ओं भूषिका देवभूषा च भूषिका ललिता उमा ॥
तपोवनरता गौरी सौभाग्यं मे प्रयच्छतु ॥ 3 ॥
4.16.m: “Oṃ, O Adorner, O Ornament of the gods, O Lalitā, O Umā, / O Gaurī delighting in the penance grove, grant me good fortune!

4.16.s:
daurbhāgyaṃ me śamayatu suprasannamanāḥ sadā ..
avaidhavyaṃ kule janma dadātvaparajanmani .. 4 ..
4.16.d:
दौर्भाग्यं मे शमयतु सुप्रसन्नमनाः सदा ॥
अवैधव्यं कुले जन्म ददात्वपरजन्मनि ॥ 4 ॥
4.16.m: May she, with an ever gracious mind, pacify my misfortune; / may she grant me freedom from widowhood and birth in a noble lineage in the next life.

4.16.s:
aṅgeṅge ca mamopāṅge parvepave sthitāmṛtam ..
sukhadṛṣṭisparśarasaṃ gaurī saubhāgyaṃ yacchatu .. 5 ..
4.16.d:
अङ्गेङ्गे च ममोपाङ्गे पर्वेपवे स्थितामृतम् ॥
सुखदृष्टिस्पर्शरसं गौरी सौभाग्यं यच्छतु ॥ 5 ॥
4.16.m: In my every limb, sub-limb, and joint, where nectar resides, / may Gaurī grant good fortune endowed with the pleasure of sight, touch, and taste!”

4.16.s:
evamuccārya maṃtrāṃśca nārījñānavatī satī ..
pūjayedbrāhmaṇoktaistu maṃtrairmukhasuvāsinī .. 6 ..
4.16.d:
एवमुच्चार्य मंत्रांश्च नारीज्ञानवती सती ॥
पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणोक्तैस्तु मंत्रैर्मुखसुवासिनी ॥ 6 ॥
4.16.m: Having uttered these mantras, the wise, virtuous woman, / sweet-faced, should worship [her] with the mantras spoken by the brahmins,

4.16.s:
jīrakaiḥ kaṭuhuṇḍaiśca lavaṇairguḍasarpiṣā ..
hṛdyairārdraiḥ phalaiḥ svarṇairmanojñaiḥ puṣpabandhanaiḥ .. 7 ..
4.16.d:
जीरकैः कटुहुण्डैश्च लवणैर्गुडसर्पिषा ॥
हृद्यैरार्द्रैः फलैः स्वर्णैर्मनोज्ञैः पुष्पबन्धनैः ॥ 7 ॥
4.16.m: with cumin, bitter gourds, salts, jaggery, and ghee, / with agreeable fresh fruits, gold, and delightful flower garlands,

4.16.s:
kusumaiḥ. kuṃkumairgandhaiḥ kāleyāgurucandanaiḥ ..
sindūreṇātiraktena vastrairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 8 ..
4.16.d:
कुसुमैः। कुंकुमैर्गन्धैः कालेयागुरुचन्दनैः ॥
सिन्दूरेणातिरक्तेन वस्त्रैर्नानाविधैः शुभैः ॥ 8 ॥
4.16.m: with blossoms, saffron, perfumes, kāleya, agallochum, and sandalwood, / with very red vermilion and various auspicious garments,
with silk cloths born of many lands, cakes, sesamum and rice grains, / with aśoka flowers, doubled pastries, and sweetmeats filled with ghee.

4.16.s:
ityevamādinaivedyaiḥ pūjayitvā mahādrumam ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām .. 4.16.10 ..
4.16.d:
इत्येवमादिनैवेद्यैः पूजयित्वा महाद्रुमम् ॥
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥ 4.16.10 ॥
4.16.m: Having worshipped the great tree with these and other offerings, / and then circumambulating it and giving a sacrificial fee to a brahmin,

4.16.s:
etatkaroti yā putrī tṛtīyāvratamuttamam ..
tataḥ prāpsyati duṣprāpyaṃ trailokye śrīdharaṃ prati .. 11 ..
4.16.d:
एतत्करोति या पुत्री तृतीयाव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
ततः प्राप्स्यति दुष्प्राप्यं त्रैलोक्ये श्रीधरं प्रति ॥ 11 ॥
4.16.m: whatever daughter performs this excellent votive observance of the third lunar day / will thereafter attain Śrīdhara, who is difficult to attain in the three worlds.

4.16.s:
etadvrataṃ mayā khyātaṃ yāsyaṃti śāśvatīḥ samā ..
vyākhyātaṃ kaśyapenādau rukmiṇyā vratamuttamam .. 12 ..
4.16.d:
एतद्व्रतं मया ख्यातं यास्यंति शाश्वतीः समा ॥
व्याख्यातं कश्यपेनादौ रुक्मिण्या व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.16.m: This votive observance has been proclaimed by me; they shall live for eternal years. / This excellent votive observance was initially explained by Kaśyapa to Rukmiṇī.

4.16.s:
yāścariṣyaṃti tāḥ sarvā bhaviṣyaṃti nirāmayāḥ ..
aṅgapratyaṅgasubhagā lokadṛṣṭimanoharāḥ .. .. 11 ..
4.16.d:
याश्चरिष्यंति ताः सर्वा भविष्यंति निरामयाः ॥
अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसुभगा लोकदृष्टिमनोहराः ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
4.16.m: All those women who perform it will be free from disease, / charming in every major and minor limb, and captivating to the sight of the world.

4.16.s:
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ cānte tato rudrapuraṃ śubham ..
yāsyaṃti haṃsayānena kiṃkiṇīśabdanādinā .. 14 ..
4.16.d:
स्थित्वा वर्षशतं चान्ते ततो रुद्रपुरं शुभम् ॥
यास्यंति हंसयानेन किंकिणीशब्दनादिना ॥ 14 ॥
4.16.m: And having lived for a hundred years, at the end they will go to Rudra's auspicious city / on a swan-borne vehicle ringing with the tinkling of small bells.

4.16.s:
tatra tvāramayiṣyaṃti svabhartṝnvatsarānbahūn ..
divyabhogabhujo hṛṣṭāḥ siddhyaṣṭakasamanvitāḥ .. 19 ..
4.16.d:
तत्र त्वारमयिष्यंति स्वभर्तॄन्वत्सरान्बहून् ॥
दिव्यभोगभुजो हृष्टाः सिद्ध्यष्टकसमन्विताः ॥ 19 ॥
4.16.m: There, enjoying divine pleasures, joyful and endowed with the eight supernormal powers, / they will delight their husbands for many years.

4.16.s:
arghaṃ mahārghamaṇikuṃkumakesarāḍhyaṃ sraggaṃdhamugdhamukharāli kulopagītam ..
dattvā phalākṣatayutaṃ madhupādapasya gaurīva lokamahitā bhavatīha nārī .. 16 ..
meghapālītṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
4.16.d:
अर्घं महार्घमणिकुंकुमकेसराढ्यं स्रग्गंधमुग्धमुखरालि कुलोपगीतम् ॥
दत्त्वा फलाक्षतयुतं मधुपादपस्य गौरीव लोकमहिता भवतीह नारी ॥ 16 ॥
मेघपालीतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.16.m:
Having offered an argha rich in costly gems, saffron, and filaments, praised by swarms of humming bees captivated by garlands and perfumes, / together with fruit and unbroken rice grains, to the madhūka tree, a woman becomes honoured in this world like Gaurī.
Description of the Meghapālītṛtīyā Votive Observance

4.17.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
meghapālīvrata kṛṣṇa kadācitkriyate nṛbhiḥ ..
kiṃ puṇyaṃ kimanuṣṭhānaṃ kīdṛgvallī smṛtā tu sā .. 1 ..
4.17.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
मेघपालीव्रत कृष्ण कदाचित्क्रियते नृभिः ॥
किं पुण्यं किमनुष्ठानं कीदृग्वल्ली स्मृता तु सा ॥ 1 ॥
4.17.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
When is the Meghapālī votive observance performed by men, O Kṛṣṇa? / What is its merit? What is its practice? And what kind of creeper is that celebrated to be?

4.17.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
meghapālyai pradātavyo bhaktyā strībhirnṛbhistathā .. 2 ..
4.17.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आश्वयुक्कृष्णपक्षे तु तृतीयायां युधिष्ठिर ॥
मेघपाल्यै प्रदातव्यो भक्त्या स्त्रीभिर्नृभिस्तथा ॥ 2 ॥
4.17.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
On the third lunar day in the dark fortnight of Āśvayuja, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / an offering must be presented to Meghapālī with devotion by women and men alike.

4.17.s:
argho virūḍhairgodhūmaiḥ saptadhānyasamanvitaiḥ ..
tilataṃḍulapiṃḍairvā dātavyo dharmalipsubhiḥ .. 3 ..
4.17.d:
अर्घो विरूढैर्गोधूमैः सप्तधान्यसमन्वितैः ॥
तिलतंडुलपिंडैर्वा दातव्यो धर्मलिप्सुभिः ॥ 3 ॥
4.17.m: An argha must be given with sprouted wheat mixed with the seven grains, / or with balls of sesamum and rice grains, by those who desire dharma.

4.17.s:
tāṃbūlasadṛśaiḥ parvai raktā vallī samaṃjarī ..
vāṭīṣu grāmamārgeṣu protthitā parvate'pi ca ..4..
4.17.d:
तांबूलसदृशैः पर्वै रक्ता वल्ली समंजरी ॥
वाटीषु ग्राममार्गेषु प्रोत्थिता पर्वतेऽपि च ॥4॥
4.17.m: It is a red creeper with clusters of flowers, with joints resembling betel leaves, / growing in gardens, village roads, and also on mountains.

4.17.s:
meghapālyāṃ dhānyatailaguḍakuṃkumahaimanān ..
padānapi ca kurvaṃti janā vāṇijyajīvanāḥ .. 5 ..
4.17.d:
मेघपाल्यां धान्यतैलगुडकुंकुमहैमनान् ॥
पदानपि च कुर्वंति जना वाणिज्यजीवनाः ॥ 5 ॥
4.17.m: On Meghapālī, people living by commerce make / payments of grain, oil, jaggery, saffron, and gold.

4.17.s:
pāpaṃ satyānṛtaṃ kṛtvā dravyalubdhāḥ phalānvitāḥ ..
arghyaṃ dattvā meghapālye nāśayaṃti kṣaṇādiha .. 6 ..
4.17.d:
पापं सत्यानृतं कृत्वा द्रव्यलुब्धाः फलान्विताः ॥
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा मेघपाल्ये नाशयंति क्षणादिह ॥ 6 ॥
4.17.m: Those greedy for wealth who have committed sin consisting of truth and falsehood, / having offered an arghya with fruits to Meghapālī, destroy it here in an instant.

4.17.s:
mānonmānairjanma madhye yatpāpaṃ kutracitkṛtam ..
satsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti vratenānena pāṃḍava .. 7 ..
4.17.d:
मानोन्मानैर्जन्म मध्ये यत्पापं कुत्रचित्कृतम् ॥
सत्सर्वं नाशमायाति व्रतेनानेन पांडव ॥ 7 ॥
4.17.m: Whatever sin has been committed anywhere in one's life through weights and measures, / all that goes to destruction through this votive observance, O Pāṇḍava.

4.17.s:
meghapālī śubhe sthāne śubhe deśe samutthitā ..
pūjanīyā varastrībhiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistathākṣataiḥ .. 8 ..
4.17.d:
मेघपाली शुभे स्थाने शुभे देशे समुत्थिता ॥
पूजनीया वरस्त्रीभिः फलैः पुष्पैस्तथाक्षतैः ॥ 8 ॥
4.17.m: Meghapālī, arisen in an auspicious spot, in an auspicious place, / is to be worshipped by noble women with fruits, flowers, and unbroken rice grains,
with dates and coconuts, pomegranates and oleanders, / with perfumes, incenses, curds, lamps, and heaps of sprouted grains.

4.17.s:
raktavastraiḥ samācchādya piṣṭātakavibhūṣitām ..
kṛtvārghyaḥ saṃpradātavyo maṃtreṇānena bhārata .. 4.17.10 ..
4.17.d:
रक्तवस्त्रैः समाच्छाद्य पिष्टातकविभूषिताम् ॥
कृत्वार्घ्यः संप्रदातव्यो मंत्रेणानेन भारत ॥ 4.17.10 ॥
4.17.m: Covering it with red cloths and decorating it with piṣṭātaka powder, / having prepared the arghya, it is to be offered with this mantra, O Bhārata;

4.17.s:
vedoktena dvijo vidvāṃstacca tasyai nivedayet ..
ityevaṃ pūjayitvā tāṃ meghapālīṃ pumāṃstataḥ .. 11 ..
4.17.d:
वेदोक्तेन द्विजो विद्वांस्तच्च तस्यै निवेदयेत् ॥
इत्येवं पूजयित्वा तां मेघपालीं पुमांस्ततः ॥ 11 ॥
4.17.m: the learned twice-born should offer that to her with a Vedic mantra. / Having thus worshipped that Meghapālī, a man then...

4.17.s:
nārī vā puruṣavyāghra prāpnoti paramāṃ śriyam ..
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye sukhasaubhāgyagarvite .. 12 ..
4.17.d:
नारी वा पुरुषव्याघ्र प्राप्नोति परमां श्रियम् ॥
स्थित्वा वर्षशतं मर्त्ये सुखसौभाग्यगर्विते ॥ 12 ॥
4.17.m: or a woman, O tiger among men, attains supreme fortune. / Having dwelt for a hundred years in the mortal world, proud of happiness and good fortune,

4.17.s:
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti dehāṃte yānasaṃsthitaḥ ..
kulāni sapta nayati svargaṃ svāni rasātalāt ..
uddhṛtya nātra saṃdehastvayā kāryo yudhiṣṭhira .. 13 ..
4.17.d:
विष्णुलोकमवाप्नोति देहांते यानसंस्थितः ॥
कुलानि सप्त नयति स्वर्गं स्वानि रसातलात् ॥
उद्धृत्य नात्र संदेहस्त्वया कार्यो युधिष्ठिर ॥ 13 ॥
4.17.m: at the end of the body, seated on a celestial vehicle, they reach the world of Viṣṇu. / They lead seven generations of their family to heaven, lifting them up from the underworld; / you should entertain no doubt about this, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.17.s:
naraka bhīrutayā dadāti yo'rghyaṃ phalādyanuyutaṃ nanu meghapāleḥ ..
unmānakūṭakapaṭāni kṛtāni yāni pāpāni haṃti saviteva tamaḥ prarohān .. 14 ..
rūparambhāvratavarṇanam
4.17.d:
नरक भीरुतया ददाति योऽर्घ्यं फलाद्यनुयुतं ननु मेघपालेः ॥
उन्मानकूटकपटानि कृतानि यानि पापानि हंति सवितेव तमः प्ररोहान् ॥ 14 ॥
रूपरम्भाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.17.m:
Whoever, out of fear of hell, offers an arghya endowed with fruit and other [gifts] to Meghapālī, / destroys sins committed through falsifying weights and dishonest deceit, just as the sun destroys shoots of darkness.
Description of the Rūparambhā Votive Observance

4.18.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
strīṇāṃ saṃpadyate yena martyaloke gṛhaṃ śubham ..
patiprema tathātyaṃtaṃ tanme brūhi vrataṃ śubham .. 1 ..
4.18.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
स्त्रीणां संपद्यते येन मर्त्यलोके गृहं शुभम् ॥
पतिप्रेम तथात्यंतं तन्मे ब्रूहि व्रतं शुभम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.18.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me that auspicious votive observance by which an auspicious household / and boundless love of a husband are obtained for women in the mortal world.

4.18.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ekadā pārvatīśaṃbhū sthitau munisurāvṛtau ..
kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite .. 2 ..
4.18.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
एकदा पार्वतीशंभू स्थितौ मुनिसुरावृतौ ॥
कैलासशिखरे रम्ये नानाधातुविचित्रिते ॥ 2 ॥
4.18.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Once, Pārvatī and Śaṃbhu were seated, surrounded by sages and gods, / on the delightful peak of Kailāsa, variegated with manifold minerals,

4.18.s:
nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite ..
munikinnara saṃghuṣṭe geyanṛtyasamākule .. 3 ..
4.18.d:
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णे नानापुष्पोपशोभिते ॥
मुनिकिन्नर संघुष्टे गेयनृत्यसमाकुले ॥ 3 ॥
4.18.m: abounding with various trees and creepers, adorned with diverse flowers, / resounded by sages and kinnaras, and filled with song and dance.

4.18.s:
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha kiṃ tvayā sadvrataṃ kṛtam ..
vāmārūpeṇa metyaṃtaṃ priyāsi varavarṇini .. 4 ..
4.18.d:
शंकरः पार्वतीं प्राह किं त्वया सद्व्रतं कृतम् ॥
वामारूपेण मेत्यंतं प्रियासि वरवर्णिनि ॥ 4 ॥
4.18.m: Śaṃkara said to Pārvatī: 'What good votive observance was performed by you? / In your fair form, you are exceedingly dear to me, O woman of excellent complexion!

4.18.s:
āgaccha jānudeśaṃ tu suprasannā tathā priye ..
brūhi cāvitathaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā pārvati yatkṛtam .. 5 ..
4.18.d:
आगच्छ जानुदेशं तु सुप्रसन्ना तथा प्रिये ॥
ब्रूहि चावितथं सर्वं त्वया पार्वति यत्कृतम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.18.m: Come, sit upon my knee, well-pleased, O dear one; / and tell without falsehood everything that was done by you, O Pārvatī.'

4.18.s:
ityuktā praṇatā bhūtvā gaurī prāha śivaṃ śubhā ..
tṛtīyāyāṃ mayā cīrṇaṃ purā raṃbhāvrataṃ śubham .. 6 ..
4.18.d:
इत्युक्ता प्रणता भूत्वा गौरी प्राह शिवं शुभा ॥
तृतीयायां मया चीर्णं पुरा रंभाव्रतं शुभम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.18.m: Thus addressed, the auspicious Gaurī bowed and spoke to Śiva: / 'In ancient times, on the third lunar day, I observed the auspicious Rambhā votive observance.

4.18.s:
tena me tvaṃ manohārī bhartā labdhosi śaṃkara..
īśvarī vāpyahaṃ strīṇāṃ tava dehārddhahāriṇī .. 7 ..
4.18.d:
तेन मे त्वं मनोहारी भर्ता लब्धोसि शंकर॥
ईश्वरी वाप्यहं स्त्रीणां तव देहार्द्धहारिणी ॥ 7 ॥
4.18.m: By that, you, who captivate the mind, were obtained by me as husband, O Śaṃkara, / and I became the sovereign lady among women, sharing half of your body.'

4.18.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ bhadre sarvasaukhyapradāyakam ..
brūhi pārvati yatnena yaccīrṇaṃ pituraṃtike .. 8 ..
4.18.d:
॥ ईश्वर उवाच ॥ ॥
कीदृशं तद्व्रतं भद्रे सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकम् ॥
ब्रूहि पार्वति यत्नेन यच्चीर्णं पितुरंतिके ॥ 8 ॥
4.18.m: The Lord said: / 'Of what kind is that votive observance, O blessed one, which bestows all happiness? / Tell carefully, O Pārvatī, what was observed [by you] near your father.'

4.18.s:
.. gauryuvāca ..
purāhaṃ deva tiṣṭhāmi kumārī bhavane pituḥ ..
himavadgahvare ramye sakhīgaṇasamāvṛtā .. 9 ..
4.18.d:
॥ गौर्युवाच ॥
पुराहं देव तिष्ठामि कुमारी भवने पितुः ॥
हिमवद्गह्वरे रम्ये सखीगणसमावृता ॥ 9 ॥
4.18.m: Gaurī said: / 'In ancient times, O Lord, I stayed as a maiden in my father's house, / in a delightful cave of the Himalayas, surrounded by a company of female companions.

4.18.s:
tato'haṃ menayā proktā svapitrā ca himādriṇā ..
putri rabhāvrataṃ cāryaṃ varasaubhāgyavardhanam .. 4.18.10 ..
4.18.d:
ततोऽहं मेनया प्रोक्ता स्वपित्रा च हिमाद्रिणा ॥
पुत्रि रभाव्रतं चार्यं वरसौभाग्यवर्धनम् ॥ 4.18.10 ॥
4.18.m: Then I was told by Menā and by my father, the snow-mountain: / "O daughter, observe the Rambhā votive observance, which increases excellent good fortune,

4.18.s:
yena prārabdhamātreṇa sarvaṃ saṃpatsyate tava ..
saubhāgyaṃ strīgaṇaiśvaryaṃ mahādevīpadaṃ tathā .. 11 ..
4.18.d:
येन प्रारब्धमात्रेण सर्वं संपत्स्यते तव ॥
सौभाग्यं स्त्रीगणैश्वर्यं महादेवीपदं तथा ॥ 11 ॥
4.18.m: by merely beginning which everything will be attained by you: / good fortune, sovereignty over groups of women, and the status of Mahādevī."

4.18.s:
evaṃ karomi vai mātarmama coktaṃ purastvayā ..
manobhilaṣitaṃ yena yena prāpnomi śaṃkaram .. 12
4.18.d:
एवं करोमि वै मातर्मम चोक्तं पुरस्त्वया ॥
मनोभिलषितं येन येन प्राप्नोमि शंकरम् ॥ 12
4.18.m: "I shall do so indeed, O mother," I replied, "as told by you before me, / so that my heart's desire [is fulfilled], by which I may attain Śaṃkara."

4.18.s:
.. menovāca ..
adya śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ snātvā niyamatatparā ..
kuru pārśveṣu pañcāgnīñjvālamānānhutāśanān .. 13 ..
4.18.d:
॥ मेनोवाच ॥
अद्य शुक्लतृतीयायां स्नात्वा नियमतत्परा ॥
कुरु पार्श्वेषु पञ्चाग्नीञ्ज्वालमानान्हुताशनान् ॥ 13 ॥
4.18.m: Menā said: / 'Today, on the bright third lunar day, having bathed and devoted to religious restrictions, / arrange five blazing fire-offerings around you on every side:

4.18.s:
gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgnimanyaṃ cāhavanīyakam ..
paṃcamaṃ bhāskaraṃ teja ityete paṃca vahnayaḥ .. 14 ..
4.18.d:
गार्हपत्यं दक्षिणाग्निमन्यं चाहवनीयकम् ॥
पंचमं भास्करं तेज इत्येते पंच वह्नयः ॥ 14 ॥
4.18.m: the Gārhapatya, the Dakṣiṇāgni, and the other, the Āhavanīya; / the fifth is the brilliance of the sun; these are the five fires.

4.18.s:
eteṣāṃ madhyato bhūtvā tiṣṭha pūrvamukhā ciram ..
caturbhujāṃ dhyānaparāṃ paddvayopari saṃsthitām .. 15 ..
4.18.d:
एतेषां मध्यतो भूत्वा तिष्ठ पूर्वमुखा चिरम् ॥
चतुर्भुजां ध्यानपरां पद्द्वयोपरि संस्थिताम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.18.m: Standing in the midst of these, facing east, remain for a long time. / Facing the goddess, who has four arms, is intent on meditation, standing upon both feet,

4.18.s:
mṛgājinacchannakucāṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇīm ..
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ devīmabhimukhīṃ kuru .. 16 ..
4.18.d:
मृगाजिनच्छन्नकुचां जटावल्कलधारिणीम् ॥
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तां देवीमभिमुखीं कुरु ॥ 16 ॥
4.18.m: her breasts covered with deer skin, wearing matted hair and bark garments, / and adorned with all ornaments, bring her before you.

4.18.s:
mahālakṣmīrmahākālī mahāmāyā mahāmatiḥ ..
gaṅgā ca yamunā siṃdhuḥ śatadurnarmadā mahī .. 17 ..
4.18.d:
महालक्ष्मीर्महाकाली महामाया महामतिः ॥
गङ्गा च यमुना सिंधुः शतदुर्नर्मदा मही ॥ 17 ॥
4.18.m: She is Mahālakṣmī, Mahākālī, Mahāmāyā, Mahāmati; / she is Gaṅgā, Yamunā, Sindhu, Śatadrū, Narmadā, Mahī,

4.18.s:
sarasvatī vaitariṇī saiva proktā mahāsatī ..
tasyāśca prekṣaṇaparā bhava tadbhāvabhāsitā .. 18 ..
4.18.d:
सरस्वती वैतरिणी सैव प्रोक्ता महासती ॥
तस्याश्च प्रेक्षणपरा भव तद्भावभासिता ॥ 18 ॥
4.18.m: Sarasvatī, Vaitaraṇī; she alone is called the great virtuous wife. / Be intent on beholding her, illuminated by her nature.

4.18.s:
homaṃ kuryuryatātmāno brāhmaṇāḥ sarvatodiśam ..
devyāḥ pūjā prakartavyā puṣpadhūpādinā tataḥ ..19..
4.18.d:
होमं कुर्युर्यतात्मानो ब्राह्मणाः सर्वतोदिशम् ॥
देव्याः पूजा प्रकर्तव्या पुष्पधूपादिना ततः ॥19॥
4.18.m: Self-controlled brahmins should perform the fire sacrifice on all sides. / Then worship of the goddess should be performed with flowers, incense, and the like.

4.18.s:
bahuprakāranaivedyaṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapācitam ..
sthāpayetpurato devyāḥ pṛthaksaubhāgyameva ca .. 4.18.20 ..
4.18.d:
बहुप्रकारनैवेद्यं नैवेद्यं घृतपाचितम् ॥
स्थापयेत्पुरतो देव्याः पृथक्सौभाग्यमेव च ॥ 4.18.20 ॥
4.18.m: Various kinds of food-offerings, food cooked in clarified butter, / and separately, [articles of] good fortune should be placed before the goddess:

4.18.s:
jīrakaṃ kaḍuhuṃḍaścāpyapūpānkusumaṃ tathā ..
nipācāṃ pāvanatarāṃ lavaṇaṃ śarkarāṃ guḍam .. 21 ..
4.18.d:
जीरकं कडुहुंडश्चाप्यपूपान्कुसुमं तथा ॥
निपाचां पावनतरां लवणं शर्करां गुडम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.18.m: cumin, kaḍuhuṇḍa, cakes, and flowers, / most purifying cooked rice, salt, sugar, and molasses.

4.18.s:
puṣpamaṃḍapikā kāryā gaṃdhapuṣpādhivāsitā ..
padmāsanena saṃtiṣṭhedyāvatpariṇato raviḥ ..
tataḥ praṇamya rudrāṇīṃ maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 22 ..
4.18.d:
पुष्पमंडपिका कार्या गंधपुष्पाधिवासिता ॥
पद्मासनेन संतिष्ठेद्यावत्परिणतो रविः ॥
ततः प्रणम्य रुद्राणीं मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.18.m: A flower pavilion should be constructed, perfumed with fragrant scents and flowers. / One should sit in the lotus posture until the sun declines. / Then, bowing to Rudrāṇī, one should utter this mantra:

4.18.s:
vedeṣu sarvaśāstreṣu divi bhūmau dharātale ..
dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaśca bahuśaḥ śaṃkāvirahitaḥ stavaḥ .. 23 ..
4.18.d:
वेदेषु सर्वशास्त्रेषु दिवि भूमौ धरातले ॥
दृष्टः श्रुतश्च बहुशः शंकाविरहितः स्तवः ॥ 23 ॥
4.18.m: "In the Vedas, in all sacred treatises, in heaven, on earth, and upon the world's surface, / this hymn free from doubt is seen and heard manifoldly:

4.18.s:
tvaṃ śaktistvaṃ svadhā svāhā tvaṃ sāvitrī sarasvatī ..
patiṃ dehi gṛhaṃ dehi vasu dehi namostu te .. 24 ..
4.18.d:
त्वं शक्तिस्त्वं स्वधा स्वाहा त्वं सावित्री सरस्वती ॥
पतिं देहि गृहं देहि वसु देहि नमोस्तु ते ॥ 24 ॥
4.18.m: 'You are Śakti, you are Svadhā, Svāhā; you are Sāvitrī and Sarasvatī. / Grant a husband, grant a house, grant wealth; homage be to you!'"

4.18.s:
evaṃ saṃkṣamayeddevīṃ praṇipatya punaḥpunaḥ ..
dehi bhaktyā gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ vicitraṃ bahubhūmikam ..
ācchādyadvārakedārakapotādivibhūṣitam .. 25 ..
4.18.d:
एवं संक्षमयेद्देवीं प्रणिपत्य पुनःपुनः ॥
देहि भक्त्या गृहं रम्यं विचित्रं बहुभूमिकम् ॥
आच्छाद्यद्वारकेदारकपोतादिविभूषितम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.18.m: Thus one should ask forgiveness from the goddess, bowing down repeatedly: / "With devotion, grant a delightful, variegated house of many storeys, / adorned with a sheltered doorway, courtyards, doves, and the like,

4.18.s:
kuḍyastaṃbhagavākṣāḍhyaṃ maṇimaṃḍitatoraṇam ..
padmarāgamahānīlavajravaiḍūryabhūṣitam .. 26 ..
4.18.d:
कुड्यस्तंभगवाक्षाढ्यं मणिमंडिततोरणम् ॥
पद्मरागमहानीलवज्रवैडूर्यभूषितम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.18.m: rich in walls, pillars, and lattice-windows, with an archway adorned with gems, / and decorated with rubies, sapphires, diamonds, and cat's-eye gems."

4.18.s:
gṛhadānavidhānena brāhmaṇāya yaśasvine ..
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya sarvopaskarasaṃyutam .. 27 ..
4.18.d:
गृहदानविधानेन ब्राह्मणाय यशस्विने ॥
सपत्नीकाय संपूज्य सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.18.m: According to the rule for giving a house, having honoured a renowned brahmin / accompanied by his wife, [the house] should be given with all household implements.

4.18.s:
suvāsinībhyastaddeyaṃ naivedyaṃ sūryasaṃsthitam ..
nirvartya vidhinānena tatpaścātkṣamayedagham .. 28 ..
4.18.d:
सुवासिनीभ्यस्तद्देयं नैवेद्यं सूर्यसंस्थितम् ॥
निर्वर्त्य विधिनानेन तत्पश्चात्क्षमयेदघम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.18.m: That food-offering placed before the sun should be given to married women whose husbands are living. / Having completed this according to the rite, one should then ask forgiveness for sin.

4.18.s:
dāṃpatyāni ca bhojyāni caturthyāṃ madhurai rasaiḥ ..
ityuktamumayā cīrṇaṃ hara raṃbhāvrataṃ param .. 29 ..
4.18.d:
दांपत्यानि च भोज्यानि चतुर्थ्यां मधुरै रसैः ॥
इत्युक्तमुमया चीर्णं हर रंभाव्रतं परम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.18.m: And married couples should be fed on the fourth lunar day with sweet foods. / Thus, O Hara, was this supreme Rambhā votive observance observed by Umā.

4.18.s:
vratāṃtegastyamunaye dattaṃ gṛhavaraṃ śubham ..
lopāmudrā priyā patnī tasya veśmani pūjitā .. 4.18.30 ..
4.18.d:
व्रतांतेगस्त्यमुनये दत्तं गृहवरं शुभम् ॥
लोपामुद्रा प्रिया पत्नी तस्य वेश्मनि पूजिता ॥ 4.18.30 ॥
4.18.m: At the conclusion of the observance, an excellent and auspicious house was given to the sage Agastya; / Lopāmudrā, his beloved wife, was worshipped in that abode.

4.18.s:
tena dharmeṇa deva tvaṃ bhartā labdho'si śaṃkaraḥ ..
arddhāṃke'pi sthitā tena yāścariṣyaṃti yoṣitaḥ ..31..
4.18.d:
तेन धर्मेण देव त्वं भर्ता लब्धोऽसि शंकरः ॥
अर्द्धांकेऽपि स्थिता तेन याश्चरिष्यंति योषितः ॥31॥
4.18.m: By that merit, O Lord Śaṃkara, you were obtained as husband, / and by it, [I] reside on half your lap. Whatever women shall observe this,

4.18.s:
kauṃteya puruṣo vāpi khyātaṃ raṃbhāvrataṃ bhuvi ..
tāsāṃ putrā gṛhaṃ bhogāḥ kulavṛddhirbhaviṣyati .. 32 ..
4.18.d:
कौंतेय पुरुषो वापि ख्यातं रंभाव्रतं भुवि ॥
तासां पुत्रा गृहं भोगाः कुलवृद्धिर्भविष्यति ॥ 32 ॥
4.18.m: or whatever man, O son of Kuntī, this celebrated Rambhā votive observance on earth, / for them there shall be sons, a household, pleasures, and the increase of their lineage,

4.18.s:
strīṇāṃ cāturyasaubhāgyaṃ gārhasthyaṃ sarvakāmikam ..
bālāvṛddhāsumadhyānāṃ rūpalāvaṇyabṛṃhaṇam ..
sapatnīdarpadalanaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam .. 33 ..
4.18.d:
स्त्रीणां चातुर्यसौभाग्यं गार्हस्थ्यं सर्वकामिकम् ॥
बालावृद्धासुमध्यानां रूपलावण्यबृंहणम् ॥
सपत्नीदर्पदलनं वशीकरणमुत्तमम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.18.m: and for women: cleverness, good fortune, householdership fulfilling all desires, / the enhancement of beauty and charm for young girls, old women, and slender-waisted maidens, / the crushing of co-wives' pride, and supreme subjugation.

4.18.s:
himavadviṃdhyayormadhye āryāvarte manohare ..
utpatya śobhane vāse pūrvotpannadhane kule .. 34 ..
4.18.d:
हिमवद्विंध्ययोर्मध्ये आर्यावर्ते मनोहरे ॥
उत्पत्य शोभने वासे पूर्वोत्पन्नधने कुले ॥ 34 ॥
4.18.m: Having been born between the Himalayas and the Vindhyas, in the delightful Āryāvarta, / in a beautiful dwelling, in a family of previously accumulated wealth,

4.18.s:
mṛtaḥ śakrapuraṃ yāti tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ..
tataḥ śivapuraṃ yāti vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā .. 35 ..
4.18.d:
मृतः शक्रपुरं याति ततो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् ॥
ततः शिवपुरं याति व्यासस्य वचनं यथा ॥ 35 ॥
4.18.m: at death, one goes to the city of Śakra, then travels to the city of Viṣṇu, / and from there goes to the city of Śiva, according to the word of Vyāsa.

4.18.s:
yadraṃbhayā kila bhayāpaharaṃ tataśca gauryā himādribhavanasthitayāpi cīrṇam ..
tasyā vrataṃ suvikaroti ratā ca dharme brahmeśakeśavapatiṃ sukhadaṃ labheta .. 36 .. ..
gopadatṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
4.18.d:
यद्रंभया किल भयापहरं ततश्च गौर्या हिमाद्रिभवनस्थितयापि चीर्णम् ॥
तस्या व्रतं सुविकरोति रता च धर्मे ब्रह्मेशकेशवपतिं सुखदं लभेत ॥ 36 ॥ ॥
गोपदतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.18.m:
That [observance] which removes fear, performed by Rambhā and then by Gaurī while residing in the home of the snow-mountain— / whoever diligently performs her votive observance, devoted to righteousness, shall obtain a joy-bestowing husband equal to Brahmā, Īśa, or Keśava.
Description of the Gopadatṛtīyā Votive Observance.

4.19.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pārtha bhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe dinodaye ..
tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ ca śuddhāyāṃ prativatsaram .. 1 ..
4.19.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पार्थ भाद्रपदे मासि शुक्लपक्षे दिनोदये ॥
तृतीयायां चतुर्थ्यां च शुद्धायां प्रतिवत्सरम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.19.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
O son of Pṛthā, in the month of Bhādrapada, in the bright fortnight at daybreak, / on the third or the fourth lunar day when unblemished, year by year,

4.19.s:
upavāsena gṛhṇīyādvrataṃ nāmnā tu gopadam ..
snātvā naro vā nārī vā puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ .. 2 ..
4.19.d:
उपवासेन गृह्णीयाद्व्रतं नाम्ना तु गोपदम् ॥
स्नात्वा नरो वा नारी वा पुष्पधूपविलेपनैः ॥ 2 ॥
4.19.m: a man or a woman, having bathed, should undertake through fasting / the votive observance called Gopada, with flowers, incense, and ointments,

4.19.s:
dadhyakṣataiśca mālābhiḥ piṣṭakairvanamālayā ..
abhyaṃjayedgavāṃ śṛṃgaṃ khuraṃ pucchāntameva ca .. 3 ..
4.19.d:
दध्यक्षतैश्च मालाभिः पिष्टकैर्वनमालया ॥
अभ्यंजयेद्गवां शृंगं खुरं पुच्छान्तमेव च ॥ 3 ॥
4.19.m: with curds, unbroken grains, garlands, cakes, and a garland of wild flowers, / and should smear the horns, hooves, and tails of the cows.

4.19.s:
dadyādgavāhnikaṃ bhaktyā tāsāṃ pūrvāparāhṇayoḥ ..
anagnipākaṃ bhuñjīta tailakṣāravivarjitam .. 4 ..
4.19.d:
दद्याद्गवाह्निकं भक्त्या तासां पूर्वापराह्णयोः ॥
अनग्निपाकं भुञ्जीत तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.19.m: With devotion, one should give daily food to the cows in the morning and afternoon; / one should eat food not cooked by fire, free of oil and salt.

4.19.s:
vrajaṃtīnāṃ gavāṃ nityamāyāṃtīnāṃ ca bhārata ..
puradvāretha vā goṣṭhe mantreṇā nena maṃtravit ..
arghyaṃ pradadyādgṛṣṭyāṃ vā gavāṃ pādeṣu pāṃḍava .. 5 ..
4.19.d:
व्रजंतीनां गवां नित्यमायांतीनां च भारत ॥
पुरद्वारेथ वा गोष्ठे मन्त्रेणा नेन मंत्रवित् ॥
अर्घ्यं प्रदद्याद्गृष्ट्यां वा गवां पादेषु पांडव ॥ 5 ॥
4.19.m: O descendant of Bharata, as the cows are going out or returning, / at the city gate or in the cow-pen, the knower of mantras / should offer water offering with this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu, at the cows' feet or to a cow with calf:

4.19.s:
mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ ..
pranuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa .. 6 ..
4.19.d:
माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः ॥
प्रनुवोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट ॥ 6 ॥
4.19.m: “The mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus, the sister of the Ādityas, the navel of nectar: / I say to the discerning person, do not slaughter the cow, Aditi, who is free from guilt.”

4.19.s:
.. iti gavāṃ maṃtraḥ .. ..
gāvo me agrataḥ santu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ ..
gāvo me hṛdaye saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham.. 7 ..
4.19.d:
॥ इति गवां मंत्रः ॥ ॥
गावो मे अग्रतः सन्तु गावो मे संतु पृष्ठतः ॥
गावो मे हृदये संतु गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम्॥ 7 ॥
4.19.m:
Such is the mantra for the cows.
“May cows be in front of me; may cows be behind me; / may cows be in my heart; I dwell in the midst of cows.”

4.19.s:
itthaṃ saṃpūjya dattvārghaṃ tato gacchedgṛhāśramam ..
paṃcamyāṃ krodharahito bhuñjīta gorasaṃ dadhi .. 8 ..
4.19.d:
इत्थं संपूज्य दत्त्वार्घं ततो गच्छेद्गृहाश्रमम् ॥
पंचम्यां क्रोधरहितो भुञ्जीत गोरसं दधि ॥ 8 ॥
4.19.m: Having thus worshipped and given water offering, one should then return to the household life; / on the fifth lunar day, free of anger, one should consume cow's milk and curds,

4.19.s:
śālipiṣṭaṃ phalaṃ śākaṃ tilamannaṃ ca śobhanam..
bhuktāvasāne rājendra saṃyatastāṃ niśāṃ svapet ..9..
4.19.d:
शालिपिष्टं फलं शाकं तिलमन्नं च शोभनम्॥
भुक्तावसाने राजेन्द्र संयतस्तां निशां स्वपेत् ॥9॥
4.19.m: rice flour, fruit, vegetables, sesame, and fine grain; / when the meal is done, O king of kings, one should sleep that night self-restrained.

4.19.s:
prabhāte gopadaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya hiraṇmayam ..
kṣamayecca gavāṃ nāthaṃ goviṃdaṃ garuḍadhvajam .. 4.19.10 ..
4.19.d:
प्रभाते गोपदं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणाय हिरण्मयम् ॥
क्षमयेच्च गवां नाथं गोविंदं गरुडध्वजम् ॥ 4.19.10 ॥
4.19.m: At dawn, having given a golden cow-footprint to a brāhmaṇa, / one should ask forgiveness of Govinda, the lord of cows, who has the banner of Garuḍa.

4.19.s:
arcyaṃte'tra yathā gāvastathā govardhano giriḥ ..
praṇamyācyutamuddiśya śṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt ..11..
4.19.d:
अर्च्यंतेऽत्र यथा गावस्तथा गोवर्धनो गिरिः ॥
प्रणम्याच्युतमुद्दिश्य शृणु यत्फलमाप्नुयात् ॥11॥
4.19.m: As cows are worshipped here, so is Mount Govardhana; / having bowed down dedicating it to Acyuta, listen to what fruit one obtains.

4.19.s:
gobhakto govrataṃ kṛtvā bhaktyā śaktyā ca goṣpadam ..
saubhāgyaṃ rūpalāvaṇyaṃ prāpnoti pṛthivītale .. 12 ..
4.19.d:
गोभक्तो गोव्रतं कृत्वा भक्त्या शक्त्या च गोष्पदम् ॥
सौभाग्यं रूपलावण्यं प्राप्नोति पृथिवीतले ॥ 12 ॥
4.19.m: A devotee of cows, having performed the cow-votive observance called Goṣpada with devotion and according to one's ability, / attains good fortune, beauty, and grace upon the earth,

4.19.s:
gotarṇakākulaṃ gehaṃ gokulaṃ ca samāsataḥ ..
dhanadhānyasamopeta śālīkṣurasamṛddhimān ..13..
4.19.d:
गोतर्णकाकुलं गेहं गोकुलं च समासतः ॥
धनधान्यसमोपेत शालीक्षुरसमृद्धिमान् ॥13॥
4.19.m: a home filled with cows and calves, and indeed a whole herd of cows, / endowed with wealth and grain, affluent in rice and sugarcane juice.

4.19.s:
saṃtānaṃ pūjitaṃ labdhvā tataḥ svarge'maro bhavet ..
divyarūpadharaḥ sragvī divyālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ ..14..
4.19.d:
संतानं पूजितं लब्ध्वा ततः स्वर्गेऽमरो भवेत् ॥
दिव्यरूपधरः स्रग्वी दिव्यालंकारभूषितः ॥14॥
4.19.m: Having obtained revered offspring, he then becomes an immortal in heaven, / possessing a divine form, wearing garlands, adorned with celestial ornaments.

4.19.s:
gandharvairgītavādyena sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ ..
divyaṃ yugaśataṃ chittvā tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet .. 15 ..
4.19.d:
गन्धर्वैर्गीतवाद्येन सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः ॥
दिव्यं युगशतं छित्त्वा ततो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.19.m: Served by the singing and instrumental music of gandharvas and by hosts of apsarases, / having spent a hundred divine yugas, he goes from there to the realm of Viṣṇu.

4.19.s:
yo gopadavratamidaṃ kurute trirātraṃ gā vai prapūjayati gorasapūjanācca ..
goviṃdamādipuruṣaṃ praṇataḥ savitrāmālokamuttamamupaiti gavāṃ pavitram .. 16 .. ..
harikālīvratavarṇanam
4.19.d:
यो गोपदव्रतमिदं कुरुते त्रिरात्रं गा वै प्रपूजयति गोरसपूजनाच्च ॥
गोविंदमादिपुरुषं प्रणतः सवित्रामालोकमुत्तममुपैति गवां पवित्रम् ॥ 16 ॥ ॥
हरिकालीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.19.m:
Whoever performs this Gopada votive observance for three nights and worships the cows through the worship of dairy products, / bowed down to Govinda the primal puruṣa, goes together with the mothers to the cows' supreme, pure realm.
Description of the Harikālī Votive Observance.

4.20.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śukle bhādra padasyaiva tṛtīyāyāṃ samarcayet ..
sarvadhānyaistāṃ virūḍhāṃ bhūtāṃ haritaśāḍvalām ..
harakālīṃ devadevīṃ gaurīṃ śaṃkaravallabhām .. 1 ..
4.20.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शुक्ले भाद्र पदस्यैव तृतीयायां समर्चयेत् ॥
सर्वधान्यैस्तां विरूढां भूतां हरितशाड्वलाम् ॥
हरकालीं देवदेवीं गौरीं शंकरवल्लभाम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.20.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, one should worship / the sprouted green pasture that has grown with all kinds of grain, / [as] Harakālī, the goddess of gods, Gaurī, the beloved of Śaṅkara,

4.20.s:
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairdhūpairnaivedyairmodakādibhiḥ ..
prīṇayitvā samācchādya padmarāgena bhāsvatā .. 2 ..
4.20.d:
गन्धैः पुष्पैः फलैर्धूपैर्नैवेद्यैर्मोदकादिभिः ॥
प्रीणयित्वा समाच्छाद्य पद्मरागेन भास्वता ॥ 2 ॥
4.20.m: having gratified her with perfumes, flowers, fruits, incenses, and food offerings such as modakas, / and having covered her with a shining ruby,

4.20.s:
ghaṇṭāvādyādibhirgītaiḥ śubhairdivyakathānugaiḥ ..
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prabhāte hyudgate ravau .. 3 ..
4.20.d:
घण्टावाद्यादिभिर्गीतैः शुभैर्दिव्यकथानुगैः ॥
कृत्वा जागरणं रात्रौ प्रभाते ह्युद्गते रवौ ॥ 3 ॥
4.20.m: keeping vigil at night with bell-ringing, musical instruments, / auspicious songs accompanied by divine tales; then at dawn, when the sun has risen,

4.20.s:
suvāsinībhiḥ sā neyā madhye puṇyajalāśaye ..
tasminvisarjayetpārtha harakālīṃ haripriyām ..4..
4.20.d:
सुवासिनीभिः सा नेया मध्ये पुण्यजलाशये ॥
तस्मिन्विसर्जयेत्पार्थ हरकालीं हरिप्रियाम् ॥4॥
4.20.m: she should be brought by married women into the midst of an auspicious body of water; / in it one should submerge Harakālī, beloved of Hari, O son of Pṛthā.

4.20.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavanharakālīti kā devī procyate bhuvi ..
ārdradhānyaiḥ sthitā kasmātpūjyate strījanena sā ..
pūjitā kiṃ dadātīha sarvaṃ me brūhi keśava.. 5 ..
4.20.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्हरकालीति का देवी प्रोच्यते भुवि ॥
आर्द्रधान्यैः स्थिता कस्मात्पूज्यते स्त्रीजनेन सा ॥
पूजिता किं ददातीह सर्वं मे ब्रूहि केशव॥ 5 ॥
4.20.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
O blessed one, what goddess on earth is called Harakālī? / Why is she worshipped by women while residing in moist grains? / What does she grant when worshipped here? Tell me everything, O Keśava.

4.20.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sarvapāpaharāṃ divyāṃ mattaḥ śṛṇu kathāmimām ..
āsīddakṣasya duhitā kālīnāmnī tu kanyakā .. 6 .
4.20.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सर्वपापहरां दिव्यां मत्तः शृणु कथामिमाम् ॥
आसीद्दक्षस्य दुहिता कालीनाम्नी तु कन्यका ॥ 6 ।
4.20.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen from me to this divine tale that destroys all sins: / Dakṣa had a maiden daughter named Kālī,

4.20.s:
varṇenāpi ca sā kṛṣṇā navanīlotpalaprabhā ..
sā ca dattā tryaṃbakāya mahādevāya śūline ..7..
4.20.d:
वर्णेनापि च सा कृष्णा नवनीलोत्पलप्रभा ॥
सा च दत्ता त्र्यंबकाय महादेवाय शूलिने ॥7॥
4.20.m: who was also dark in colour, with the lustre of a fresh blue lotus; / and she was given to the three-eyed Mahādeva, the trident-wielder.

4.20.s:
vivāhitā vidhānena śaṃkhatūryānunādinā ..
yatkuryādāgatairdevairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ .. 8 ..
4.20.d:
विवाहिता विधानेन शंखतूर्यानुनादिना ॥
यत्कुर्यादागतैर्देवैर्ब्राह्मणानां च निस्वनैः ॥ 8 ॥
4.20.m: She was married in according with tradition, resplendent with the sounds of conches and trumpets, / and with the chanting of brāhmaṇas alongside the assembled gods.

4.20.s:
nirvartite vivāhe tu tayā sārdhaṃ trilocanaḥ ..
krīḍate vividhairbhogairmanasaḥ prītivardhanaiḥ .. 9 ..
4.20.d:
निर्वर्तिते विवाहे तु तया सार्धं त्रिलोचनः ॥
क्रीडते विविधैर्भोगैर्मनसः प्रीतिवर्धनैः ॥ 9 ॥
4.20.m: When the marriage had been performed, the three-eyed god with her / disported in various pleasures that increased the joy of the mind.

4.20.s:
atha devasamānastu kadācitsa vṛṣadhvajaḥ ..
āsthānamaṃḍape ramye āste viṣṇusahāyavān .. 4.20.10 ..
4.20.d:
अथ देवसमानस्तु कदाचित्स वृषध्वजः ॥
आस्थानमंडपे रम्ये आस्ते विष्णुसहायवान् ॥ 4.20.10 ॥
4.20.m: Then once that god, the bull-bannered one, equal to the gods, / was seated in the delightful assembly pavilion, accompanied by Viṣṇu.

4.20.s:
tatrasthaścāhvayāmāsa narmaṇā tripurāṃtakaḥ ..
kālī nīlotpalaśyāmāṃ gaṇamātṛgaṇāvṛtām .. 11 ..
4.20.d:
तत्रस्थश्चाह्वयामास नर्मणा त्रिपुरांतकः ॥
काली नीलोत्पलश्यामां गणमातृगणावृताम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.20.m: Sitting there, the destroyer of Tripura jokingly called out / to Kālī, who was as dark as a blue lotus and surrounded by the host of mothers and gaṇas:

4.20.s:
ehyehi tvamitaḥ kāsi kṛṣṇāṃjanasamanvite ..
kālasuṃdari matpārśve dhavale tvamupāviśa .. 12 ..
4.20.d:
एह्येहि त्वमितः कासि कृष्णांजनसमन्विते ॥
कालसुंदरि मत्पार्श्वे धवले त्वमुपाविश ॥ 12 ॥
4.20.m: “Come, come here! Who are you, coated in black collyrium? / O dark beauty, sit beside me, who am white!”

4.20.s:
evamutkṣiptamanasā devī saṃkuddhamānasā ..
śvāsayāmāsa tāmrākṣī bāṣpagadgadayā girā .. 13 ..
4.20.d:
एवमुत्क्षिप्तमनसा देवी संकुद्धमानसा ॥
श्वासयामास ताम्राक्षी बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा ॥ 13 ॥
4.20.m: Her mind thus agitated, the goddess, with anger in her heart, / sighed with copper-red eyes, and in a voice choked with tears,

4.20.s:
ruroda sasvaraṃ bālā tatrasthā sphuritādharā ..
kiṃdaivayogāttāmrā gaurgaurī cetyabhidhīyate .. 14 ..
4.20.d:
रुरोद सस्वरं बाला तत्रस्था स्फुरिताधरा ॥
किंदैवयोगात्ताम्रा गौर्गौरी चेत्यभिधीयते ॥ 14 ॥
4.20.m: the young woman, trembling-lipped, wept aloud right there: / “Is a coppery cow called ‘Gaurī’ by some twist of fate?

4.20.s:
yasmānmamopamā dattā kṛṣṇavarṇena śaṃkara ..
harakālīti vāhūtā devarṣigaṇasevitā .. 15 ..
4.20.d:
यस्मान्ममोपमा दत्ता कृष्णवर्णेन शंकर ॥
हरकालीति वाहूता देवर्षिगणसेविता ॥ 15 ॥
4.20.m: Because you have compared me to a black colour, O Śaṅkara, / or called me ‘Harakālī’, though I am attended by the hosts of gods and sages,

4.20.s:
tasmāddehamimaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ juhomi jvalite'nale ..
ityuktvā vāryamāṇā tu harakālī ruṣānvitā .. 16 ..
4.20.d:
तस्माद्देहमिमं कृष्णं जुहोमि ज्वलितेऽनले ॥
इत्युक्त्वा वार्यमाणा तु हरकाली रुषान्विता ॥ 16 ॥
4.20.m: therefore I shall cast this black body into the blazing fire!” / Having said this, Harakālī, full of wrath though restrained,

4.20.s:
mumoca haritacchāyākāṃtiṃ haritaśādvale ..
cikṣepa doṣaṃ rāgeṇa jvalite havyavāhane .. 17 ..
4.20.d:
मुमोच हरितच्छायाकांतिं हरितशाद्वले ॥
चिक्षेप दोषं रागेण ज्वलिते हव्यवाहने ॥ 17 ॥
4.20.m: released her greenish lustrous radiance onto the green pasture; / with passion she threw the blemish into the blazing fire.

4.20.s:
punaḥ parvatarājasya gṛhe gaurī babhūva sā ..
mahādevasya dehārddhe sthitā saṃpūjyate suraiḥ .. 18 ..
4.20.d:
पुनः पर्वतराजस्य गृहे गौरी बभूव सा ॥
महादेवस्य देहार्द्धे स्थिता संपूज्यते सुरैः ॥ 18 ॥
4.20.m: She was born again as Gaurī in the house of the king of mountains; / dwelling in half of Mahādeva’s body, she is worshipped by the gods.

4.20.s:
evaṃ sā harakālīti gaurīśasya vyavasthitā ..
pūjanīyā mahādevī maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava .. 19 ..
4.20.d:
एवं सा हरकालीति गौरीशस्य व्यवस्थिता ॥
पूजनीया महादेवी मंत्रेणानेन पांडव ॥ 19 ॥
4.20.m: Thus established as Harakālī, the consort of Gaurī’s lord, / that great goddess must be worshipped with this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu:

4.20.s:
harakarmasamutpanne harakāye harapriye ..
māṃ trāhīśasya mūrtisthe praṇatāstu namonamaḥ .. 4.20.20 ..
4.20.d:
हरकर्मसमुत्पन्ने हरकाये हरप्रिये ॥
मां त्राहीशस्य मूर्तिस्थे प्रणतास्तु नमोनमः ॥ 4.20.20 ॥
4.20.m: “O you born of Hara's rite, O body of Hara, O beloved of Hara, / protect me, O you residing in the lord's form! Salutations, salutations to you who are bowed to!”

4.20.s:
itthaṃ saṃpūjya naivedyaṃ dadyādviprāya pāṃḍava ..
tāṃ ca prātarjale ramye maṃtreṇaiva visarjayet .. 21 ..
4.20.d:
इत्थं संपूज्य नैवेद्यं दद्याद्विप्राय पांडव ॥
तां च प्रातर्जले रम्ये मंत्रेणैव विसर्जयेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.20.m: Having worshipped her thus, one should give the food offering to a brāhmaṇa, O son of Pāṇḍu, / and at dawn one should dismiss her into pleasant water with this very mantra:

4.20.s:
arcitāsi mayā bhaktyā gaccha devi surālayam ..
harakāle śive gauri punarāgamanāya ca ..22..
4.20.d:
अर्चितासि मया भक्त्या गच्छ देवि सुरालयम् ॥
हरकाले शिवे गौरि पुनरागमनाय च ॥22॥
4.20.m: “You have been worshipped by me with devotion; go, O goddess, to the abode of the gods, / O Harakālī, O Śivā, O Gaurī, and [return] to come again!”

4.20.s:
evaṃ yaḥ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha harakālīvrataṃ caret ..
varṣevarṣe vidhānena nārī narapate śubhā .. 23 ..
4.20.d:
एवं यः पांडवश्रेष्ठ हरकालीव्रतं चरेत् ॥
वर्षेवर्षे विधानेन नारी नरपते शुभा ॥ 23 ॥
4.20.m: O best of the Pāṇḍavas, any auspicious woman who thus performs the Harakālī observance / year by year in accordance with the rules, O king of men,

4.20.s:
sā yatphalamavāpnoti tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa ..
martyaloke ciraṃ tiṣṭhetsarvarogavivarjitā .. 24 ..
4.20.d:
सा यत्फलमवाप्नोति तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप ॥
मर्त्यलोके चिरं तिष्ठेत्सर्वरोगविवर्जिता ॥ 24 ॥
4.20.m: hear the fruit that she obtains, O ruler of men: / she remains long in the mortal world, freed from all disease,

4.20.s:
sarvabhogasamāyuktā sau bhāgyabalagarvitā ..
putrapautrasuhṛnmitranaptṛdauhitrasaṃkulā .. 25 ..
4.20.d:
सर्वभोगसमायुक्ता सौ भाग्यबलगर्विता ॥
पुत्रपौत्रसुहृन्मित्रनप्तृदौहित्रसंकुला ॥ 25 ॥
4.20.m: endowed with every enjoyment, proud of the strength of her good fortune, / surrounded by sons, grandsons, well-wishers, friends, great-grandsons, and daughter’s sons.

4.20.s:
sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvadbhogānbhuktvā mahītale ..
tatovasāne dehasya śivajñānā mahāmune .. 26 ..
4.20.d:
साग्रं वर्षशतं यावद्भोगान्भुक्त्वा महीतले ॥
ततोवसाने देहस्य शिवज्ञाना महामुने ॥ 26 ॥
4.20.m: Having enjoyed pleasures on the earth for fully a hundred years, / then, at the end of her body, having attained knowledge of Śiva, O great sage,

4.20.s:
cirabhadrā mahākālanaṃdīśvaravināyakāḥ ..
tadājñākiṃkarāḥ sarve mahādevaprasādataḥ .. 27 ..
4.20.d:
चिरभद्रा महाकालनंदीश्वरविनायकाः ॥
तदाज्ञाकिंकराः सर्वे महादेवप्रसादतः ॥ 27 ॥
4.20.m: she enjoys perpetual welfare; and Mahākāla, Nandīśvara, and the vināyakas / all become servants to her command, through the grace of Mahādeva.

4.20.s:
saṃpūrṇasūryagaṇasaptavirūḍhaśasyāṃ tāṃ vai himādritanayāṃ harakālikākhyām ..
saṃpūjya jāgaramanuddhatagītavādyairyacchaṃti yā iha bhavaṃti patipriyāstāḥ .. 28 ..
lalitāvratavarṇanam
4.20.d:
संपूर्णसूर्यगणसप्तविरूढशस्यां तां वै हिमाद्रितनयां हरकालिकाख्याम् ॥
संपूज्य जागरमनुद्धतगीतवाद्यैर्यच्छंति या इह भवंति पतिप्रियास्ताः ॥ 28 ॥
ललिताव्रतवर्णनम्
4.20.m:
Those women who, having worshipped that daughter of the snow-mountain called Harakālikā, / with shoots of grain sprouted for seven [days] when the company of the sun is complete, keep vigil with restrained song and musical instruments, become beloved of their husbands in this world.
Description of the Lalitā Votive Observance

4.21.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
atha pṛcchāmi bhagavanvrataṃ dvādaśamāsikam ..
lalitārādhanaṃ nāma māsamāsakrameṇa vā .. 1
4.21.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
अथ पृच्छामि भगवन्व्रतं द्वादशमासिकम् ॥
ललिताराधनं नाम मासमासक्रमेण वा ॥ 1
4.21.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Now I ask, O Blessed One, about the twelve-month observance / named the worship of Lalitā, or month by month in succession.

4.21.s:
.. kṛṣṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu pāṃḍava yatnena yathā vṛttaṃ purātanam ..
śaṃkarasya mahādevyāḥ saṃvādaṃ kurusattama .. 2 ..
4.21.d:
॥ कृष्ण उवाच ॥
शृणु पांडव यत्नेन यथा वृत्तं पुरातनम् ॥
शंकरस्य महादेव्याः संवादं कुरुसत्तम ॥ 2 ॥
4.21.m: Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen attentively, O Pāṇḍava, to how it took place of old, / the dialogue between Śaṅkara and Mahādevī, O best of the Kurus.

4.21.s:
kailāsaśikhare ramye bahupuṣpaphalopage ..
sahakāradrumacchanne caṃpakāśokabhūṣite .. 3 ..
4.21.d:
कैलासशिखरे रम्ये बहुपुष्पफलोपगे ॥
सहकारद्रुमच्छन्ने चंपकाशोकभूषिते ॥ 3 ॥
4.21.m: On the delightful peak of Kailāsa, covered with many flowers and fruits, / shaded by mango trees, adorned with campaka and aśoka,

4.21.s:
kadaṃbabakulāmoda vaśīkṛtamadhuvrate ..
mayūraravasaṃghuṣṭe rājahaṃsopaśobhite .. 4 ..
4.21.d:
कदंबबकुलामोद वशीकृतमधुव्रते ॥
मयूररवसंघुष्टे राजहंसोपशोभिते ॥ 4 ॥
4.21.m: where bees were captivated by the fragrance of kadamba and bakula, / resounding with the calls of peacocks, beautified by royal swans,

4.21.s:
mṛgarkṣagajasiṃhaiśca śākhāmṛgagaṇāvṛte ..
gaṃdharvayakṣadevarṣisiddhakinnarapannagaiḥ .. 5 ..
4.21.d:
मृगर्क्षगजसिंहैश्च शाखामृगगणावृते ॥
गंधर्वयक्षदेवर्षिसिद्धकिन्नरपन्नगैः ॥ 5 ॥
4.21.m: surrounded by deer, bears, elephants, lions, and troops of monkeys, / [and] by gandharvas, yakṣas, divine seers, siddhas, kinnaras, and serpents,

4.21.s:
tapasvibhirmahābhāgaiḥ sevamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
sukhāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtam .. 6 ..
4.21.d:
तपस्विभिर्महाभागैः सेवमानं समंततः ॥
सुखासीनं महादेवं भूतसंघैः समावृतम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.21.m: continually attended on all sides by illustrious ascetics, / [to] Mahādeva seated comfortably, surrounded by hosts of ghosts,

4.21.s:
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtamumā natvābravīdidam ..
umovāca ..
bhagavandevadeveśa śūlapāṇe vṛṣadhvaja .. 7 ..
4.21.d:
अप्सरोभिः परिवृतमुमा नत्वाब्रवीदिदम् ॥
उमोवाच ॥
भगवन्देवदेवेश शूलपाणे वृषध्वज ॥ 7 ॥
4.21.m: and encompassed by apsarases, Umā bowed and spoke this. / Umā said: / O Blessed One, lord of the gods of gods, trident-in-hand, who has a bull on your banner,

4.21.s:
kathayasva maheśāna tṛtīyāvratamuttamam ..
saubhāgyaṃ labhate yena dhanaṃ putrānpaśūnsukham .. 8 ..
4.21.d:
कथयस्व महेशान तृतीयाव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
सौभाग्यं लभते येन धनं पुत्रान्पशून्सुखम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.21.m: tell me, O Great Lord, the excellent tṛtīyā observance / by which a woman obtains good fortune, wealth, sons, cattle, happiness,

4.21.s:
nārī svargaṃ śubhaṃ rūpamārogyaṃ śriyamuttamām ..
evamukto dayitayā bhāryayā prītipūrvakam ..
vihasya śaṃkaraḥ prāha kiṃ vratena tava priye .. 9 ..
4.21.d:
नारी स्वर्गं शुभं रूपमारोग्यं श्रियमुत्तमाम् ॥
एवमुक्तो दयितया भार्यया प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ॥
विहस्य शंकरः प्राह किं व्रतेन तव प्रिये ॥ 9 ॥
4.21.m: heaven, auspicious beauty, health, and supreme prosperity. / Thus addressed with affection by his beloved wife, / Śaṅkara laughed and said: “What need have you of an observance, my dear?

4.21.s:
ye kāmāstriṣu lokeṣu divyā bhūmyaṃtīrakṣajāḥ ..
sarvepi tena cāyattā vaśyastehaṃ yataḥ patiḥ .. 4.21.10 ..
4.21.d:
ये कामास्त्रिषु लोकेषु दिव्या भूम्यंतीरक्षजाः ॥
सर्वेपि तेन चायत्ता वश्यस्तेहं यतः पतिः ॥ 4.21.10 ॥
4.21.m: Whatever desires exist in the three worlds—celestial, earthly, or produced in the intermediate realm— / all are subject to it, and I, being your husband, am in your control.”

4.21.s:
umovāca .. satyametatsureśāna tvayi dṛṣṭe na durlabham ..
kiṃcittribhuvanābhogabhūṣaṇe śaśibhūṣaṇe .. 11 ..
4.21.d:
उमोवाच ॥ सत्यमेतत्सुरेशान त्वयि दृष्टे न दुर्लभम् ॥
किंचित्त्रिभुवनाभोगभूषणे शशिभूषणे ॥ 11 ॥
4.21.m: Umā said: “This is true, O lord of the gods; when you are seen, nothing is difficult to attain / in the expanse of the three worlds, O ornament [of the universe], O moon-adorned one.

4.21.s:
bhaktyā striyo hi māṃ deva prajapaṃti śubhāśubham ..
virūpāḥ sulabhāḥ kāścidaputrā bahuputrakāḥ ..12..
4.21.d:
भक्त्या स्त्रियो हि मां देव प्रजपंति शुभाशुभम् ॥
विरूपाः सुलभाः काश्चिदपुत्रा बहुपुत्रकाः ॥12॥
4.21.m: Yet out of devotion, O god, women pray to me in good and bad circumstances: / some are deformed though easily available, some are sonless, some have many sons,

4.21.s:
suśīlāstapasā kāścicchvaśrubhiḥ pīḍitā bhṛśam ..
śaucācārasamāyuktā na rocantetha kasyacit .. 13 ..
4.21.d:
सुशीलास्तपसा काश्चिच्छ्वश्रुभिः पीडिता भृशम् ॥
शौचाचारसमायुक्ता न रोचन्तेथ कस्यचित् ॥ 13 ॥
4.21.m: some are well-behaved through asceticism but terribly oppressed by their mothers-in-law, / [and some,] endowed with cleanliness and good conduct, still please no one.

4.21.s:
evaṃ vahuvidhairduḥkhaiḥ pīḍyamānāstu dāruṇaiḥ ..
śaraṇaṃ māṃ prapannāstāḥ kṛpāviṣṭā tato hyaham .. 14 ..
4.21.d:
एवं वहुविधैर्दुःखैः पीड्यमानास्तु दारुणैः ॥
शरणं मां प्रपन्नास्ताः कृपाविष्टा ततो ह्यहम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.21.m: Tormented thus by manifold harsh sufferings, / they have taken refuge in me; therefore I am filled with pity.

4.21.s:
yena tāḥ sukhasaṃbhogarūpalāvaṇyasaṃpadā ..
putraiḥ saubhāgyavittaughai ryuktāḥ syuḥ surasattama ..
tanme kathaya tattvena vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam .. 15 ..
4.21.d:
येन ताः सुखसंभोगरूपलावण्यसंपदा ॥
पुत्रैः सौभाग्यवित्तौघै र्युक्ताः स्युः सुरसत्तम ॥
तन्मे कथय तत्त्वेन व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.21.m: Tell me truly, O best of the gods, the most excellent of observances, / by which they may be endowed with happiness, enjoyment, beauty, grace, prosperity, / sons, good fortune, and abundant wealth.”

4.21.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
māghe māsi site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ yatavratāḥ..
mukhaṃ prakṣālya hastau ca pādau caiva samāhitāḥ .. 16 ..
4.21.d:
॥ ईश्वर उवाच ॥ ॥
माघे मासि सिते पक्षे तृतीयायां यतव्रताः॥
मुखं प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ च पादौ चैव समाहिताः ॥ 16 ॥
4.21.m: The Lord said: / In the month of Māgha, in the bright fortnight, on the tṛtīyā, keeping their vows, / with concentrated minds, having washed their faces, hands, and feet,

4.21.s:
upavāsasya niyamaṃ daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
madhyāhne tu tataḥ snānaṃ bilvairāmalakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..17..
4.21.d:
उपवासस्य नियमं दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ॥
मध्याह्ने तु ततः स्नानं बिल्वैरामलकैः शुभैः ॥17॥
4.21.m: observing the rule of fasting after first brushing their teeth, / then bathing at midday with auspicious bilvas and āmalakas,

4.21.s:
snātvā tīrthajale śubhre vāsasī paridhāya ca ..
sugaṃdhaiḥ sumanobhiśca prabhūtaiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ ..18..
4.21.d:
स्नात्वा तीर्थजले शुभ्रे वाससी परिधाय च ॥
सुगंधैः सुमनोभिश्च प्रभूतैः कुंकुमादिभिः ॥18॥
4.21.m: having bathed in sacred water and put on two white garments, / with fragrant flowers and abundant saffron and the like,

4.21.s:
arcayaṃti sadā devi tvāṃ bhaktyā bhaktavatsale ..
karpūrādyaistathā dhūpairnaivedyaiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ .. 19 ..
4.21.d:
अर्चयंति सदा देवि त्वां भक्त्या भक्तवत्सले ॥
कर्पूराद्यैस्तथा धूपैर्नैवेद्यैः शर्करादिभिः ॥ 19 ॥
4.21.m: they always worship you, O goddess, with devotion, O you who are affectionate to your devotees, / with incense of camphor and the like, and food-offerings of sugar and the like,

4.21.s:
yadṛcchālābhasaṃpannairdhūpadīpārcanādibhiḥ ..
nāmneśānīṃ gṛhītvā tu pratīkṣeddhaṭikāṃ tataḥ .. 4.21.20 ..
4.21.d:
यदृच्छालाभसंपन्नैर्धूपदीपार्चनादिभिः ॥
नाम्नेशानीं गृहीत्वा तु प्रतीक्षेद्धटिकां ततः ॥ 4.21.20 ॥
4.21.m: and with worship of incense and lamps obtained as chance provides. / Taking the name Īśānī, one should then await the ghaṭikā.

4.21.s:
pātre tāmramaye śuddhe jalākṣatavimiśrite ..
sahiraṇyaṃ dvijaṃ kṛtvā maṃtrapūrvaṃ samādhinā .. 21 ..
4.21.d:
पात्रे ताम्रमये शुद्धे जलाक्षतविमिश्रिते ॥
सहिरण्यं द्विजं कृत्वा मंत्रपूर्वं समाधिना ॥ 21 ॥
4.21.m: In a clean copper vessel mixed with water and unbroken grains of rice, / having honoured a twice-born along with gold, according to the mantra with concentration,

4.21.s:
śirasi prakṣipettoyaṃ dhyāyaṃtī manasepsitam ..
brahmāvartātsamāyātā brahmayonervinirgatā .. 22 ..
4.21.d:
शिरसि प्रक्षिपेत्तोयं ध्यायंती मनसेप्सितम् ॥
ब्रह्मावर्तात्समायाता ब्रह्मयोनेर्विनिर्गता ॥ 22 ॥
4.21.m: she should sprinkle the water upon her head, meditating on her heart’s desire: / ‘Arrived from Brahmāvarta, issued from the womb of Brahmā,

4.21.s:
bhadreśvarā tato devī lalitā śaṃkarapriyā ..
gaṃgādvārāddharaṃ prāptā gaṅgājalapavitritā .. 23 ..
4.21.d:
भद्रेश्वरा ततो देवी ललिता शंकरप्रिया ॥
गंगाद्वाराद्धरं प्राप्ता गङ्गाजलपवित्रिता ॥ 23 ॥
4.21.m: thence the goddess Bhadreśvarā, Lalitā, beloved of Śaṅkara, / who reached the earth from Gaṅgādvāra, purified by the waters of the Gaṅgā,

4.21.s:
saubhāgyārogyaputrārthamarthārthaṃ haravallabhe ..
āyātā ghaṭikāṃ bhadre pratīkṣasva namonamaḥ .. 24 ..
4.21.d:
सौभाग्यारोग्यपुत्रार्थमर्थार्थं हरवल्लभे ॥
आयाता घटिकां भद्रे प्रतीक्षस्व नमोनमः ॥ 24 ॥
4.21.m: arrived for the sake of good fortune, health, sons, and wealth, O beloved of Hara; / wait for the ghaṭikā, O auspicious one! Salutation, salutation!’

4.21.s:
dattvā hiraṇyaṃ tattasmai prāśnīyācca kuśodakam ..
ācamya prayato bhūtvā bhūbhisthā kṣapayetkṣapām .. 25 ..
4.21.d:
दत्त्वा हिरण्यं तत्तस्मै प्राश्नीयाच्च कुशोदकम् ॥
आचम्य प्रयतो भूत्वा भूभिस्था क्षपयेत्क्षपाम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.21.m: Having given that gold to him, she should consume kuśa-water; / having sipped water and become purified, lying on the ground, she should pass the night,

4.21.s:
dhyāyamānā umāṃ daivīṃ harite yavasaṃstare ..
dvitīyehni tataḥ snātvā tathaivābhyarcya pārvatīm .. 26 ..
4.21.d:
ध्यायमाना उमां दैवीं हरिते यवसंस्तरे ॥
द्वितीयेह्नि ततः स्नात्वा तथैवाभ्यर्च्य पार्वतीम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.21.m: meditating upon the divine Umā on a bed of green barley-grass. / Then on the second day, having bathed and worshipped Pārvatī in the same manner,

4.21.s:
yathāśakti dvijānpūjya tato bhuñjīta vāgyatā ..
evaṃ tu prathame māsi pūjanīyāsi kālike .. 27 ..
4.21.d:
यथाशक्ति द्विजान्पूज्य ततो भुञ्जीत वाग्यता ॥
एवं तु प्रथमे मासि पूजनीयासि कालिके ॥ 27 ॥
4.21.m: having honoured the twice-born according to her means, she should eat, restrained in speech. / Thus in the first month you are to be worshipped as Kālikā;

4.21.s:
dvitīye pārvatīnāma tṛtīye śaṃkarapriyā ..
bhavānyatha caturthe tvaṃ skadamātātha pañcame .. 28 ..
4.21.d:
द्वितीये पार्वतीनाम तृतीये शंकरप्रिया ॥
भवान्यथ चतुर्थे त्वं स्कदमाताथ पञ्चमे ॥ 28 ॥
4.21.m: in the second under the name Pārvatī; in the third as Śaṅkarapriyā; / then in the fourth you are Bhavānī; and in the fifth, Skandamātā;

4.21.s:
dakṣasya duhitā ṣaṣṭhe mainākī saptame smṛtā ..
kātyāyanyaṣṭame māsi navame tu himādrijā ..29..
4.21.d:
दक्षस्य दुहिता षष्ठे मैनाकी सप्तमे स्मृता ॥
कात्यायन्यष्टमे मासि नवमे तु हिमाद्रिजा ॥29॥
4.21.m: in the sixth as the Daughter of Dakṣa; in the seventh she is remembered as Mainākī; / in the eighth month as Kātyāyanī; in the ninth as the Daughter of the Snow-Mountain;

4.21.s:
daśame māsi vikhyātā devi saubhāgyadāyinī ..
umā tvekādaśe māsi gaurī tu dvādaśe parā .. ..4.21.30..
4.21.d:
दशमे मासि विख्याता देवि सौभाग्यदायिनी ॥
