उमा त्वेकादशे मासि गौरी तु द्वादशे परा ॥ ॥4.21.30॥
4.21.m: in the tenth month, O goddess, she is renowned as Bestower of Good Fortune; / in the eleventh month as Umā; and in the twelfth as the supreme Gaurī.

4.21.s:
kuśodakaṃ payaḥ sarppirgomūtraṃ gomaya phalam ..
niṃbapatraṃ kaṃṭakārī gavāṃ śṛṃgodakaṃ dadhi ..31..
4.21.d:
कुशोदकं पयः सर्प्पिर्गोमूत्रं गोमय फलम् ॥
निंबपत्रं कंटकारी गवां शृंगोदकं दधि ॥31॥
4.21.m: Kuśa-water, milk, clarified butter, cow's urine, cow dung, fruit, / neem leaves, kaṇṭakārī, water [washed from] cows' horns, curd,

4.21.s:
pañcagavyaṃ tathā śākaḥ prāśanāni kramādamī ..
māsimāsi sthitā hyevamupavāsaparāyaṇā ..32..
4.21.d:
पञ्चगव्यं तथा शाकः प्राशनानि क्रमादमी ॥
मासिमासि स्थिता ह्येवमुपवासपरायणा ॥32॥
4.21.m: the five products of the cow, and vegetables—these are the foods to be consumed in succession. / Remaining thus month after month, devoted to fasting,

4.21.s:
dadāti śraddhayaitāni vācake brāhmaṇottame ..
kusuṃbhamājyaṃ lavaṇaṃ jīrakaṃ guḍameva ca ..33..
4.21.d:
ददाति श्रद्धयैतानि वाचके ब्राह्मणोत्तमे ॥
कुसुंभमाज्यं लवणं जीरकं गुडमेव च ॥33॥
4.21.m: she faithfully gives these to an excellent brāhmaṇa who recites: / safflower, clarified butter, salt, cumin, and jaggery.

4.21.s:
dattairebhiḥ sūryasthā tvaṃ sūryasthā tuṣyasi priye ..
māsimāsi bhavenmantro gakāro dvādaśākṣaraḥ .. 34 ..
4.21.d:
दत्तैरेभिः सूर्यस्था त्वं सूर्यस्था तुष्यसि प्रिये ॥
मासिमासि भवेन्मन्त्रो गकारो द्वादशाक्षरः ॥ 34 ॥
4.21.m: When these are given, you who abide in the sun are pleased, my dear. / Month by month there should be the twelve-syllable mantra beginning with the syllable 'ga',

4.21.s:
oṅkārapūrvako devi namaskārāṃta īritaḥ ..
ebhistvaṃ pūjitā maṃtraistuṣyasi vratataḥ priye .. 35 ..
4.21.d:
ओङ्कारपूर्वको देवि नमस्कारांत ईरितः ॥
एभिस्त्वं पूजिता मंत्रैस्तुष्यसि व्रततः प्रिये ॥ 35 ॥
4.21.m: preceded by the syllable 'om', O goddess, and declared to end with 'namas'. / Worshipped by these mantras through the observance, you are pleased, my dear.

4.21.s:
tuṣṭā tvabhīpsitānkāmāndadāsi prītipūrvakam ..
samāpte tu vrate tasminbrāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam .. 36 ..
4.21.d:
तुष्टा त्वभीप्सितान्कामान्ददासि प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ॥
समाप्ते तु व्रते तस्मिन्ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.21.m:
And pleased, you grant desired wishes with affection.
When that vrata is completed, to a brāhmaṇa who has mastered the Vedas,

4.21.s:
sahitaṃ bhāryayābhyarcya gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
dvijaṃ maheśvaraṃ kṛtvā umāṃ bhāryāṃ tathaiva ca .. 37 ..
4.21.d:
सहितं भार्ययाभ्यर्च्य गंधपुष्पादिभिः शुभैः ॥
द्विजं महेश्वरं कृत्वा उमां भार्यां तथैव च ॥ 37 ॥
4.21.m:
having worshipped [him] together with his wife using auspicious perfumes, flowers, and other offerings,
having regarded the twice-born as Maheśvara and his wife as Umā,

4.21.s:
annaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ dadyāttathā śukle ca vāsasī ..
raktaṃ vāsoyugaṃ dadyāttvāmuddiśya harapriye .. 38 ..
4.21.d:
अन्नं सदक्षिणं दद्यात्तथा शुक्ले च वाससी ॥
रक्तं वासोयुगं दद्यात्त्वामुद्दिश्य हरप्रिये ॥ 38 ॥
4.21.m:
one should give food along with a sacrificial fee, and likewise two white garments;
one should give a pair of red garments dedicated to you, O beloved of Hara.

4.21.s:
brāhmaṇe śraddhayā yuktastasyāṃ phalamidaṃ śṛṇu ..
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi lokānprāpya parāparān .. 39 ..
4.21.d:
ब्राह्मणे श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्यां फलमिदं शृणु ॥
दशवर्षसहस्राणि लोकान्प्राप्य परापरान् ॥ 39 ॥
4.21.m:
Endowed with faith toward the brāhmaṇa, hear this fruit on that [occasion]:
Having attained higher and lower worlds for ten thousand years,

4.21.s:
modate bhartṛsahitā yatheṃdreṇa śacī tathā ..
mānuṣatvaṃ punaḥ prāpya svena bhartrā sahaiva sā .. 4.21.40..
4.21.d:
मोदते भर्तृसहिता यथेंद्रेण शची तथा ॥
मानुषत्वं पुनः प्राप्य स्वेन भर्त्रा सहैव सा ॥ 4.21.40॥
4.21.m:
she rejoices along with her husband, just as Śacī does with Indra.
Having attained human birth once again, together with her own husband,

4.21.s:
puṇye kule śriyā yuktā nīrogā sukhamaśnute ..
sapta janmāni yāvacca na vaidhavyamavāpnuyāt ..41..
4.21.d:
पुण्ये कुले श्रिया युक्ता नीरोगा सुखमश्नुते ॥
सप्त जन्मानि यावच्च न वैधव्यमवाप्नुयात् ॥41॥
4.21.m:
endowed with fortune in a virtuous family, free of disease, she enjoys happiness,
and for seven births she will not suffer widowhood.

4.21.s:
putrānbhogāṃstathā rūpaṃ saubhāgyārogyameva ca ..
ekapatnī tathā bhartuḥ prāṇebhyo'pyadhikā bhavet..42..
4.21.d:
पुत्रान्भोगांस्तथा रूपं सौभाग्यारोग्यमेव च ॥
एकपत्नी तथा भर्तुः प्राणेभ्योऽप्यधिका भवेत्॥42॥
4.21.m:
She attains sons, pleasures, beauty, good fortune, and good health;
and as the sole wife of her husband, she becomes dearer [to him] than life itself.

4.21.s:
śṛṇuyādvācyamānaṃ tu bhaktyā yā lalitāvratam ..
mayā snehena kathitaṃ sāpi tatphalabhāginī .. 43 ..
4.21.d:
शृणुयाद्वाच्यमानं तु भक्त्या या ललिताव्रतम् ॥
मया स्नेहेन कथितं सापि तत्फलभागिनी ॥ 43 ॥
4.21.m:
Whichever woman hears with devotion this Lalitāvrata being recited,
which has been related by me out of love, she too partakes of that reward.

4.21.s:
saṃpūjya lakṣalalitāṃ lalitāṃgayaṣṭiṃ gaṃdhodakāmṛtaghaṭīṃ śirasi kṣipedyaḥ..
sā svargametya lalitāsu lalāmabhūtā bhūpādhipaṃ patimavāpya bhuvaṃ bhunakti .. 44 ..
aviyogatṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
4.21.d:
संपूज्य लक्षललितां ललितांगयष्टिं गंधोदकामृतघटीं शिरसि क्षिपेद्यः॥
सा स्वर्गमेत्य ललितासु ललामभूता भूपाधिपं पतिमवाप्य भुवं भुनक्ति ॥ 44 ॥
अवियोगतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.21.m:
Whoever, having worshipped Lalitā a hundred thousand times, whose slender body is lovely, pours a jar of nectar-like scented water upon her head,
she, having attained heaven, becomes an ornament among graceful women, and having obtained a lord of kings as husband, enjoys the earth.
Description of the Aviyogatṛtīyāvrata
